name: Acid
identity: Acid removes protection and changes surfaces. It does not apply Poison's internal damage stacks; its threat is exposure to the next attack.

moves.name: Vitriol Needle
moves.desc: A thin lime needle travels at 24 m/s, dealing 70 damage and one Corrosion. Hitting a construct instead erodes 100 durability; it stops at the first solid obstacle.
moves.p60: Adds a second Corrosion on a shield hit, not a second damage packet.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the narrow line or use disposable cover.

moves.name: Solvent Ribbon
moves.desc: Sweep a 1.5-metre-wide ribbon across the floor. It lasts 5 seconds, dealing 20 damage each second of contact and removing a stack of hardened terrain reinforcement per tick.
moves.p60: Permits one curved segment around a visible corner.
moves.counterplay: Jump across; flying targets are unaffected.

moves.name: Caustic Shed
moves.statline: CD 16 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.15 s | R self
moves.desc: Peel away a transparent acidic shell, cleansing one movement slow and leaving a 120-durability decoy for 3 seconds. Destroying it splashes 45 damage within 2 metres; the caster retreats 3 metres.
moves.p60: Lets the shell absorb one Corrosion stack from its owner.
moves.counterplay: Avoid breaking the shell at melee range.

moves.name: Dissolution Brand
moves.desc: Stamp a visible triangular brand for 5 seconds. The next shield created by that enemy loses 100 durability immediately; otherwise the brand expires in a 90-damage burst. Only one brand may exist.
moves.p60: Makes its expiry leave a 2-metre acid pool for 3 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Cleanse the brand or spend a small shield to discharge it.

moves.name: Basilisk Rain
moves.desc: Mark an 8-metre-radius zone. Three concentric rain rings strike over 3 seconds for 90 each, outside inward. Breakable cover loses 150 durability per ring. Gaps rotate between rings and remain visibly marked.
moves.counterplay: Move through the ring gaps; overhead cover buys one ring.
moves.unstable: Replaces the final ring with a moving 120-damage acid wave; the caster is also vulnerable to that wave.

passive.name: Etched Weakness
passive.text: Direct ability hits add one Corrosion stack for 6 seconds, maximum three. Each removes 4 percentage points of damage reduction, never below zero. At three, shields take 25% extra damage from Acid. Cleansing removes one stack per use.

mutation.name: Universal Solvent
mutation.text: After the unstable wave, all Acid pools become neutral for 4 seconds and can hurt the caster. Rupture also removes the caster's protective shell; there is no blanket Acid immunity during recovery.

sequence: Lay Ribbon across the shortest retreat, Brand a shield user, then fire Needle when they cross. Caustic Shed is the only immediate escape; baiting it makes the stationary ultimate vulnerable.

team.text: Steel filings in Ribbon become a brittle corrosive mesh that slows by 20% for 2 seconds. Water clears half a pool's remaining duration and creates a non-damaging diluted slick; it never amplifies Acid damage.

name: Agility
identity: Agility rewards clean movement and whiff punishment. It has no teleports, flight, or passive damage amplification and cannot escape a properly timed root.

moves.name: Needle Step
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 4 | W 0.12 s | R 5 m
moves.desc: Lunge 5 metres and strike for 65 damage. Aim can rotate only 30 degrees after commitment. Spending one Stride extends the lunge by 2 metres but adds 0.2 seconds of recovery.
moves.p60: Allows a 1-metre sidestep after a confirmed hit.
moves.counterplay: Hold the endpoint rather than chasing the dash trail.

moves.name: Wall Waltz
moves.statline: CD 10 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.2 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: Run along a solid wall for up to 2 seconds, then vault away. A descending kick deals 85 damage. Destroying the wall forces a fall; the user cannot attack during the run.
moves.p60: Allows one transfer to another wall within 3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Remove the supporting wall or aim at the landing marker.

moves.name: Borrowed Opening
moves.statline: CD 14 s | E 18 | H 7 | W 0.1 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Assume a low stance for 0.5 seconds. If a melee strike misses within 2 metres, instantly circle its attacker and deal 100 damage. Projectiles and grabs do not trigger the response.
moves.p60: Refunds one Stride on success.
moves.counterplay: Delay the strike or use a grab.

moves.name: Redline Route
moves.desc: Place three visible waypoints within a 16-metre path. Recast within 4 seconds to dash between them, dealing 35 damage per crossed enemy per segment. A target can take at most two segments.
moves.p60: Allows moving the final waypoint before recasting.
moves.counterplay: Trap a waypoint or force the user away from the start.

moves.name: Frame Perfect
moves.statline: CD 75 s | E 30 | H 30 | W 0.8 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 6 seconds, successful evades store up to four counterstrikes. Recast ends the stance and spends them as 60-damage lunges toward visible enemies within 10 metres. Missing lunges still consume charges.
moves.counterplay: Stop feeding attacks, spread out, or block the final approach.
moves.unstable: Doubles lunge travel speed but removes steering and defensive dodge frames during the execution.

passive.name: Unbroken Stride
passive.text: Moving continuously for 2 seconds grants one Stride, maximum three. A dodge through a hostile hitbox grants another. Each Stride adds 3% running speed. Taking a hard-control effect removes all stacks; standing still drains one per second.

mutation.name: Impossible Footwork
mutation.text: The unstable sequence leaves the user exhausted at its last endpoint. It grants no invulnerability between strikes; an opponent who predicts the route can interrupt the entire release.

sequence: Use Wall Waltz to change approach height, Needle Step to provoke a swing, then Borrowed Opening. Agility loses value in open spaces without walls and against lingering hazards rather than discrete attacks.

team.text: Wind lanes extend Wall Waltz's exit by 2 metres without extra damage. Friendly Thread can supply one temporary wall-run line, but cutting it immediately ends the traverse.

name: Alchemist
identity: Alchemist crafts fixed reactions from three reagents. Recipes are visible and deterministic; this is controlled chemistry fantasy, not unrestricted Creation or random Magic.

moves.name: Retort Flask
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Throw a flask in an arc for 55 impact damage. Salt roots for 0.4 seconds; Sulfur adds 30 burn over 3 seconds; Mercury slides the target 2 metres. The selected color remains visible in flight.
moves.p60: Refunds the reagent if the flask intercepts a projectile.
moves.counterplay: Break line of sight or dodge after reading the flask color.

moves.name: Equivalent Exchange
moves.desc: Convert one nonliving construct below 180 durability into a 120-durability wall, 80-point shield, or 60-health restorative pickup. Ownership must be friendly or neutral; hostile structures must first be broken.
moves.p60: Lets the pickup be thrown 8 metres.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the offered material before conversion completes.

moves.name: Catalyst Circle
moves.desc: A 4-metre circle lasts 6 seconds. The next two flasks landing inside react: Salt plus Sulfur deals 120 burst; Salt plus Mercury creates 100-durability cover; Sulfur plus Mercury pushes enemies 4 metres.
moves.p60: Preserves the circle after its first completed reaction.
moves.counterplay: Leave the circle or attack its 100-durability chalk anchor.

moves.name: Quick Distillation
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 10 | H 4 | W 0.75 s | R self
moves.desc: Channel to refill one missing reagent and remove one removable damage-over-time effect. Each remaining tick removed grants 3 Energy, maximum 15. Moving cancels the channel without refunding its initial cost.
moves.p60: Lets a nearby ally within 3 metres receive the cleanse instead.
moves.counterplay: Pressure during the channel; it is not a panic invulnerability.

moves.name: Magnum Opus
moves.desc: Create a 7-metre reaction circle with three 120-durability vessels. Salt pins, Mercury draws inward, and Sulfur detonates after 3 seconds for 260 damage. Each destroyed vessel removes its associated stage.
moves.counterplay: Destroy Sulfur to remove the main burst, or escape through a broken vessel's sector.
moves.unstable: Doubles the circle duration and permits a second 160-damage detonation, but vessels then become neutral explosives.

passive.name: Three Reagents
passive.text: Carry three reagent charges: Salt, Sulfur, and Mercury. The first three normal abilities consume one chosen reagent; Quick Distillation consumes none. An empty slot refills after 7 seconds. Repeating a reagent adds 4 Heat; alternating all three refunds 10 Energy once per cycle.

mutation.name: Philosopher Reaction
mutation.text: The unstable second blast damages every unit including the Alchemist. No recipe produces permanent currency, restores Proxima, duplicates ultimates, or converts player bodies.

sequence: Salt Flask supplies a brief setup window for Catalyst Circle. Exchange creates protection for Distillation. Fast enemies that keep relocating can deny the slow two-flask reaction without needing a specific element.

team.text: Gold constructs yield 30 additional shield points through Exchange, once per construct. Mud in Catalyst Circle replaces Mercury's pull with a 25% slow but cannot add another damage stage.

name: Angel
identity: Angel uses wings, sanctuary, and interception. Its signature is saving a teammate at personal risk; offensive power depends on proximity to threatened allies.

moves.name: Feather Verdict
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Release three white feathers in a narrow fan, each dealing 25 damage. Feathers crossing an ally restore 10 health instead and then disappear. A single unit can receive all three.
moves.p60: Lets one missed feather return to heal the caster for 15.
moves.counterplay: Spread laterally; feathers do not bend around cover.

moves.name: Mercy Descent
moves.desc: Glide to a visible ally or ground point and open a 140-point shield over both for 2 seconds. Landing deals no damage. A hostile hit can knock the user out of the approach.
moves.p60: Cleanses one slow from the protected ally.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the glide or wait out the short shield.

moves.name: Sanctuary Wing
moves.desc: Plant one wing as a frontal 240-durability barrier for 4 seconds. Allies may pass through. The Angel moves at half speed and cannot cast Feather Verdict while maintaining it.
moves.p60: Stores 20% blocked damage, maximum 60, as healing on release.
moves.counterplay: Flank the wing or force the Angel to turn.

moves.name: Ascension Bell
moves.desc: A bell marks a 3-metre circle for 0.8 seconds, then lifts enemies 2 metres and deals 95 damage. Allies in the circle gain a single high jump rather than being forcibly moved.
moves.p60: Allows one airborne enemy to be nudged 2 metres sideways.
moves.counterplay: Step outside the bell outline before it rings.

moves.name: Choir of Return
moves.desc: Four pillars surround a 7-metre sanctuary for 6 seconds. Each second heals allies for 20 and deals 25 to enemies. Recast ends it with a 120-point allied shield; destroying two pillars ends it early.
moves.counterplay: Attack pillars or isolate the Angel outside the sanctuary.
moves.unstable: Transfers up to 200 incoming allied damage to the Angel while doubling the final shield; transferred damage cannot be reduced.

passive.name: Witness
passive.text: Preventing 60 damage to an ally grants one Grace, maximum three, lasting 10 seconds. Spending Grace adds 20 shield to the next rescue ability. Self-protection, environmental damage, and friendly damage cannot farm Grace.

mutation.name: Seraphic Burden
mutation.text: The unstable rescue can defeat its caster. It does not resurrect eliminated players. Visual wings and choir rings must never hide opponents or replace the player's camera.

sequence: Use Wing to earn Grace, then Descent to rescue a second ally. Bell protects the retreat. Angel's self-healing is modest; split pressure forces hard choices about whom to defend.

team.text: Light beams through Wing gain 2 metres of range but consume 30 barrier durability. Sound can carry the Bell cue farther for allies, granting a 10% movement buff for 2 seconds instead of extra control.

name: Animal
identity: Animal fights alongside one trained companion. Unlike Beast, the player does not transform; damage and scouting are divided between two vulnerable bodies.

moves.name: Sic
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.2 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Order the companion to attack for 70 damage. Hound tracks the last visible path; Hawk dives above low cover; Boar pushes 1.5 metres. None tracks an unseen target after 1 second.
moves.p60: Grants the player 10% speed toward the attacked enemy for 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Intercept the companion or break its approach path.

moves.name: Recall Leap
moves.desc: Recall the companion immediately and vault 4 metres away from its arrival point. The return path is harmless. If it is rooted, the vault fails but the ability's cooldown is halved.
moves.p60: Grants the companion an 80-point shield during recall.
moves.counterplay: Root the companion before recall or pressure the player separately.

moves.name: Territorial Call
moves.desc: Place a 5-metre patrol circle for 7 seconds. The companion attacks intruders once per 2 seconds for 35 damage and reveals their footprints for 1 second. It still needs line of sight.
moves.p60: Extends patrol to a second adjacent circle with no faster attacks.
moves.counterplay: Destroy or lure away the companion; circles are not walls.

moves.name: Shared Instinct
moves.desc: For 4 seconds the player and companion alternate receiving a 40% damage reduction after either is hit. Each switch lasts 0.5 seconds. Area attacks hitting both resolve separately, not twice on one health pool.
moves.p60: Lets the player swap positions with the companion once, if both locations are clear.
moves.counterplay: Use broad attacks or focus the currently unprotected body.

moves.name: Wild Assembly
moves.desc: Summon the two unselected companions for 8 seconds, each with 160 health. Recasts issue a coordinated charge, maximum twice, dealing 60 per surviving animal. The player's original companion remains commandable.
moves.counterplay: Spread attacks across the fragile summons or retreat through narrow cover.
moves.unstable: Adds a third charge but makes all companions ignore Recall and pursue their final target until defeated.

passive.name: Pack Bond
passive.text: Choose Hound, Hawk, or Boar at spawn. The companion has 220 health and a 20-metre leash. Defeat disables commands for 12 seconds; resummoning costs 20 Energy. It reveals targets only through actual vision.

mutation.name: Primal Muster
mutation.text: Unstable companions cannot be redirected, healed, or copied. Their command loss matters more than raw damage; a target can lead them into traps before the final charge.

sequence: Patrol restricts movement, Sic tests the opponent's reaction, and Shared Instinct creates a flank. Losing the companion removes most pressure; the player's basic attack remains available but gains no replacement pet.

team.text: Heal restores companions at half its listed player value. Nature bushes conceal a stationary companion's silhouette, but its command ring and attack windup remain visible when it acts.

name: Arcane
identity: Arcane arranges vertices, lines, and enclosed shapes. Magic uses a flexible spell repertoire; Arcane's power depends on spatial preparation that opponents can dismantle.

moves.name: Axiom Bolt
moves.desc: Fire a violet bolt for 65 damage. Hitting terrain places a vertex; hitting an enemy places it at their ground position, not attached to their body. The bolt cannot pass through intact cover.
moves.p60: Lets the bolt bend once at a friendly vertex by up to 60 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Destroy a vertex or move outside the predicted reflected line.

moves.name: Transversal
moves.desc: Slide along one owned ley line to either end. Crossing an enemy deals 80 damage once. The endpoint glows before movement, and teleportation is prohibited if the line intersects newly raised cover.
moves.p60: Leaves a 1-second decoy at the starting vertex.
moves.counterplay: Block the line or attack the announced endpoint.

moves.name: Proof of Containment
moves.desc: Activate the triangle for 4 seconds. Crossing an edge deals 45 damage and a 0.3-second root, once per enemy per second. Standing inside is safe; the triangle is a boundary trap.
moves.p60: Allows one vertex to move 2 metres before activation.
moves.counterplay: Break the weakest vertex or jump over an edge's 2-metre height.

moves.name: Counterformula
moves.statline: CD 19 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.2 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: For 0.7 seconds, intercept one energy projectile crossing a ley line. Dissolve it and refund 15 Energy. Physical projectiles merely lose 25% damage; beams and ultimates cannot be intercepted.
moves.p60: Turns the dissolved projectile into a fresh vertex at the crossing.
moves.counterplay: Use a physical attack or bait the short interception window.

moves.name: Grand Theorem
moves.desc: Expand the current triangle into a six-sided seal for 5 seconds. Its edges flash clockwise, then fire inward for 60 damage each; an enemy can take at most four edges. Destroying a vertex opens an escape sector.
moves.counterplay: Break vertices early or remain in the sector of an already fired edge.
moves.unstable: Rotates the seal while it fires, adding a 100-damage central collapse that also hits its caster.

passive.name: Ley Geometry
passive.text: Basic ability impacts place a vertex for 8 seconds, maximum three. Two vertices connect a harmless visible line; three form a triangle. Only one triangle can exist, and each vertex has 60 durability.

mutation.name: Forbidden Geometry
mutation.text: The unstable central collapse destroys all owned vertices and leaves no safe center. Without a prepared triangle, the ultimate places a small equilateral seal at the cursor instead of failing silently.

sequence: Use two Bolts to establish a lane, Transversal to change angle, and the third Bolt to close a trap. Arcane loses prepared value whenever an enemy destroys low-health vertices.

team.text: Crystal can replace one vertex with a 100-durability facet. Space can move one vertex through a portal but breaks all existing lines, forcing the Arcane user to rebuild the shape.

name: Ash
identity: Ash exploits spent attacks, soot, and smoldering remains. Fire is immediate ignition; Ash thrives after flames have gone out and the arena has accumulated debris.

moves.name: Cinder Finger
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Flick an ember for 55 damage and a 20-damage burn over 2 seconds. Spend one stored Ember to make it pass through one Ash pile and emerge at a chosen second pile.
moves.p60: Reveals the exit pile only 0.25 seconds before emergence.
moves.counterplay: Clear piles or dodge perpendicular to the exit glow.

moves.name: Soot Veil
moves.desc: Raise a 4-metre cloud for 5 seconds. It blocks target locks through its center but not manual aiming, silhouettes at close range, or objective indicators. Enemies entering cough once for 35 damage.
moves.p60: Lets the caster drag the cloud 2 metres while channeling.
moves.counterplay: Use area attacks or Wind to disperse it.

moves.name: Ember Rake
moves.desc: Pull up to three owned piles into a sweeping arc. Each consumed pile adds 35 damage to the base 45. The sweep spans 100 degrees and knocks targets 2 metres away.
moves.p60: Leaves one new pile behind every struck construct.
moves.counterplay: Fight outside the pile network and punish the visible gathering motion.

moves.name: Cremation Bed
moves.desc: Compress a 5-metre patch of Ash into a smoldering bed for 6 seconds. It deals 18 damage per second and reduces incoming healing by 25% while occupied; it does not stack with other healing reductions.
moves.p60: Slows the first enemy entering by 20% for 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Leave the bed; it cannot follow its victim.

moves.name: The Last Ember
moves.desc: All owned piles glow for 1 second, then erupt sequentially for 90 damage within 3 metres. A target can take three eruptions at most. Remaining ash becomes a single 8-metre soot bank for 5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Destroy glowing piles or follow the already detonated trail.
moves.unstable: Burns the soot bank from its perimeter inward for 150 damage, affecting the caster as well.

passive.name: What Remains
passive.text: A damaging ability leaving a scorch or destroyed construct creates one Ash pile, maximum five owned piles. Walking through one consumes it to store an Ember, maximum three. At full Embers, piles remain uncollected. Enemy-owned piles cannot be collected without cleansing them first.

mutation.name: Funeral Ash
mutation.text: The unstable burn consumes every owned Ash resource. It creates a strong finish but leaves the user with no stored Embers and no obscuring cloud during Burnout.

sequence: Veil conceals placement, Bed pressures a healing location, and Rake converts piles into burst. A clean arena or opponents who fight vertically deny the passive's strongest routes.

team.text: Friendly Fire adds one Ash pile when a burn zone ends, never every tick. Water turns Ash into neutral sludge, removing ignition but creating a 15% movement slow for both teams.

name: Beast
identity: Beast changes its own anatomy to pursue wounded opponents. Animal commands a companion; Beast has one body and accepts the risks of every committed pounce.

moves.name: Rending Claw
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 5 | W 0.2 s | R 3 m
moves.desc: Swipe twice for 35 damage each. The second hit applies a 30-damage bleed over 3 seconds only if the first connected. Turning between hits is limited to 45 degrees.
moves.p60: Extends the second claw's reach by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Backstep after the first swipe or parry the second.

moves.name: Predator Pounce
moves.desc: Crouch, then leap along a visible arc for 100 landing damage in a 2-metre circle. Hitting a scented enemy refunds 3 seconds of cooldown; missing leaves 0.6 seconds of recovery.
moves.p60: Permits one midair direction adjustment of 20 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Dodge after launch; the leap cannot retarget fully.

moves.name: Hide of the Cornered
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Grow armored hide for 3 seconds, reducing frontal damage by 30% and knockback by half. Running speed falls 15%, and claw reach is unchanged. Rear attacks bypass the reduction.
moves.p60: Stores up to 60 prevented damage for the next claw hit.
moves.counterplay: Circle behind or force the stance to expire.

moves.name: Territorial Roar
moves.desc: Roar in a cone, dealing 75 damage and interrupting channels. Scented enemies are pushed 3 metres; others 1 metre. The sound never reverses controls or forces camera movement.
moves.p60: Reveals footprints from hidden enemies caught in the cone.
moves.counterplay: Use solid cover or strike during the inhalation.

moves.name: Apex Hunt
moves.statline: CD 80 s | E 35 | H 30 | W 1 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: Transform for 7 seconds. Claw cooldown becomes 2 seconds, Pounce gains one extra charge, and Hide cannot be used. The transformation grants no healing and preserves existing cooldowns when it ends.
moves.counterplay: Disengage around corners and punish the unguarded recovery.
moves.unstable: Adds 20% movement speed and bleed damage, but removes guarding and makes missed pounces cause a 1-second fall.

passive.name: Scent of Weakness
passive.text: Damaging an enemy below 50% health reveals their footprints for 4 seconds within 15 metres. Following those footprints grants 8% speed. This reveals a trail, never a live wall-through silhouette.

mutation.name: Apex Without Restraint
mutation.text: The unstable form continues until its timer ends, even during Rupture. Its inability to guard is the price of pursuit; transformation never grants control immunity.

sequence: Roar interrupts a defensive channel, Claw creates a wounded target, and Pounce follows the scent. Beast is vulnerable to aerial opponents and opponents who keep health high through small, frequent heals.

team.text: Blood marks produce scent trails but do not activate the below-half speed bonus. Snow records Beast footprints too, making its own ambush route easier for opponents to track.

name: Blood
tagline: Visible resource expenditure and delayed recovery
identity: Blood uses a conjured reserve, not unrestricted control over another player's body. Its strongest attacks spend stored vitality and expose predictable recovery points.

moves.name: Hemal Lance
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 10 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Spend 10 Reserve to launch a dark-red spear for 90 damage. If Reserve is insufficient, it deals 55 without spending any. A struck target leaves one visible droplet, collectible by the caster for 5 Reserve.
moves.p60: Lets the lance pin a droplet to cover for remote collection.
moves.counterplay: Block the spear or deny access to the droplet.

moves.name: Crimson Tether
moves.desc: Attach a tether for 3 seconds, dealing 15 per second while line of sight holds. Recast spends 15 Reserve to pull the target 2 metres; a dodge through the tether snaps it.
moves.p60: Lets the pull move the caster instead, creating a gap closer.
moves.counterplay: Break line of sight or dash across the tether.

moves.name: Coagulate
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 20 | H 6 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend up to 30 Reserve to create a shield worth three times the amount spent, lasting 4 seconds. Unused shield converts back at half efficiency; it does not restore health.
moves.p60: Grants 0.5 seconds of knockback resistance on activation.
moves.counterplay: Wait out the shield or use pressure that forces its full consumption.

moves.name: Circulatory Return
moves.desc: Call up to six owned droplets home. Each restores 12 health and 5 Reserve. Droplets travel visibly and can be intercepted by enemies, who destroy them but receive no healing.
moves.p60: Lets droplets curve around one visible obstacle.
moves.counterplay: Stand between the caster and droplets or interrupt the channel.

moves.name: Crimson Orrery
moves.desc: Spend up to 60 Reserve to create six orbiting spears for 5 seconds. Each deals 35 plus half the spent Reserve, fired on individual recasts. A target can take at most four spears.
moves.counterplay: Move through the gaps or block the visible convergence point.
moves.unstable: Fires all six in a converging ring and grants 30% lifesteal, but locks Return for 8 seconds.

passive.name: Crimson Reserve
passive.text: Begin with 60 Reserve, maximum 100. Direct damage restores Reserve equal to 15% of health damage dealt, maximum 10 per cast. Reserve is separate from health. Spending it never kills the player or bypasses shields.

mutation.name: Royal Circulation
mutation.text: Unstable lifesteal applies only to actual enemy health damage, capped at 120 healing. Shields, companions, self-damage, and overkill return nothing, preventing a self-sustaining loop.

sequence: Lance supplies droplets, Tether protects access to them, and Return converts a good exchange into recovery. Blood struggles when shields deny health damage or enemies occupy its scattered droplets.

team.text: Thorn can hold a droplet safely on a friendly bramble, once per bramble. Heal may cleanse Blood's bleeds normally; it cannot remove or steal the caster's Reserve.

name: Bone
tagline: Segmented armor and expendable skeletal tools
identity: Bone grows finite structures from a renewable Marrow pool. It uses articulated geometry, with breakable joints and recoverable fragments rather than generic stone walls.

moves.name: Splinter Fan
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 16 m
moves.desc: Spend one Marrow to fire five splinters for 18 damage each across a 35-degree fan. Hitting a jointed construct deals 30 extra durability damage, but player limbs are never separately disabled.
moves.p60: Narrows the fan on hold for a precision shot.
moves.counterplay: Angle a shield toward the fan or fight outside its central overlap.

moves.name: Ribcage Guard
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 20 | H 7 | W 0.35 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend two Marrow to create three 70-durability ribs for 4 seconds. Each blocks its own narrow frontal sector; open spaces remain between them. The caster can fire Splinter Fan through the gaps.
moves.p60: Allows rotating the ribs around the torso once.
moves.counterplay: Shoot through gaps or attack from behind.

moves.name: Vertebral Vault
moves.statline: CD 15 s | E 18 | H 8 | W 0.4 s | R 9 m
moves.desc: Spend one Marrow to extend a segmented spine along the floor, vaulting 6 metres upward. Recast collapses it into a 75-damage sweep. Destroying a middle joint removes the sweep's far segment.
moves.p60: Lets the spine grip a wall to change the launch angle.
moves.counterplay: Break the visible joint or pressure the landing.

moves.name: Ossuary Stakes
moves.desc: Spend two Marrow to raise four 90-durability stakes in a square for 7 seconds. Enemies touching a stake take 40 damage once per second. Stakes obstruct movement individually, not as an invisible cage.
moves.p60: Connects one pair with a breakable 60-durability crossbar.
moves.counterplay: Destroy one stake to open a route.

moves.name: Cathedral of Ribs
moves.desc: Raise a 7-metre skeletal dome for 6 seconds, with six 130-durability supports. Recast closes its ribs in three waves for 80 each. Every destroyed support removes one sixth of each wave's hitbox.
moves.counterplay: Break supports before closure or leave through a missing sector.
moves.unstable: Turns the final wave into a 160-damage collapse, including beneath the caster, and consumes all remaining Marrow.

passive.name: Marrow Economy
passive.text: Carry five Marrow segments. Abilities spend the listed segments and regrow one every 4 seconds. Destroyed owned bones drop fragments for 3 seconds; collecting two restores one segment, once per original structure.

mutation.name: Marrow Titan
mutation.text: The unstable collapse does not immobilize anyone by cinematic fiat. It leaves collectible fragments for opponents to destroy; regrowth pauses throughout Burnout, making wasted armor expensive.

sequence: Stakes guide the opponent into a narrow Fan, while Guard protects slow setup. Bone loses to repeated piercing attacks and enemies who destroy fragments before the caster can recycle them.

team.text: Steel can reinforce one stake by 60 durability but prevents its fragment refund. Acid strips that reinforcement first, then damages the underlying bone normally.

name: Candy
identity: Candy changes between syrup, hard candy, and spun sugar. Its playful appearance conceals a kit built around adhesion, breakage, and controlled consumption.

moves.name: Taffy Snare
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 16 m
moves.desc: A pink strand deals 55 damage and slows 25% for 2 seconds. If it hits terrain, it becomes a visible ankle-height tripwire for 4 seconds, with 40 durability.
moves.p60: Lets its endpoints stretch 2 metres farther apart.
moves.counterplay: Jump the wire or cut either endpoint.

moves.name: Jawbreaker Ricochet
moves.desc: Roll a hard candy sphere for 90 damage. It rebounds from two walls and loses 20 damage per rebound. Its path cannot hit the same player twice.
moves.p60: Leaves a 1-second syrup patch at each rebound.
moves.counterplay: Avoid predicted rebounds or destroy the 60-durability sphere.

moves.name: Cotton Cloud
moves.desc: Create a spun-sugar cushion for 5 seconds. It absorbs 120 projectile damage, then collapses. Landing on it cancels fall recovery and launches an optional 4-metre bounce.
moves.p60: Permits two allied bounces before the cushion dissolves.
moves.counterplay: Melee attacks pass through its porous defense.

moves.name: Caramel Lock
moves.desc: Coat a 3-metre patch in syrup. After 1 second it hardens, dealing 100 damage and rooting occupants for 0.6 seconds. The hardened patch becomes 160-durability low cover.
moves.p60: Allows delaying the hardening by up to 1 second.
moves.counterplay: Leave the patch before its gold surface cracks.

moves.name: Sugar Palace
moves.desc: Build four candy walls around a 6-metre court for 6 seconds. Each has 160 durability. Recast shatters surviving walls inward for 70 per wall, maximum 210 per target.
moves.counterplay: Break a wall to establish a safe exit.
moves.unstable: Coats shards in syrup, adding a 30% slow but making walls shatter toward allies too.

passive.name: Sugar Temper
passive.text: Alternate soft and hard abilities to earn Temper, maximum two. A Temper increases the next Candy construct's durability by 40, then is consumed. Soft effects slow; hard effects block. Neither steals movement inputs.

mutation.name: Glass Sugar
mutation.text: The unstable palace's shards hurt the caster for full damage. Every wall is hard Candy and consumes at most one Temper; construction cannot recursively generate Temper.

sequence: Snare steers opponents into Caramel Lock; Jawbreaker punishes the remaining exit. Water dissolves soft Candy twice as fast, while heat prematurely melts hard cover into harmless syrup.

team.text: Fire melts a Jawbreaker into a short syrup lane instead of an explosion. Ice hardens Cotton Cloud into conventional 160-durability cover but removes its bounce.

name: Chaos
identity: Chaos changes the shape of an attack through a visible cycle. Randomness never decides whether a hit deals zero or instantly kills; opponents can read the selected outcome.

moves.name: Discord Bolt
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Launch 90 total damage as three 30-damage splinters, one curved bolt, or a 45-outbound/45-return boomerang according to the wheel. The chosen symbol appears over the hand.
moves.p60: Lets the player freeze the wheel for 1 second before launch.
moves.counterplay: Read the symbol and evade its specific path.

moves.name: Wrong Turn
moves.desc: Dash 6 metres, leaving an arrow that reverses one incoming ordinary projectile's direction after a 0.4-second warning. The redirected projectile becomes neutral and expires after 8 metres.
moves.p60: Allows rotating the arrow by 90 degrees once.
moves.counterplay: Attack from another direction or use a beam.

moves.name: Anomaly Box
moves.desc: Place a 120-durability box for 6 seconds. It alternates between a 2-metre lift, a 25% slow, and a harmless sideways shove in a 3-metre radius; no damage ticks occur.
moves.p60: Permits choosing the starting state.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the box or enter during its weak state.

moves.name: Misfire Insurance
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 20 | H 7 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: For 3 seconds, one missed Chaos projectile returns 50% of its Energy cost and creates a 60-point shield. Hits, construct hits, and deliberately fired skyward shots do not qualify.
moves.p60: Also refunds 2 seconds of that projectile's cooldown.
moves.counterplay: Force a hit on cheap cover to deny the refund.

moves.name: Probability Carnival
moves.desc: Mark nine floor tiles. Three announced patterns strike over 4 seconds, each for 100 damage. The next pattern previews for 0.7 seconds; at least three tiles remain safe every wave.
moves.counterplay: Follow previews; do not chase the caster through unsafe tiles.
moves.unstable: Permits manual rotation of the final pattern, but its damage affects the caster and its preview remains mandatory.

passive.name: Loaded Disorder
passive.text: A three-symbol wheel cycles every 2 seconds: Split, Curve, Return. Casting locks its current symbol for that cast. It alters trajectories only; all branches share a fixed damage budget and target cap.

mutation.name: Prime Disorder
mutation.text: The unstable board never conceals its next pattern. It cannot randomize controls, cooldowns, player health, or victory conditions; its uncertainty is spatial and bounded.

sequence: Use Box to constrain a route and select Curve to punish it. Chaos has poor precision when its wheel and terrain disagree; recognizing the cycle makes its apparent randomness manageable.

team.text: Glitch may offset one Box cycle by 0.5 seconds, shown on its display. Rainbow colors the board for clearer team calls but grants no additional damage or hidden safe tiles.

name: Circus
identity: Circus chains juggling, trapeze movement, and stage hazards. It differs from Illusion because its props are physical, destructible, and useful even after the deception is understood.

moves.name: Jugglers Comets
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 14 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Throw three clubs on staggered arcs for 30 damage each. Holding the cast delays the third club up to 0.6 seconds. Clubs are visible and stop on solid cover.
moves.p60: Lets the delayed club bounce once off a wall.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the final club separately rather than all three together.

moves.name: Trapeze Escape
moves.desc: Anchor a 100-durability trapeze to visible terrain and swing for up to 2 seconds. Release launches a kick for 75 damage; breaking its anchor drops the caster.
moves.p60: Allows one ally to take a harmless follow-up swing.
moves.counterplay: Shoot the anchor or wait at the landing point.

moves.name: False Bottom
moves.desc: Place two visible 100-durability trapdoors for 6 seconds. Recast swaps the caster between them if both are clear. An enemy crossing either hears a bell and takes 40 damage once.
moves.p60: Leaves a 1-second cardboard double at the departure.
moves.counterplay: Destroy either trapdoor; they never bypass sealed terrain.

moves.name: Ring of Fireworks
moves.desc: Arrange six colored launchers on a 4-metre ring. They fire sequentially inward for 35 damage, capped at four hits per enemy. Each launcher has 35 durability.
moves.p60: Lets the caster reverse the firing order once.
moves.counterplay: Break adjacent launchers to create a safe wedge.

moves.name: The Final Act
moves.desc: Raise a 7-metre stage for 6 seconds. Clubs, trapeze sweeps, and trapdoor jets attack three separately marked sectors for 90 each. Recast chooses the order, not the damage.
moves.counterplay: Read the numbered sector lights and attack the exposed performer.
moves.unstable: Repeats the first sector at half damage, but removes the stage's safe performer platform.

passive.name: Applause
passive.text: Hitting with three different abilities within 6 seconds grants one Encore, maximum two. Spend an Encore to repeat an ordinary prop's utility at half duration, never its damage or an ultimate.

mutation.name: Encore Disaster
mutation.text: Unstable props become neutral after their first activation. The extra performance cannot generate Applause or another Encore, closing a repeat-cast loop.

sequence: Clubs encourage an evade, Trapdoor changes angle, and Fireworks punishes a corner. Circus spends time building a stage; aggressive opponents can destroy props faster than it earns Encore.

team.text: Music may synchronize launcher timing, compressing six shots into three pairs without changing total damage. Fire can ignite a broken prop for 20 damage once; it cannot repeatedly farm Applause.

name: Cloud
identity: Cloud manipulates support surfaces and moisture storage. Mist hides sightlines; Cloud creates conspicuous solid-looking vapor platforms with finite load and durability.

moves.name: Nimbus Disc
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Throw a flat cloud for 65 damage. At its endpoint it becomes a 3-metre platform for 6 seconds. Recasting this skill replaces the oldest disc above the three-Cloud cap.
moves.p60: Lets the disc rise 2 metres after formation.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the platform or fight beneath it.

moves.name: Updraft Lift
moves.desc: A 2-metre column lifts occupants 5 metres over 0.8 seconds. Enemies take 45 damage and may air-steer; allies must jump to accept the lift. The column lasts 2 seconds.
moves.p60: Lets the caster tilt the exit by 20 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Step out before the upward spiral closes.

moves.name: Heavy Weather
moves.desc: Compress one Cloud into a dark weight and drop it after 0.8 seconds for 120 damage in a 3-metre circle. Its destruction consumes the platform and knocks down for 0.5 seconds.
moves.p60: Transfers carried projectiles into harmless rain before dropping.
moves.counterplay: Watch the shadow and clear the impact circle.

moves.name: Cloudbank Bridge
moves.desc: Connect two owned Clouds with a 2-metre-wide vapor bridge for 7 seconds. The bridge has 180 durability and shares the endpoint load limit. Breaking an endpoint breaks the bridge.
moves.p60: Permits one 45-degree bend around visible cover.
moves.counterplay: Attack the exposed endpoints rather than the whole bridge.

moves.name: Kingdom Aloft
moves.desc: Raise three 200-durability platforms around an 8-metre zone for 8 seconds. Each can be ordered to drop once for 100 damage. The caster chooses between preserving movement routes and spending them as attacks.
moves.counterplay: Leave the announced impact areas or destroy platforms early.
moves.unstable: Drops all remaining platforms together for up to 240 damage but removes all aerial support immediately.

passive.name: Condensation
passive.text: Maintain up to three Clouds, each with 120 durability. A Cloud supports two player-equivalent loads. Above that limit it sinks at 2 m/s and dissolves on touching terrain; allies are not immune to collapse.

mutation.name: Thunderhead Collapse
mutation.text: Unstable platforms carry no lightning unless Electric or Storm explicitly charges them. The caster falls normally when support vanishes and cannot cancel landing recovery through Burnout.

sequence: Disc grants height; Lift changes which platform is reachable; Heavy Weather punishes enemies who shelter underneath. Cloud has weak horizontal chase and obvious setup targets.

team.text: Electric may charge one Cloud for a single 50-damage discharge, consuming it. Water extends one Cloud's lifespan by 2 seconds but adds a load, potentially forcing it downward.

name: Copy
identity: Copy samples enemy ordinary abilities, not entire characters. Its identity is adaptation through observation; Duplication makes bodies and Mirror redirects existing events.

moves.name: Mimetic Bolt
moves.desc: Fire a silver bolt for 65 damage. If it hits the blueprint's owner, extend Study Window by 4 seconds. Repeated extensions cannot keep a blueprint beyond 16 seconds from first observation.
moves.p60: Reveals the stored ability's cooldown readiness icon for 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Block the bolt or leave the observation radius.

moves.name: Borrowed Technique
moves.desc: Execute the stored blueprint once at 70% damage, capped at 130, or 70% healing, capped at 90. Control durations are halved. Placeable constructs become one inert 100-durability replica.
moves.p60: Raises the damage or healing multiplier to 85%, retaining caps.
moves.counterplay: Exploit the reduced duration and the original move's normal counter.

moves.name: Selective Memory
moves.statline: CD 16 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Protect the current blueprint for 5 seconds while observing a second. Recast selects one and discards the other. This grants no free cast and cannot keep both after the timer.
moves.p60: Refunds 8 Energy when discarding an unused blueprint.
moves.counterplay: Pressure before a useful second technique becomes available.

moves.name: Original Rebuttal
moves.desc: For 0.7 seconds, intercept the exact technique currently stored. Cancel one ordinary projectile or melee hit and answer with 100 damage. Other abilities ignore the counter; channels are not wholly cancelled.
moves.p60: Grants a fresh blueprint duration after success.
moves.counterplay: Use a different move or delay the stored technique.

moves.name: Perfect Interpretation
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 7 seconds, Borrowed Technique has two charges and uses 100% output within its normal caps. Each observed technique can be cast only once during this ultimate; duplicate Copy sources are invalid.
moves.counterplay: Deny useful casts, break sightlines, and attack during observation.
moves.unstable: Raises the damage cap to 180 but makes every borrowed cast add 15 Heat and locks blueprint replacement afterward.

passive.name: Study Window
passive.text: After observing a visible ordinary cast within 18 metres, store its blueprint for 8 seconds. Only one blueprint exists. Copies inherit geometry and utility but use Copy's fixed budgets; no passive, ultimate, resource engine, or summon spawning is copied.

mutation.name: Identity Overwrite
mutation.text: The unstable state never gains another player's passive or ultimate. On expiry, all blueprints disappear. Recursive Copy, Duplication armies, and borrowed resource refunds are forbidden.

sequence: Study a strong projectile, threaten Rebuttal, then borrow its utility while the owner hesitates. Copy cannot force enemies to reveal the desired tool and has modest damage without a blueprint.

team.text: Illusion decoys cannot supply blueprints. Technology can show a teammate's approved ordinary cast for sampling, but allied copies use 50% output and cannot generate Proxima.

name: Corrupt
identity: Corrupt infects constructs and delayed effects. It does not hack real players or reverse their controls; its takeover is a visible, breakable contest over game objects.

moves.name: Black Patch
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Launch a fractured black shard for 60 damage and one Infection. Against constructs it deals 80 durability damage and applies two stacks. It cannot infect the map's protected structure.
moves.p60: Jumps one Infection to another construct within 3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the shard or keep constructs separated.

moves.name: Fault Injection
moves.desc: Target an infected construct and pause its automatic action for 2 seconds. Player-cast attacks remain available. A turret already firing finishes its current shot before pausing.
moves.p60: Extends the pause to 3 seconds at three stacks.
moves.counterplay: Cleanse the construct or replace it before the cast resolves.

moves.name: Borrowed Ownership
moves.desc: Take over a three-stack ordinary construct for 4 seconds. It keeps current durability, cannot reproduce, and deals at most 100 total damage. Ultimate anchors cannot be stolen.
moves.p60: Lets the caster move the object 2 metres on takeover.
moves.counterplay: Destroy or dismiss the object before takeover completes.

moves.name: Quarantine Ring
moves.desc: Place a 5-metre ring for 5 seconds. Enemy constructs inside cannot receive repairs; enemy players receive 25% weaker new shields. Existing shields are unchanged. Its 140-durability core is exposed.
moves.p60: Cleanses one friendly Infection when an ally enters.
moves.counterplay: Break the core or build outside the ring.

moves.name: System Rot
moves.desc: Pulse a 7-metre area three times over 3 seconds. Each deals 65 damage and one Infection. Three-stack constructs erupt for 70 damage within 2 metres, maximum two eruptions per victim.
moves.counterplay: Spread constructs and leave the initial pulse zone.
moves.unstable: Spreads one extra stack through connected constructs, but also disables the caster's own stolen objects and shield generation for 6 seconds.

passive.name: Infection Ledger
passive.text: Direct hits apply one Infection for 5 seconds, maximum three. On players, each reduces outgoing shield strength by 5%. On constructs, three stacks permit a temporary takeover; owners see the stack count.

mutation.name: Root Corruption
mutation.text: The unstable network cannot cross team boundaries endlessly. Each construct processes one spread event; player bodies never become propagation nodes, preventing a full-team chain from one hit.

sequence: Patch creates takeover pressure; Fault Injection prevents a turret from defending itself; Quarantine blocks repair. Construct-free opponents give Corrupt fewer targets and can win through direct aggression.

team.text: Technology can isolate a node to prevent spread, temporarily disabling its own network bonus. Heal removes one Infection from a friendly construct instead of repairing it on that cast.

name: Cosmic
identity: Cosmic manages relationships between orbiting bodies. Star uses individual stellar shots and Solar uses sustained heat; Cosmic rewards arranging several bodies before an aligned release.

moves.name: Satellite Sling
moves.desc: Launch a mote along its current tangent for 80 damage. The player can rotate the orbital plane before casting but not afterward. It returns harmlessly after hitting its first solid obstacle.
moves.p60: Curves the final 3 metres toward a Constellation-marked target.
moves.counterplay: Move across the tangent rather than away along it.

moves.name: Orbital Shelter
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 20 | H 7 | W 0.35 s | R self
moves.desc: Hold remaining motes at 2-metre radius for 3 seconds. Each intercepts one ordinary projectile and is consumed. Melee, beams, and overhead area strikes pass through.
moves.p60: Restores one mote after a successful interception, once.
moves.counterplay: Use a cheap projectile to remove a mote first.

moves.name: Constellation Stitch
moves.desc: Place two spent motes as 80-durability endpoints for 5 seconds. Their line deals 55 damage on crossing, once per second. A marked target crossing is slowed 25% for 2 seconds.
moves.p60: Bends the line through one third owned mote.
moves.counterplay: Break either endpoint or vault above the 2-metre line.

moves.name: Precession
moves.desc: Rotate the entire local constellation 90 degrees around the caster over 0.6 seconds. Moving lines deal 70 damage once. The caster cannot translate while rotating, making the pivot readable.
moves.p60: Permits choosing clockwise or counterclockwise at the last moment.
moves.counterplay: Attack the stationary pivot or stay outside the line sweep.

moves.name: Astral Alignment
moves.desc: Suspend three 160-durability stars around an 8-metre field. After 2 seconds they fire three intersecting beams for 100 each, maximum 250 per target. Each destroyed star removes its beam.
moves.counterplay: Destroy a star or stand between the announced beam paths.
moves.unstable: Rotates the beam cross once more for 120 additional damage, including against the caster.

passive.name: Three Satellites
passive.text: Three motes orbit at fixed 120-degree intervals. Ordinary skills spend one mote; each returns after 5 seconds. Aligning two motes with an enemy grants a visible Constellation mark for 4 seconds, once per 3 seconds.

mutation.name: Conjunction Failure
mutation.text: The unstable rotation empties all satellites and delays their recovery by 5 seconds. Its spectacle uses a sky overlay only; neither camera controls nor map visibility is removed.

sequence: Stitch creates a boundary, Sling pressures one side, and Precession catches a premature sidestep. Cosmic's power drops sharply when it spends every satellite defensively.

team.text: Gravity bends one Stitch endpoint inward by 2 metres with a visible warning. Light can illuminate its line through Mist, improving readability for both teams without extra damage.

name: Creation
identity: Creation fabricates a small library of useful objects. It cannot invent arbitrary spells mid-match; every permitted object has a known shape, cost, durability, and lifetime.

moves.name: First Brick
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 14 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R 12 m
moves.desc: Create a 100-durability low wall at a clear visible location for 8 seconds. Formation pushes players gently aside and deals no damage; it cannot trap someone inside solid geometry.
moves.p60: Lets the wall unfold into a 3-metre ramp.
moves.counterplay: Break the wall or interrupt its placement preview.

moves.name: Sculptors Mallet
moves.statline: CD 8 s | E 16 | H 7 | W 0.3 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Swing for 85 damage. Hitting an owned construct instead converts 40 durability into a launched chunk dealing 75 damage at 14 metres. This spends real durability, not free ammunition.
moves.p60: Lets the chunk become 40-durability cover on landing.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the chunk or deny access to its source.

moves.name: Revision
moves.desc: Reshape one owned construct without increasing durability: wall to ramp, ramp to platform, or platform to wall. Occupants receive a 0.5-second warning and are displaced to the nearest safe side.
moves.p60: May rotate the result by 90 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Move off the construct before it transforms.

moves.name: Emergency Prototype
moves.desc: Create a 180-point frontal shield for 2 seconds, borrowing unused blueprint durability. When it ends, spent durability remains unavailable for 6 seconds. It cannot be recast through cooldown resets.
moves.p60: Also grants a small standing platform under one airborne ally.
moves.counterplay: Flank it or exploit the temporary budget shortage.

moves.name: Genesis Workshop
moves.desc: Raise budget to 700 for 8 seconds and place three preselected structures within a 7-metre zone. Recast animates one structure as a 180-damage shove, consuming it. Only two shoves are permitted.
moves.counterplay: Destroy structures early or move outside their marked shove lanes.
moves.unstable: Allows a third shove, but all remaining structures crumble simultaneously at expiry.

passive.name: Blueprint Budget
passive.text: Begin with 300 Blueprint reserve. Live construct durability plus unspent reserve cannot exceed 300. Placement spends reserve; after 2 seconds without construction, regenerate 25 per second up to unused capacity. Dismissing an intact object refunds half its remaining durability. Maximum three ordinary objects exist.

mutation.name: Unfinished World
mutation.text: The unstable workshop cannot create living allies, heals, currency, or permanent terrain. Its collapse removes support under the caster as well, so escape planning is part of using it.

sequence: Ramp establishes a firing angle, Mallet spends it for pressure, and Revision closes a flank. Creation loses to opponents who force emergency shielding before its budget can recover.

team.text: Steel reinforces a created wall by 60 durability using the Steel player's resource. Plant may root into a created ramp, but both objects collapse if the supporting blueprint is dismissed.

name: Crystal
identity: Crystal grows durable facets that redirect its own attacks. Glass is fragile and sharp; Crystal trades speed for a persistent network that becomes powerful through angle control.

moves.name: Prism Dart
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Fire a narrow dart for 75 damage. Crossing one friendly crystal redirects it along that facet's displayed arrow. The dart can redirect at most twice and never damages twice on the same pass.
moves.p60: Adds the first crystal's stored energy, capped at 40.
moves.counterplay: Read the facet arrows or destroy the first prism.

moves.name: Amethyst Rise
moves.desc: Grow a 180-durability crystal column after a 0.5-second floor warning. It deals 70 damage and pushes occupants aside. The column remains 8 seconds and can hold one reflected beam.
moves.p60: Permits choosing its facing after placement.
moves.counterplay: Leave the warning circle or use a physical breaker.

moves.name: Facet Turn
moves.desc: Rotate up to two owned crystals by 90 degrees. Their stored hits release as 60-damage rays, consuming the storage. Empty crystals rotate harmlessly; the release has a 0.4-second glint.
moves.p60: Lets one ray split into two 30-damage rays.
moves.counterplay: Avoid the glint direction; splitting preserves total damage.

moves.name: Geode Shell
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 26 | H 10 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Encapsulate the caster in 220-durability crystal for up to 2 seconds. Movement stops. Recast cracks it outward for 80 damage at 3 metres, reduced proportionally to remaining durability.
moves.p60: Leaves one 80-durability facet after release.
moves.counterplay: Wait outside 3 metres or break it from range.

moves.name: Cathedral Refraction
moves.desc: Six 100-durability facets surround a 7-metre field. A beam travels three chosen edges for 90 damage each, maximum 240 per target. Paths preview before every segment and stop at destroyed facets.
moves.counterplay: Break a facet to cut the beam route.
moves.unstable: Runs a second reversed beam for 140 total damage but shatters all facets afterward.

passive.name: Facet Memory
passive.text: Owned crystals store one incoming energy hit worth up to 60 damage, maximum three crystals. Stored light is visible. Physical hits damage them normally; stored energy expires after 6 seconds and cannot be recaptured after release.

mutation.name: Prismatic Fracture
mutation.text: The unstable beam can hit the caster. Crystal shards after collapse are decorative, not hidden damage fields, keeping the final's true danger visible.

sequence: Rise supplies a firing surface, Dart makes its angle threatening, and Turn punishes a new approach. Flanking or destroying one key facet can dismantle the whole planned shot.

team.text: Laser can pass through one friendly facet at 80% damage, sharing its path preview. Sound vibrations remove stored energy before damaging the crystal, denying reflected burst.

name: Dark
tagline: Absence of light and resource suppression
identity: Dark creates opaque energy and extinguishes illuminated objects. Shadow requires cast shadows and positional links; Dark works in bright spaces but cannot teleport between silhouettes.

moves.name: Blackout Spear
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Throw a dense black lance for 80 damage. On hitting a light-emitting construct, remove its reveal effect for 3 seconds. This does not disable the construct's other functions.
moves.p60: Lets the spear pierce one extinguished luminous object.
moves.counterplay: Use ordinary cover or dodge the straight trajectory.

moves.name: Dusk Mantle
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 18 | H 7 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Wrap the caster in a 100-point shield for 4 seconds. While intact, enemy reveal marks expire twice as fast. The caster remains fully visible at ordinary sight distance.
moves.p60: Removes one existing reveal immediately.
moves.counterplay: Break the modest shield; this is not invisibility.

moves.name: Unlit Corridor
moves.desc: Create a 3-by-12-metre opaque lane for 5 seconds. Attacks travel normally through it; entering enemies take 45 damage once and lose target lock through the lane's far wall.
moves.p60: Allows a single right-angle bend.
moves.counterplay: Use manual aim, close-range sight, or go around.

moves.name: Extinguishing Grip
moves.desc: A visible hand closes after 0.6 seconds, dealing 110 damage and reducing Energy regeneration by half for 3 seconds. It drains no current Energy and cannot prevent basic attacks.
moves.p60: Also pauses one luminous construct's reveal pulses for 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the closing hand or cleanse the regeneration debuff.

moves.name: Night Without Stars
moves.desc: A 9-metre dome lasts 6 seconds. Three rings contract for 80 damage each, leaving readable pale outlines. Everyone retains nearby silhouettes and objective markers; outside scenery darkens without turning the screen black.
moves.counterplay: Move through gaps or destroy the 220-durability dome heart.
moves.unstable: Adds a fourth ring but suppresses the caster's own Energy regeneration and removes allied exemption from that ring.

passive.name: Light Hunger
passive.text: Extinguishing an enemy luminous construct or hitting a target recently revealed grants one Gloom, maximum three. Each can reduce one ordinary Dark ability's Energy cost by 5. Repeatedly toggling allied lights grants nothing.

mutation.name: Total Blackout
mutation.text: The unstable ring is a shared hazard. Accessibility settings retain edge outlines and sound alternatives. Darkness never hides essential attack telegraphs, menus, or health information.

sequence: Corridor narrows sightlines, Grip punishes a guessed exit, and Mantle protects the approach. Dark has no inherent answer to physical melee pressure once an opponent gets inside its concealment.

team.text: Light burns a temporary viewing hole through Corridor, shortening it by 1 second. Mist inside Dark keeps close silhouettes visible and adds no second layer of target-lock denial.

name: Death
tagline: Attrition marks and a contestable execution
identity: Death punishes accumulated mistakes. It has a conditional finisher, not a universal instant kill, and cannot bypass shields or protected spawn states.

moves.name: Pale Crescent
moves.desc: Sweep a sickle-shaped projectile for 75 damage. It travels 18 m/s and curves once toward the aim point, not toward a moving target. Terrain stops it.
moves.p60: Extends Omen duration by 2 seconds on hit.
moves.counterplay: Evade inward beneath its outer arc.

moves.name: Grave Step
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 18 | H 7 | W 0.3 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: Place a visible grave seal and slide 6 metres away. Recast within 3 seconds returns to it if unoccupied. The 70-durability seal can be destroyed; neither travel deals damage.
moves.p60: Grants a 60-point shield on successful return.
moves.counterplay: Destroy or camp the return seal.

moves.name: Last Toll
moves.desc: Ring a bell around one marked enemy. After 1 second, deal 35 damage per Omen and consume them. The target can cleanse Omens before the toll; damage is fixed at resolution.
moves.p60: Slows the target 20% during the warning.
moves.counterplay: Cleanse or interrupt the bell channel.

moves.name: Borrowed Breath
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: For 3 seconds, defer up to 120 incoming health damage as a visible debt. Half the deferred amount returns over 4 seconds afterward; the other half is prevented. Shields resolve first.
moves.p60: Lets Last Toll repay up to 40 of the debt.
moves.counterplay: Keep pressure through the repayment window.

moves.name: Reapers Hearing
moves.desc: Mark one four-Omen target for 2 seconds, then strike for 260 damage. If they remain below 15% maximum health after damage, deal a further 150. Leaving range or sight breaks the hearing.
moves.counterplay: Heal above threshold, shield, or break sight.
moves.unstable: Raises the threshold to 20%, but a broken hearing deals 150 backlash to the caster.

passive.name: Mortal Ledger
passive.text: Ordinary direct hits add one Omen for 7 seconds, maximum four, once per cast. Healing above 70% health removes one. Omens are visible to their owner and disappear on elimination; they do not cross lives.

mutation.name: Final Appointment
mutation.text: The execution bonus remains ordinary damage and can be shielded. Bosses receive only the main hit. Unstable backlash cannot trigger Borrowed Breath or generate Omens.

sequence: Preserve Omens for Hearing or cash them through Toll, never both. Cleanse and consistent healing dismantle the ledger; Death has limited damage when repeatedly forced to restart.

team.text: Heal removes one Omen through a dedicated cleanse. Time can delay the hearing's strike by 0.5 seconds, also extending the defender's escape opportunity.

name: Defensive
identity: Defensive specializes in facing, guard timing, and protecting locations. It cannot turn infinite blocked damage into damage output or hold every direction at once.

moves.name: Shield Check
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.2 s | R 3 m
moves.desc: Bash for 65 damage and push 2 metres. Hitting during an enemy's windup adds 25 Guard damage but no additional stun. Missing exposes 0.35 seconds of recovery.
moves.p60: Can move the caster 1 metre with a confirmed push.
moves.counterplay: Bait the short reach and counter from the side.

moves.name: Bulwark Panel
moves.desc: Place a 260-durability shield panel for 5 seconds. It blocks attacks from one face; its rear is open. Allies can pass through, but cannot shoot through its protected face.
moves.p60: Allows rotating it once by 90 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Flank or pressure the panel's exposed rear.

moves.name: Intercept Line
moves.desc: Dash toward a visible ally, intercepting the first ordinary projectile crossed. Gain a 100-point shield for 2 seconds. It does not cancel beams or area impacts.
moves.p60: Transfers the shield to the ally on arrival.
moves.counterplay: Use staggered attacks after the first interception.

moves.name: Hold the Gate
moves.desc: Anchor for 4 seconds with 40% frontal damage reduction. A 5-metre cone prevents hostile dashes from crossing once per enemy, slowing them instead; walking through remains possible.
moves.p60: Refunds one Resolve when a dash is stopped.
moves.counterplay: Walk around, attack from behind, or force displacement.

moves.name: Citadel Stance
moves.desc: Raise four 220-durability panels for 7 seconds. Recast folds surviving panels inward as an allied shield, 60 per panel, maximum 180. It causes no offensive explosion.
moves.counterplay: Destroy panels before conversion or isolate the caster afterward.
moves.unstable: Doubles shield conversion but roots the caster for 2 seconds after folding and consumes all Guard.

passive.name: Bastion Rhythm
passive.text: A perfect guard within 0.2 seconds of impact restores 12 Guard and earns one Resolve, maximum three. The next Defensive skill consumes one Resolve for 20 shield. Area damage and self-hits grant none.

mutation.name: Unyielding Debt
mutation.text: The unstable shield cannot stack with itself, refill Guard, or count as prevented damage for Resolve. Taking the larger team save means accepting an exposed personal recovery.

sequence: Panel blocks one lane while Intercept covers another. Defensive struggles against grabs, ground hazards, and coordinated flanks; its own damage is deliberately modest.

team.text: Angel may extend one panel's height without adding durability. Rock supplies rear cover, but also obstructs the Defender's retreat and cannot create a sealed invulnerable bunker.

name: Demon
identity: Demon creates visible contracts that reward aggression and punish retreat. Its costs use health debt and exposed recovery, not arbitrary possession or loss of player control.

moves.name: Hellbrand Claw
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 6 | W 0.25 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Slash for 85 damage and place a brand for 4 seconds. The next Demon hit consumes it for 25 additional damage, once per target per 2 seconds.
moves.p60: Lets the brand reveal the target at close range.
moves.counterplay: Create distance before the follow-up.

moves.name: Debt Collector
moves.desc: A chain hand travels 16 m/s. Hit for 60 and pull a branded target 3 metres; unbranded targets move 1 metre. Solid cover blocks the hand.
moves.p60: Moves the caster toward an anchored target instead.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the hand after its chain becomes visible.

moves.name: Devils Shelter
moves.statline: CD 18 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Gain a 160-point shield for 3 seconds. On expiry, 25% of absorbed damage becomes health debt. The shield cannot pay existing debt and does not block debt repayment damage.
moves.p60: Lets one nearby ally share half the shield.
moves.counterplay: Pressure after expiry rather than feeding shield value.

moves.name: Hellgate
moves.desc: Open a 120-durability gate for 5 seconds. It fires three 45-damage bolts at manually marked visible targets. Each bolt needs a fresh recast; it never auto-fires through cover.
moves.p60: Lets the caster step through to its location once.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the gate before its later shots.

moves.name: Pandemonium Contract
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.3 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 7 seconds, ordinary hits deal 20% extra damage and repay debt twice as fast. The caster loses passive Energy regeneration and gains no free cooldown resets.
moves.counterplay: Disengage, shield health damage, and force the debt to mature.
moves.unstable: Raises the bonus to 35%, but all unpaid debt doubles at expiry, capped at 240 health damage.

passive.name: Infernal Credit
passive.text: Ordinary casts may borrow 10 Energy, maximum 30 debt. Each borrowed point becomes 2 health damage after 6 seconds unless repaid by dealing 4 health damage. Shields and summons do not repay debt.

mutation.name: Archdemon Default
mutation.text: Contract damage cannot be used to repay the same contract. Debt is capped and shown as a health-bar overlay; it can defeat the caster but never silently change its due time.

sequence: Brand sets up Collector, Gate closes a retreat, then the contract rewards confirmed pressure. Patient shield users deny debt repayment and can win without chasing.

team.text: Blood lifesteal may restore health after debt is paid but cannot cancel the debt event. Light exposes Hellgate's full outline through concealment, making the investment easier to punish.

name: Destruction
identity: Destruction removes durability and stability. It has powerful object damage but limited sustain; breaking empty terrain cannot farm unlimited combat resources.

moves.name: Ruin Knuckle
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 14 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Punch for 95 damage, or 180 against construct durability. A short ground crack extends 2 metres beyond the hit but deals only 30 damage to additional targets.
moves.p60: Can break one 60-durability debris obstacle before hitting.
moves.counterplay: Backstep the fist; the crack is weaker.

moves.name: Demolition Line
moves.desc: Mark a 2-metre-wide line, then detonate it after 0.7 seconds for 130 damage. Each construct intersected loses 150 durability. The line cannot travel through protected map cores.
moves.p60: Extends it 4 metres if it breaks a construct.
moves.counterplay: Leave the marked line before detonation.

moves.name: Shatterguard
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: For 0.6 seconds, catch a physical melee hit and destroy 80 durability from its summoned weapon, if any. Return 70 damage. Energy, grabs, and ultimates bypass the catch.
moves.p60: Applies one Stress to the attacker's nearby construct.
moves.counterplay: Use a different attack class or delay contact.

moves.name: Collapse Point
moves.desc: Brand one breakable structure for 4 seconds. On destruction, it collapses toward the chosen side for 140 damage within a 4-metre wedge. Dismissing it triggers a harmless collapse instead.
moves.p60: Allows changing the collapse direction once before destruction.
moves.counterplay: Move to the safe side or dismiss an owned structure.

moves.name: Nothing Remains
moves.desc: A 9-metre zone cracks in three rings for 90 damage each. Cover loses 200 durability per ring. The center remains safe until the final ring, and every boundary previews for 0.6 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Follow the ring sequence or interrupt the long startup.
moves.unstable: Erases remaining ordinary constructs in the zone, but the final ring also hits the caster for 180.

passive.name: Fracture Stress
passive.text: Direct hits add Stress to nonliving objects. At three stacks, the next Destruction hit deals 100 extra durability damage. Players instead receive a visible 5% damage vulnerability for 2 seconds, never stacking above one.

mutation.name: Total Ruin
mutation.text: Protected map geometry, objectives, and respawn floors survive. Erased constructs yield no refunds, debris procs, or copied explosions; their destruction cannot recursively damage the whole arena.

sequence: Collapse Point turns an enemy bunker into a liability; Line forces the exit; Knuckle finishes at close range. Open terrain and mobile opponents deny valuable structural targets.

team.text: Creation can provide a disposable collapse object, but its maker loses the invested budget. Rock rubble widens a collapse wedge by 1 metre without adding another damage packet.

name: Dragon
tagline: Heavy aerial pressure and breath management
identity: Dragon combines a vulnerable airborne body with charged breath. Unlike Fly, its movement is ponderous; unlike Fire, its main threat is a large frontal commitment.

moves.name: Scale Lance
moves.desc: Fire a sharp scale for 80 damage. It lodges in a shield or construct for 4 seconds; the next Dragon breath hitting it bursts for 35 damage within 2 metres.
moves.p60: Lets the scale pierce 50-durability cover.
moves.counterplay: Remove the lodged scale with a basic hit.

moves.name: Wingbeat Ascent
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 18 | H 8 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend 20 Breath to rise 5 metres and hover for 3 seconds. Takeoff deals 60 damage in a 3-metre circle. Hovering allows slow lateral steering but no dodge invulnerability.
moves.p60: Permits one 3-metre lateral wingbeat during hover.
moves.counterplay: Attack the large airborne silhouette from the side.

moves.name: Furnace Breath
moves.desc: Spend 40 Breath to channel a cone for 1.5 seconds, dealing five 25-damage ticks. Turning is capped at 35 degrees per second; cover blocks the cone.
moves.p60: Can sweep the cone 15 degrees wider.
moves.counterplay: Flank during the channel or retreat behind cover.

moves.name: Tail Tribunal
moves.desc: Sweep a heavy tail behind and around the caster for 115 damage and 3-metre knockback. It protects the rear but leaves the narrow forward sector untouched.
moves.p60: Cracks breakable walls struck by displaced enemies for 40 bonus damage.
moves.counterplay: Stay near the forward shoulder rather than directly behind.

moves.name: Elder Descent
moves.desc: Rise along a visible path, then dive into a 5-metre circle for 220 damage. Three breath fissures extend outward for 40 each, capped at two per target. The landing point locks 0.8 seconds early.
moves.counterplay: Evade the locked circle and punish the grounded dragon.
moves.unstable: Adds a second breath sweep for 120 damage but empties Breath and removes flight for 8 seconds.

passive.name: Breath Reservoir
passive.text: Store 100 Breath. Grounded movement restores 12 per second; airborne movement restores none. Breath skills spend their stated amount. At zero Breath, wings fold and the caster lands without additional stun.

mutation.name: World Serpent
mutation.text: The unstable form changes scale visually without enlarging its damaging hitbox beyond marked zones. Anti-air interrupts before the dive still cancel the attack under standard ultimate refund rules.

sequence: Scale marks cover, Ascent changes the cone angle, and Tail punishes reckless flanks. Dragon must land to refill Breath; sustained anti-air pressure controls its cycle.

team.text: Wind extends hover by 1 second but does not restore Breath. Lava fissures can continue a breath lane at 20 damage per second, replacing rather than stacking existing ground damage.

name: Dream
identity: Dream fabricates fragile objects inside visible dream fields. It does not put players into long unplayable sleep or claim that anything imagined becomes mechanically possible.

moves.name: Sleepwalking Star
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: A slow pastel star deals 65 damage and applies Drowsy for 3 seconds, reducing turn-independent running speed by 15%. A second star refreshes duration, never causes sleep.
moves.p60: Makes the star split around one owned dream object.
moves.counterplay: Break the object or sidestep the slow projectile.

moves.name: Imaginary Stair
moves.desc: Spend one Lucid token to create a 100-durability staircase for 5 seconds. Without a token it is an obvious translucent decoy. Its maximum rise is 4 metres.
moves.p60: Allows folding the staircase into a short bridge.
moves.counterplay: Destroy its base or attack before it solidifies.

moves.name: Soft Landing
moves.desc: Place a pillow-like field for 3 seconds. It halves the next knockback or fall recovery for each ally entering and grants 60 shield. Enemies receive no effect.
moves.p60: Lets an ally choose a 3-metre rebound by jumping.
moves.counterplay: Wait out its brief protection or attack from outside.

moves.name: Lucid Monster
moves.desc: Spend two tokens to animate a 160-health dream beast for 5 seconds. It follows one straight commanded path, biting once for 130 damage. It cannot chase independently or reproduce.
moves.p60: Permits one 45-degree turn at a marked waypoint.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the fragile beast or leave its route.

moves.name: A World Before Waking
moves.desc: Create an 8-metre dream field for 7 seconds with three solid objects: stair, beast, and shelter. Each has 140 durability. Recast swaps one object's role, retaining its remaining durability.
moves.counterplay: Break supporting objects or disengage until the dream ends.
moves.unstable: Doubles object count but all vanish after 4 seconds, including platforms supporting the caster.

passive.name: Lucid Tokens
passive.text: Begin with two Lucid tokens, maximum four. Successfully using three different normal Dream skills grants two more; a damaging hit, solid object placement, or consumed Soft Landing protection qualifies. Tokens solidify dream objects; without tokens, those objects are visible decoys with no collision or damage.

mutation.name: Lucid Collapse
mutation.text: Dream objects cannot become real loot, permanent terrain, or additional players. Unstable collapse removes support but causes no hidden explosion; its danger comes from exposed positioning.

sequence: Star slows a route, Stair supplies elevation, and Monster attacks a predictable lane. Token starvation prevents instant construction; fast destroyers can dismantle the dream economy.

team.text: Nightmare can frighten a dream beast, reversing its command path after a warning. Life heals dream objects at half value but cannot keep them beyond their expiry.

name: Duplication
identity: Duplication creates copies of its own body and commands. It never borrows another element, duplicates inventory, or multiplies the player's full health pool.

moves.name: Split Entry
moves.statline: CD 8 s | E 14 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R 6 m
moves.desc: Create one double 3 metres to either side and deliver a 70-damage strike from the real body. The double does not repeat this ability and counts against the two-double cap.
moves.p60: Lets the player choose the double's initial facing.
moves.counterplay: Use the delayed movement tell to identify the real body.

moves.name: Twin Relay
moves.desc: Swap with a visible double after a 0.35-second connecting flash. Both destinations must be clear. The swap preserves health and debuffs on their original owners, not their locations.
moves.p60: Grants the double a 60-point shield after swapping.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the destination double or trap the arrival.

moves.name: Echo Formation
moves.desc: Order doubles into a triangular formation for 4 seconds. Each blocks one ordinary projectile before losing 60 health. They cannot attack while intercepting; the triangle is not an invisible wall.
moves.p60: Allows the formation to follow at walking speed.
moves.counterplay: Use area damage or attack through an open side.

moves.name: Synchronized Strike
moves.desc: The caster and all doubles lunge toward three separately chosen visible points. Real hit deals 90; doubles deal 45 each. A single victim takes at most 150 total damage.
moves.p60: Delays one double's lunge by 0.4 seconds.
