moves.counterplay: Dodge the stagger and punish the isolated real endpoint.

moves.name: Assembly of One
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.2 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: Raise the double cap to five for 7 seconds, each at 120 health. Basic attacks remain capped at 75 total double damage per second against one target. Relay gains one extra charge.
moves.counterplay: Use sweeping attacks and deny safe Relay destinations.
moves.unstable: Allows simultaneous Strike from all bodies, capped at 240 damage, then destroys every double.

passive.name: Shared Attention
passive.text: Maintain two ordinary doubles with 150 health each. They copy movement with a 0.3-second delay and use a basic 25-damage strike at most once per second. Only the real body generates Proxima.

mutation.name: Multiplicity Crash
mutation.text: All copies share one command stream and cannot cast ultimates, generate further copies, capture extra objective weight, or trigger ally-count bonuses. Unstable expiry exposes the real body unmistakably.

sequence: Entry establishes ambiguity, Relay changes angles, and Strike punishes narrow evasion. Area attacks efficiently erase doubles; careful observers can follow the real body's immediate movement.

team.text: Love may bond to the real body only. Mirror can redirect a double's basic projectile but cannot reflect its creation into another copy.

name: Earth
identity: Earth moves the floor itself within protected arena limits. Rock launches discrete masses; Earth creates ramps, ridges, and fault boundaries that influence both teams.

moves.name: Fault Jab
moves.desc: A narrow ridge travels along connected ground at 18 m/s for 80 damage. It stops at gaps wider than 1 metre and rises only 2 metres up slopes.
moves.p60: Lets it turn once at an owned Earth ridge.
moves.counterplay: Jump or cross a disconnected surface.

moves.name: Rampart Rise
moves.desc: Raise a 240-durability, 4-metre wall after a floor warning. It lasts 8 seconds and pushes occupants to a clear side without damage. Protected doors and spawn exits cannot be sealed.
moves.p60: Permits a sloped ramp face on one side.
moves.counterplay: Break the wall or attack around its finite width.

moves.name: Burrow Lane
moves.desc: Travel beneath connected ground for 1 second, emerging 8 metres away for 75 damage in 2 metres. A moving mound reveals the route; ground-targeted attacks still connect.
moves.p60: Allows emerging early on recast.
moves.counterplay: Strike the mound or guard its endpoint.

moves.name: Seismic Fold
moves.desc: Fold two 3-metre ground strips inward for 130 damage and 0.6-second knockdown. The central safe seam remains visible. Afterward both strips settle as low ridges for 5 seconds.
moves.p60: Lets the safe seam be angled before commitment.
moves.counterplay: Stand in the seam or move airborne before closure.

moves.name: Continental Verdict
moves.desc: A 9-metre area rises in four announced terraces over 4 seconds. Each uplift deals 75 damage once, capped at 250 per target. Ramps remain for 8 seconds instead of permanently deforming the map.
moves.counterplay: Climb safe ramps or leave the affected footprint.
moves.unstable: Drops every terrace simultaneously for 140 damage, including beneath the caster.

passive.name: Ground Sense
passive.text: While grounded and stationary for 0.6 seconds, see footsteps as rings within 8 metres for 2 seconds. Airborne or motionless enemies remain hidden. Casting ends the sensing stance immediately.

mutation.name: Tectonic Recoil
mutation.text: The unstable drop preserves a safe recovery floor below. It never opens instant-death holes under unavoidable spawn routes; the caster can still be punished on landing.

sequence: Rampart divides sightlines, Fault checks the exit, and Fold punishes grounded defenders. Flight and disconnected platforms bypass much of Earth's control but remain vulnerable on landing.

team.text: Water fills Earth channels as 15% slowing streams without damage. Plant roots reinforce a wall by 50 durability but disappear when that wall settles.

name: Eater
identity: Eater turns a caught attack into a bounded resource. It cannot eat player bodies, whole ultimates, protected terrain, or another player's entire ability kit.

moves.name: Snap Bite
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.25 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Bite for 80 damage. Against a construct below 80 remaining durability, consume it and gain one Meal instead. Stronger objects take normal damage and are not instantly removed.
moves.p60: Extends the consumption threshold to 110 durability.
moves.counterplay: Keep weak constructs out of bite range.

moves.name: Vacuum Maw
moves.desc: Open a cone for 1 second, consuming at most two ordinary projectiles. Beams, melee, ground waves, and ultimates pass normally. The caster moves at half speed and cannot guard.
moves.p60: Pulls one loose neutral pickup inward, without stealing ownership.
moves.counterplay: Use an excluded attack type or flank the maw.

moves.name: Spitback
moves.desc: Spend one Meal to fire a compact glob for 110 damage, regardless of the eaten attack. Without a Meal, deal 45. The glob has no inherited special effects or summons.
moves.p60: Lets the glob ricochet once at 80 damage.
moves.counterplay: Dodge its visible straight line.

moves.name: Comfort Food
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 20 | H 6 | W 0.9 s | R self
moves.desc: Digest up to two Meals, healing 55 per Meal over 3 seconds. Taking direct damage pauses healing for 0.5 seconds but does not extend total duration; interrupted ticks are lost.
moves.p60: Clears one slow when digestion begins.
moves.counterplay: Pressure during digestion to deny ticks.

moves.name: Bottomless Banquet
moves.desc: For 5 seconds, the maw consumes up to six projectiles and two small constructs. Recast releases a 5-metre blast for 100 plus 25 per item, capped at 300. The caster cannot use other abilities while eating.
moves.counterplay: Stop feeding it and attack through melee or terrain effects.
moves.unstable: Raises the cap to 360 but forces release after 5 seconds and deals 80 backlash if fewer than three items were consumed.

passive.name: Stomach Capacity
passive.text: Store three Meals, each representing one consumed ordinary projectile or small construct. Meals expire after 10 seconds. A consumed object's damage does not determine healing; every Meal has a fixed value.

mutation.name: Indigestion
mutation.text: The unstable banquet empties Meals and locks healing for 4 seconds. Friendly projectiles can be consumed for defense but contribute no ultimate damage or Meals.

sequence: Maw punishes predictable projectile pressure; Spitback forces movement; Bite threatens weakened cover. Against melee and beams, Eater must create distance without its defining defense.

team.text: Candy constructs count as ordinary Meals, never bonus healing. Poison projectiles are neutralized on consumption, but Poison clouds and ground pools cannot be eaten.

name: Elasticity
identity: Elasticity stretches a connected body and redirects momentum. Slime changes mass and flow; Elasticity retains a visible tether to its original position throughout extended attacks.

moves.name: Rubber Knuckle
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: Extend a fist for 85 damage, then retract along the same line. Spending 20 Tension adds 3 metres. During extension the arm's visible line can be struck to deal 40 damage to the caster.
moves.p60: Permits one angled rebound off terrain.
moves.counterplay: Hit the stretched arm or evade the return lane.

moves.name: Slingshot Anchor
moves.desc: Grip a surface and pull backward up to 4 metres, then release along a locked line for 100 collision damage. The anchor has 100 durability; breaking it cancels propulsion.
moves.p60: Lets the player release early without extra recovery.
moves.counterplay: Break the anchor or step off the locked line.

moves.name: Rebound Guard
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 22 | H 7 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: For 0.7 seconds, reduce one physical hit by 50% and store its knockback as 30 Tension. Return a 70-damage shove at 3 metres. Sharp piercing attacks bypass the reduction.
moves.p60: Allows directing the shove sideways.
moves.counterplay: Use piercing pressure or delay until the stance ends.

moves.name: Springboard Skin
moves.desc: Place a 140-durability elastic mat for 6 seconds. Jumping allies choose a 6-metre launch; enemies crossing its center are bounced 2 metres after a visible compression, once per 2 seconds.
moves.p60: Allows rotating the launch arrow once.
moves.counterplay: Walk around the center or destroy the mat.

moves.name: World Snapback
moves.desc: Attach four elastic anchors in a 7-metre area. After 2 seconds, surviving anchors pull inward for 50 damage each and a final 100-damage impact. Each 90-durability anchor controls one quadrant.
moves.counterplay: Break an anchor to open a safe quadrant.
moves.unstable: Doubles pull distance but also pulls the caster and destroys all friendly mats.

passive.name: Tension Bank
passive.text: Absorbing knockback while guarding stores up to 100 Tension. Running down after knockback stores none. Ordinary attacks may spend Tension for extra reach, not damage; the bank decays 10 per second out of combat.

mutation.name: Maximum Extension
mutation.text: The unstable snap can reposition its caster into the enemy team. It never pulls through intact walls; blocked tethers break rather than clipping bodies through geometry.

sequence: Mat creates predictable airborne movement for Knuckle; Anchor supplies a committed finish. Piercing attacks and destructible-anchor denial limit Elasticity's defensive recycling.

team.text: Size changes the mat's load: a giant breaks it after one launch. Ice stiffens an elastic anchor, halving its pull distance while granting 40 durability.

name: Electric
identity: Electric routes current between prepared targets. Its chains are bounded by visible links; wet terrain extends routing but never electrocutes an entire map automatically.

moves.name: Arc Needle
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 5 | W 0.2 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Fire a narrow 70-damage arc. It jumps once to a charged enemy within 4 metres for 30 damage, never returning to the first target. Solid cover breaks the jump.
moves.p60: Extends the jump by 2 metres.
moves.counterplay: Separate from charged teammates.

moves.name: Flash Ground
moves.desc: Dash along the floor for 7 metres, leaving a 2-second conductive line. Crossing enemies take 40 damage once. The dash has no invulnerability and stops on cover.
moves.p60: Consumes a Charge at the endpoint for a 60-point shield.
moves.counterplay: Place ground hazards along the announced dash.

moves.name: Lightning Rod
moves.desc: Place a 140-durability rod for 6 seconds. One incoming Electric projectile can route through it toward a visible target, changing direction but preserving damage and its existing jump limit.
moves.p60: Lets the caster relocate the rod 2 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the rod or break its exit sightline.

moves.name: Short Circuit
moves.desc: Detonate Charges on one target for 45 damage each and a 0.2-second interrupt. Nearby charges do not detonate automatically. No Charges means a weak 30-damage spark.
moves.p60: Also pauses one nearby automated construct for 1 second.
moves.counterplay: Cleanse Charge or force an early discharge.

moves.name: Heavens Circuit
moves.desc: Three rods mark an 8-metre triangle. Current travels its edges three times for 70 damage per crossing, capped at 280 per victim. Each rod has 160 durability and a clear destruction tell.
moves.counterplay: Break one rod and escape through the open edge.
moves.unstable: Fills the center with a 120-damage pulse, also striking the caster, then destroys every rod.

passive.name: Potential Difference
passive.text: Direct hits apply Charge for 5 seconds, maximum three. At three, the next Electric hit consumes them for 40 bonus damage. A target discharged this way cannot gain Charge for 1 second.

mutation.name: Ball Lightning
mutation.text: The unstable center is a single event, not an infinite chain. Wet targets gain longer links, never an additional damage multiplier; one cast's target caps remain enforced.

sequence: Needle charges, Rod bends an approach, and Circuit cashes out committed positioning. Insulating cover and separated formations deny Electric's efficient multi-target exchanges.

team.text: Water extends a conductive link by 2 metres. Steel can redirect a link through a weapon, consuming 40 weapon durability and retaining the one-jump cap.

name: Energy
identity: Energy controls a neutral power reserve. Unlike Electric, it does not conduct or stun; its choices are whether to store, shield, or spend output immediately.

moves.name: Kinetic Pellet
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 4 | W 0.2 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Fire a compact green sphere for 65 damage. Holding 0.5 seconds spends 20 Cell to deal 100 and push 1 metre. The charged sphere travels more slowly.
moves.p60: Lets a charged pellet pierce one weak projectile.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the slower charged shot.

moves.name: Capacitor Shell
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Convert up to 40 Cell into a shield at three points per Cell, lasting 4 seconds. Remaining shield returns half its original Cell value on expiry; broken shield returns nothing.
moves.p60: Allows sharing half the shield with one nearby ally.
moves.counterplay: Pressure the shield until it breaks.

moves.name: Vector Vent
moves.statline: CD 15 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: Spend 15 Cell for a 6-metre directional burst and 70 damage behind the caster. With insufficient Cell, travel only 3 metres and deal 35. It cannot cancel hard control.
moves.p60: Removes 10 Heat if the rear blast hits an enemy.
moves.counterplay: Attack from the destination rather than the exhaust side.

moves.name: Overcharge Relay
moves.desc: Place a 120-durability cell for 5 seconds and deposit up to 30 Cell. An ally may collect it for up to 20 Energy; the caster may detonate it for 60 plus deposited Cell damage.
moves.p60: Lets the relay shield its collector for 40.
moves.counterplay: Destroy or deny the visible relay.

moves.name: Total Discharge
moves.desc: Channel a beam for 2 seconds, dealing four 50-damage ticks plus up to 100 stored Cell divided among them. Turning is limited to 20 degrees per second and cover blocks each tick.
moves.counterplay: Break sightline, flank the channel, then punish the empty reserve.
moves.unstable: Adds a final 120-damage pulse but empties Energy and disables regeneration for 3 seconds.

passive.name: Reserve Cell
passive.text: Store 0 to 100 Cell. Every 10 unused Energy regenerated adds 5 Cell, capped at 15 Cell per 5 seconds. Damage to enemies never generates Cell directly, preventing a damage-feedback loop.

mutation.name: Critical Capacity
mutation.text: The unstable pulse cannot refill Cell. Shielding and support are lost during its dry recovery, so choosing the final is a genuine commitment of every energy reserve.

sequence: Pellet checks pressure while Shell protects saved Cell; Relay trades offense for ally recovery. Energy is weakest when forced to defend before the reserve fills.

team.text: Engine may consume a relay for 20 Torque instead of Energy. Plasma can charge it by 10 Cell once, but adds 10 Heat to the Energy user.

name: Engine
identity: Engine converts sustained forward motion into Torque. Agility turns quickly; Engine accelerates powerfully but must plan braking, heat, and collision angles.

moves.name: Piston Jab
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 5 | W 0.2 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Strike for 75 damage. Spend 15 Torque to add a second 30-damage piston hit after 0.25 seconds. The follow-up is blockable and does not repeat the first hit's control.
moves.p60: Preserves one gear during the jab.
moves.counterplay: Parry the follow-up or sidestep its narrow axis.

moves.name: Turbo Lane
moves.desc: Spend 25 Torque to charge 12 metres, dealing 115 damage once. Steering is limited to 15 degrees. A wall collision stops the user and causes 0.7 seconds of recovery.
moves.p60: Lets a hit break through 100-durability cover.
moves.counterplay: Bait the charge toward a sturdy wall.

moves.name: Emergency Brake
moves.statline: CD 15 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.15 s | R self
moves.desc: Stop instantly and spray a rear exhaust cone for 60 damage and 2-metre push. Lose all gears but remove 15 Heat. Braking during Turbo halves its remaining travel.
moves.p60: Creates a 1-second 20% slowing exhaust patch.
moves.counterplay: Approach from the front during gear loss.

moves.name: Flywheel Bank
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 24 | H 10 | W 0.7 s | R self
moves.desc: Store up to 50 Torque for 5 seconds. The next Piston or Turbo consumes it for up to 50 bonus damage. Being interrupted during storage drops half the bank as unusable sparks.
moves.p60: Allows retaining one gear while charging.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the visible spinning flywheel.

moves.name: Redline Express
moves.desc: Lock a two-segment driving route. Charge both segments for 140 damage each, maximum 250 per target. Between segments, a 0.5-second brake permits one 45-degree direction adjustment.
moves.counterplay: Predict the route and force the runaway endpoint into cover.
moves.unstable: Adds a third segment but removes the final brake; collision causes 120 self-damage and Burnout.

passive.name: Three Gears
passive.text: Moving forward for 1.5 seconds advances a gear, maximum three. Turning over 90 degrees or stopping drops one gear. Each gear adds 4% speed and generates 5 Torque per second, maximum 100.

mutation.name: Runaway Engine
mutation.text: The unstable route cannot be cancelled into invulnerability. Torque does not refill from wall damage or friendly collisions; speed bonuses remain within the universal movement cap.

sequence: Accelerate on a safe lane, bank Torque, then Turbo through a committed enemy. Tight corners, roots, and sturdy obstacles make Engine's speed a liability.

team.text: Wind lanes grant one gear on entry, once per lane. Ice increases Turbo travel by 2 metres but doubles braking distance, affecting both benefit and danger.

name: Explosion
identity: Explosion separates arming, triggering, and displacement. Fire burns over time; Explosion spends finite charges for readable bursts and terrain demolition.

moves.name: Pop Charge
moves.desc: Throw a sticky 40-durability charge. Recast detonates for 85 damage within 2.5 metres. It sticks to terrain and shields, not directly to player skin; impact itself deals no damage.
moves.p60: Increases the blast's outward push by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Destroy or move away from the visible charge.

moves.name: Blast Hop
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 18 | H 8 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: Detonate a small floor blast for 55 damage and launch 5 metres upward. The caster takes no damage from this specific blast but remains vulnerable during ascent.
moves.p60: Lets the player angle the launch 30 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Attack the predictable airborne path.

moves.name: Shaped Breach
moves.desc: Place a directional cone charge for 6 seconds. It deals 140 health damage or 260 durability damage on detonation, but only inside its marked 60-degree cone.
moves.p60: Lets the caster rotate the cone once before arming.
moves.counterplay: Approach from its rear or destroy the 60-durability housing.

moves.name: Delayed Sympathy
moves.desc: Link two owned charges. Triggering one detonates the other 0.7 seconds later with its usual damage. Each charge can belong to one link; linked blasts cannot create further links.
moves.p60: Allows cancelling the second detonation during its warning.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the second blast separately after the first cue.

moves.name: Demolition Symphony
moves.desc: Place six 70-durability charges around an 8-metre circle. Trigger three chosen pairs over 4 seconds for 80 each, capped at 300 per enemy. Each blast shows its radius before firing.
moves.counterplay: Destroy charges or exit before the synchronized flash.
moves.unstable: Detonates all surviving charges together for up to 360 damage but gives the caster no blast immunity.

passive.name: Fuse Discipline
passive.text: Maintain three ordinary charges. A charge arms after 0.6 seconds and expires after 8. Detonating at least 1 second after arming refunds 5 Energy; chain-detonated charges grant no refund.

mutation.name: Sympathetic Failure
mutation.text: The unstable blast cannot trigger ordinary charges recursively. Detached rubble is visual after its initial collision; it does not generate hundreds of damage events.

sequence: Pop controls retreat, Hop changes approach height, and Breach punishes cover. Enemies who destroy charges before arming deny both damage and Fuse refunds.

team.text: Fire shortens a charge's remaining fuse by 0.3 seconds, with a visible warning. Water prevents arming for 1 second but never permanently disables all explosives.

name: Fairy
identity: Fairy uses short-lived sprites to alter small interactions. It differs from Angel's direct protection and Witch's ritual curses by offering visible choices and fragile helpers.

moves.name: Pixie Sting
moves.desc: Send a sprite on a looping approach for 60 damage. It circles its target once for 0.6 seconds before striking, revealing the victim only while in actual sight.
moves.p60: Lets the sprite feint one strike before committing.
moves.counterplay: Strike the fragile sprite during its circle.

moves.name: Borrowed Wings
moves.desc: Assign a sprite to an ally for 4 seconds, granting one optional double jump and 10% air steering. The sprite detaches after use. It provides neither permanent flight nor an extra dodge.
moves.p60: Adds a 50-point shield on the double jump.
moves.counterplay: Attack the sprite before the jump is used.

moves.name: Faerie Bargain
moves.desc: Place a visible fruit for 5 seconds. An ally collects 60 healing; an enemy may destroy it safely or take it for 40 healing plus a 25% slow for 3 seconds.
moves.p60: Allows recalling an uncollected fruit for half Energy.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the offer instead of accepting it.

moves.name: Mischief Circle
moves.desc: Two sprites orbit a 4-metre circle for 5 seconds. Enemy ordinary projectiles crossing it bend 15 degrees away from the center, once each. Beams and melee are unaffected.
moves.p60: Lets one intercepted projectile produce a 40-point allied shield.
moves.counterplay: Destroy either orbiting sprite or fire from inside.

moves.name: Court of the Small
moves.desc: Six 50-health sprites patrol a 7-metre garden for 6 seconds. Recast assigns each to heal an ally for 30 or sting an enemy for 35, once per sprite. Unassigned sprites guard no one.
moves.counterplay: Clear sprites with a broad attack or force the caster outside the garden.
moves.unstable: Allows every surviving sprite to act twice but drains 10 health from the caster per second for the garden's duration.

passive.name: Court Favor
passive.text: Maintain three 40-health sprites. Each ordinary cast assigns one for up to 4 seconds. A sprite returning unharmed grants 5 Energy; a defeated sprite returns after 7 seconds instead of immediately.

mutation.name: Unpaid Favor
mutation.text: The unstable health cost cannot generate healing-trigger passives. Sprites are excluded from ally-count scaling and cannot accept Love bonds or create additional Fairy courts.

sequence: Wings changes an ally's route, Circle protects that route, and Sting punishes pursuers. Fairy loses helpers rapidly to broad damage and cannot sustain prolonged direct duels.

team.text: Flower beds give one sprite 20 temporary health. Music can call sprites back early, sacrificing their remaining assignments to recover one Court Favor refund.

name: Fly
identity: Fly specializes in controlled altitude. It has less direct damage than Dragon and no terrain immunity; aerial exposure, lift limits, and predictable landing windows are central weaknesses.

moves.name: Wing Dart
moves.desc: Fire two narrow air darts for 35 damage each. Airborne casts can aim downward but do not halt falling or refund Lift. Darts stop on ordinary cover.
moves.p60: Lets one dart curve 15 degrees during descent.
moves.counterplay: Use overhead cover or move laterally.

moves.name: Takeoff
moves.statline: CD 10 s | E 16 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend 20 Lift to rise 6 metres and enter hover. Recast cancels hover immediately. The ascent has a visible spiral and no damage or invulnerability.
moves.p60: Grants 0.4 seconds of knockback resistance only.
moves.counterplay: Hit during ascent to drain Lift.

moves.name: Crosswind Bank
moves.statline: CD 14 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.2 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: Spend 15 Lift to bank sideways 6 metres. A trailing wing clips enemies for 60 damage once. This movement cannot cross solid walls or cancel a root.
moves.p60: Retains horizontal momentum after the bank.
moves.counterplay: Predict the exit and use a wide projectile.

moves.name: Dive Intercept
moves.desc: Dive toward a visible ground point for 110 impact damage in 2 metres. Damage is constant regardless of altitude. Landing restores 20 Lift but locks Takeoff for 1 second.
moves.p60: Adds a 2-metre rebound after a confirmed hit.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the locked marker and punish landing.

moves.name: Open Sky
moves.statline: CD 85 s | E 35 | H 30 | W 1 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 8 seconds, Lift consumption halves and Crosswind gains one additional charge. Every second airborne paints a visible contrail. Recast ends the state in a 180-damage dive at 4 metres.
moves.counterplay: Use sustained anti-air pressure and track contrails.
moves.unstable: Removes Lift cost but makes incoming airborne hits deal 20% extra damage and forces the final dive on expiry.

passive.name: Lift Budget
passive.text: Store 100 Lift. Hovering spends 15 per second; grounded movement restores 20 per second. Taking a direct airborne hit removes 10 Lift. At zero, descend safely at normal fall speed without a stun.

mutation.name: Icarus Limit
mutation.text: Unstable flight cannot exceed the arena ceiling or leave objective boundaries. At expiry the landing marker appears 0.8 seconds early, and the player retains steering only until that lock.

sequence: Takeoff gains a sightline, Dart pressures, Bank avoids a counter, and Dive resets Lift. Enclosed ceilings and coordinated anti-air undermine the entire cycle.

team.text: Cloud platforms count as ground for half-rate Lift recovery. Storm updrafts provide altitude but no Lift, preventing indefinite free hover inside weather.

name: Fight
identity: Fight uses parries, throws, and compact combinations. Power adds raw force, Agility adds travel, and Fight wins by choosing the correct close-range response.

moves.name: Three Point Combination
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 4 | W 0.15 s | R 3 m
moves.desc: Jab, body blow, and kick deal 20, 30, and 45 damage. Each recast commits the next hit within 0.5 seconds. The final kick pushes 2 metres and cannot follow a missed second hit automatically.
moves.p60: Allows stopping after the body blow without recovery penalty.
moves.counterplay: Parry the predictable final kick.

moves.name: Shoulder Entry
moves.statline: CD 11 s | E 18 | H 7 | W 0.3 s | R 6 m
moves.desc: Advance 4 metres with a shoulder strike for 80 damage. It ignores light flinch during travel but not grabs or hard control. A blocked hit causes 0.5-second recovery.
moves.p60: Deals 30 extra Guard damage on block.
moves.counterplay: Guard the entry, then punish its recovery.

moves.name: Counterhand
moves.statline: CD 15 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.1 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Open a 0.4-second melee parry. Success deals 100 damage and turns the opponent 45 degrees through normal displacement. Projectiles and grabs bypass it.
moves.p60: Grants one Focus on a successful parry.
moves.counterplay: Delay, throw, or use a ranged poke.

moves.name: Hip Throw
moves.desc: Grab a nearby grounded enemy after an orange tell. Throw them 4 metres for 110 damage. It bypasses guard but not dodge invulnerability and cannot grab an airborne target.
moves.p60: Permits choosing left or right after a confirmed grab.
moves.counterplay: Jump or dodge on the orange tell.

moves.name: Perfect Round
moves.statline: CD 80 s | E 35 | H 30 | W 0.8 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 6 seconds, earn Focus after any two different successful defensive or offensive actions. Recast spends Focus in a 120-damage uppercut plus 40 per stored Focus, maximum 200.
moves.counterplay: Create distance and punish the unguarded approach.
moves.unstable: Grants a 260-damage finisher but removes guard until the stance ends, even if the uppercut misses.

passive.name: Clean Technique
passive.text: Land a strike, evade, and guard in any order within 5 seconds to earn Focus, maximum two. Focus shortens one ordinary recovery by 0.15 seconds; it never removes startup or grants extra hits.

mutation.name: No Guard Round
mutation.text: The unstable stance is still vulnerable to control. It does not create an unavoidable cinematic combo; the uppercut is a separate, dodgeable 0.4-second attack.

sequence: Shoulder threatens a block, Throw punishes it, and Counterhand catches retaliation. Fight has almost no long-range pressure and must preserve movement resources to enter.

team.text: Agility can create the opening but cannot transfer Focus. Defensive panels shorten approach lanes while also blocking Fight's own direct route if placed poorly.

name: Fire
identity: Fire controls burns and spreading flame across prepared fuel. It differs from Lava's lasting terrain and Explosion's armed bursts through pressure that accumulates during continued contact.

moves.name: Cinder Shot
moves.desc: Launch a small fireball for 70 damage. On terrain it leaves a 1-metre ember for 3 seconds, dealing 15 damage once to the first hostile crossing. It cannot stack on itself.
moves.p60: Splits the ember into two adjacent 15-damage patches.
moves.counterplay: Block the projectile and avoid the brief residue.

moves.name: Flamewheel
moves.desc: Roll 6 metres inside a flame ring, dealing 85 damage once. The ring has no invulnerability; water or a solid obstacle ends travel early. It cannot climb walls.
moves.p60: Leaves a 2-second trail dealing 20 damage once.
moves.counterplay: Intercept the roll with a persistent hazard.

moves.name: Backdraft Seal
moves.desc: Mark a 3-metre circle for 5 seconds. A second Fire hit ignites it for 120 damage and a 2-metre inward pull. The seal itself deals nothing and has a visible center.
moves.p60: Permits triggering it through an owned ember.
moves.counterplay: Destroy its 70-durability center or leave before ignition.

moves.name: Furnace Wall
moves.desc: Raise a 6-metre flame curtain for 5 seconds. Crossing deals 80 damage once per 2 seconds. It destroys weak projectiles below 40 damage but cannot stop players or stronger attacks.
moves.p60: Lets the curtain bend around one visible corner.
moves.counterplay: Shoot through with heavier attacks or cross once decisively.

moves.name: Cremation Horizon
moves.desc: Draw three parallel firefronts across a 9-metre zone. Each advances after a 0.8-second warning for 90 damage. Existing embers ignite only once for 25 extra damage, capped at 50 per enemy.
moves.counterplay: Move between firefronts or interrupt before they ignite.
moves.unstable: Creates white flame that crosses water but burns the caster and consumes all owned embers.

passive.name: Kindling
passive.text: Direct hits add one Kindling for 5 seconds, maximum three. Consuming three with a Fire ability deals 45 burn over 3 seconds. Burn does not apply more Kindling, and refreshes never duplicate its ticks.

mutation.name: Whitefire
mutation.text: The unstable flame has no arbitrary true damage. It retains normal mitigation and ground boundaries, while its friendly-fire risk and lost ember network make survival afterward difficult.

sequence: Cinder prepares embers, Wall restricts routes, and Seal punishes a predictable crossing. Water removes Kindling one stack at a time and shortens ground flame durations.

team.text: Wind extends a firefront 2 metres without increasing speed. Expired flame creates one Ash pile per ability, not per tick or per victim.

name: Flower
identity: Flower specializes in discrete blossoms with timed opening. Plant controls roots and stems; Nature manages an ecosystem, while Flower centers on small, readable blooms with different purposes.

moves.name: Petal Razor
moves.desc: Throw four petals for 20 damage each. Passing through an open bud gives the petals a 15-degree fan, not homing. A target takes at most four petals.
moves.p60: Lets one petal return harmlessly to accelerate a bud by 0.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Avoid the fan's central overlap.

moves.name: Restorative Bloom
moves.desc: Plant a bud that heals one nearby ally for 25 each second over 3 seconds after opening. It selects the lowest-health ally in 3 metres; healing stops if the bud is destroyed.
moves.p60: Lets it split each tick between two allies.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the blossom or move the fight away.

moves.name: Pollen Bell
moves.desc: An opening bud releases a 4-metre pollen cloud for 3 seconds, dealing 20 per second and slowing 20%. It does not blind or induce sleep; the perimeter stays clear.
moves.p60: Reveals footprints of enemies moving through pollen.
moves.counterplay: Leave the small cloud or disperse it with Wind.

moves.name: Thornless Snare
moves.desc: A lotus closes around a 2-metre circle after 0.8 seconds, dealing 100 damage and rooting 0.6 seconds. Its 100-health bud is vulnerable throughout the warning.
moves.p60: Lets a friendly open bud trigger the closure instead.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the bud or evade the closing petals.

moves.name: Garden of Returning Spring
moves.desc: Six flowers bloom in a 7-metre field for 6 seconds. Three heal for 20 per second; three release 35-damage pollen pulses every 2 seconds. A target receives at most one heal and one pulse per tick.
moves.counterplay: Clear flowers from range and avoid clustering near them.
moves.unstable: Makes all flowers perform both roles, but their destruction deals 50 neutral damage in 2 metres.

passive.name: Bud Cycle
passive.text: Maintain three buds with 80 health each. They open after 2 seconds and expire after 8. Uprooting a bud before opening refunds 5 Energy; a destroyed bud refunds nothing.

mutation.name: Overbloom
mutation.text: Unstable flowers cannot create new buds on death. Healing caps remain intact even when all six overlap, preventing multiplicative sustain in a small area.

sequence: Place healing near cover and pollen at its approach, then close Lotus on committed attackers. Flower needs two seconds of preparation and loses quickly to early area damage.

team.text: Water advances one bud's opening by 0.5 seconds. Insect can pollinate a blossom for 1 extra second of duration, once per blossom, without creating another flower.

name: Ghost
identity: Ghost temporarily changes collision and visibility. It cannot attack while fully phased, pass through protected barriers, or stay intangible indefinitely.

moves.name: Cold Touch
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.25 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: A spectral hand deals 75 damage and applies Haunt. Against an already haunted target, it slows 20% for 2 seconds instead of adding another mark.
moves.p60: Extends reach by 2 metres during reappearance.
moves.counterplay: Keep distance from the reappearance outline.

moves.name: Phase Walk
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Become intangible for 1.2 seconds, moving at walking speed and unable to attack or capture objectives. Cross one ordinary wall up to 1 metre thick; endpoint validation prevents becoming trapped.
moves.p60: Leaves a visible decoy where phasing began.
moves.counterplay: Wait for the outlined exit; area hazards remain there.

moves.name: Poltergeist Cabinet
moves.desc: Possess one loose prop of at most 150 durability for 5 seconds. Recast throws it for 120 damage. The body remains stationary and vulnerable beside the prop until release.
moves.p60: Allows dragging the prop 3 metres before throwing.
moves.counterplay: Attack the exposed body or destroy the prop.

moves.name: Haunting Return
moves.desc: Teleport to a clear point 2 metres behind a visible haunted enemy after a 0.7-second silhouette warning. Deal no arrival damage; the mark is consumed and Cold Touch becomes available only if already off cooldown.
moves.p60: Grants a 70-point shield on arrival.
moves.counterplay: Turn toward the warning or break sight before commitment.

moves.name: House of the Unseen
moves.desc: Haunt a 7-metre area with four 100-health spirit lamps for 7 seconds. The caster may phase between surviving lamps twice. Each departure emits a 90-damage ring with a 0.5-second warning.
moves.counterplay: Destroy lamps in advance or guard the remaining exits.
moves.unstable: Grants four transitions but each lamp destroyed deals 40 damage to the caster.

passive.name: Haunt Anchor
passive.text: Ordinary hits leave one Haunt on a target for 5 seconds. The caster sees the mark only in line of sight. Phasing within 8 metres of a Haunt lasts 0.5 seconds longer, once per phase.

mutation.name: Unquiet House
mutation.text: Unstable lamp backlash cannot be avoided by Phase Walk. Ghost never gains permanent invisibility; close silhouettes, footprints during movement, and reappearance cues remain readable.

sequence: Touch supplies Haunt, Phase avoids one exchange, and Return threatens a flank. Ghost is fragile during possession and predictable when few lamps or clear wall exits remain.

team.text: Light reveals phased outlines without making them damageable. Witch may seal one lamp for 2 seconds, denying travel but not destroying it or triggering backlash.

name: Heal
identity: Heal is immediate medical-style support. Life supplies growth and persistence; Heal answers current wounds, cleanses conditions, and stabilizes allies without resurrection.

moves.name: Mending Ray
moves.desc: A narrow green ray heals an ally for 95 or damages an enemy for 55. It stops at the first unit or solid obstacle; aim assistance prefers the explicitly selected teammate.
moves.p60: Removes one slow when healing a low-health ally.
moves.counterplay: Block the sightline or pressure during the ray's windup.

moves.name: Emergency Dressing
moves.desc: Give an ally a 100-point shield for 3 seconds and heal 40 on expiry if the shield survives. A broken shield grants no final heal. It does not stack with itself.
moves.p60: Permits self-cast at 80% shield value.
moves.counterplay: Break the dressing before its delayed recovery.

moves.name: Cleanse Pulse
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 24 | H 8 | W 0.5 s | R 5 m
moves.desc: Remove one removable status from each ally within 5 metres, prioritizing hard control, then damage-over-time, then slows. Heal 30 per affected ally, including the caster; no status means no heal.
moves.p60: Permits selecting which status to cleanse on one target.
moves.counterplay: Reapply pressure after the single cleanse.

moves.name: Field Clinic
moves.desc: Deploy a 180-health station for 6 seconds. It heals the lowest-health visible ally within 5 metres for 25 per second. The caster cannot move the station, and cover blocks treatment.
moves.p60: Adds a second 15-point tick for another ally.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the exposed clinic or displace its patients.

moves.name: Refuse the Ending
moves.desc: Mark up to three visible allies for 5 seconds. Each receives 120 healing immediately and one 100-point shield when falling below 20% health. Shields trigger once; lethal damage is not automatically cancelled.
moves.counterplay: Separate targets from the healer or force several triggers together.
moves.unstable: Raises the shield to 180 but transfers 80 health damage per triggered shield to the caster.

passive.name: Triage Priority
passive.text: Healing an ally below 35% health adds 15% output, once per ally per 4 seconds. Overhealing is lost. Self-healing receives no Triage bonus, and summoned copies do not count as separate patients.

mutation.name: Overextended Triage
mutation.text: Transferred damage bypasses the caster's shields and can defeat them. No heal revives eliminated players or repairs removed objectives, and temporary invulnerability never accompanies treatment.

sequence: Dressing buys time for Ray; Cleanse removes the condition preventing escape; Clinic sustains a defended position. Heal has limited dueling output and must preserve sightlines.

team.text: Love links share only the delivered heal, never duplicate it. Life's healing-over-time can continue after Cleanse but follows the universal healing reception cap.

name: Glass
identity: Glass trades durability for sharp angles and staged breakage. Crystal stores and refracts power; Glass shapes panes, edges, and dangerous fragments that cannot sustain repeated pressure.

moves.name: Glass Needle
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 4 | W 0.2 s | R 24 m
moves.desc: Fire a near-transparent needle for 80 damage. A bright tip and audible whistle preserve readability. Piercing one owned pane adds 20 damage and breaks that pane.
moves.p60: Permits piercing two panes, retaining a 120 damage cap.
moves.counterplay: Use non-glass cover or sidestep the visible tip.

moves.name: Window Step
moves.desc: Create a pane underfoot and vault 5 metres diagonally. The pane remains for 4 seconds and blocks one low projectile before breaking. It is not a teleport.
moves.p60: Creates a second landing pane if the destination is clear.
moves.counterplay: Track the airborne arc and punish landing.

moves.name: Cutting Gallery
moves.desc: Place three vertical panes for 6 seconds. Enemies touching edges take 35 damage once per second. Panes block ordinary projectiles but shatter under one heavy hit.
moves.p60: Allows angling each pane independently before placement.
moves.counterplay: Destroy from range or walk between their finite edges.

moves.name: Stress Release
moves.desc: Shatter up to three owned panes in chosen directions. Each deals a 70-damage fan, capped at 180 per victim. Passive shards are included in that budget, not added again.
moves.p60: Delays one pane's shatter by 0.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Leave the marked fans or destroy panes before release.

moves.name: Cathedral Shatter
moves.desc: Raise six panes around a 7-metre court. After 1.5 seconds they fracture sequentially into crossing lanes for 70 damage, capped at 280. Destroyed panes remove their lanes entirely.
moves.counterplay: Break two adjacent panes and use their safe sector.
moves.unstable: Shatters all surviving panes together, raising the cap to 330 but including the caster in every lane.

passive.name: Stress Lines
passive.text: Owned panes have 90 durability and visibly crack at half health. Breaking one deliberately produces three shards, each worth 15 damage in a short cone. Each pane yields shards once, regardless of repair.

mutation.name: Memory Glass
mutation.text: Unstable fragments retain the last pane angles, not target tracking. No invisible permanent shards remain afterward; every damaging edge has a bounded lifetime and visible glint.

sequence: Gallery creates firing angles for Needle; Step gives height; Release punishes a rushed crossing. Broad, cheap damage efficiently destroys the low-durability setup.

team.text: Sound shatters cracked panes immediately. Laser reflects from one intact pane at 80% damage, consuming it; it cannot bounce indefinitely through a gallery.

name: Glitch
tagline: Short positional discontinuities and fake states
identity: Glitch changes presentation and bounded movement timing. It never affects real latency, client stability, input bindings, menus, or the opponent's ability to understand their health.

moves.name: Missing Frame
moves.desc: Fire a pixelated bolt for 70 damage. Halfway along its fixed path, it skips forward 2 metres after a visible square flash. It cannot skip through solid cover.
moves.p60: Increases the skip to 3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Dodge sideways rather than counting on travel timing.

moves.name: Packet Jump
moves.desc: Blink 6 metres to a visible clear point. Both endpoints flash for 0.3 seconds. Existing damage-over-time follows the caster, and the blink grants no invulnerability after arrival.
moves.p60: Leaves two echoes but only one can grant Energy.
moves.counterplay: Guard the endpoint or use persistent damage.

moves.name: Error Tile
moves.desc: Place a 3-metre tile for 5 seconds. Its first enemy entrant is displaced 2 metres to the displayed exit and takes 85 damage. The tile then disappears.
moves.p60: Allows rotating the exit before anyone enters.
moves.counterplay: Avoid the tile or destroy its 80-durability corner node.

moves.name: Rollback Decoy
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 26 | H 11 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Record the caster's position for 3 seconds. Recast returns there, keeping current health, Energy, cooldowns, and statuses. The visible 100-durability record node can be destroyed to prevent return.
moves.p60: Leaves a 60-damage pulse at departure with a 0.4-second warning.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the node or trap the recorded position.

moves.name: Reality Exception
moves.desc: Mark four 3-metre tiles for 6 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds one announced pair swaps occupants' positions, dealing 70 damage to enemies moved. Players may exit during the 0.6-second preview.
moves.counterplay: Read tile arrows and step out before each swap.
moves.unstable: Swaps all four in a displayed cycle, including the caster, and adds one 100-damage terminal pulse.

passive.name: Desync Echo
passive.text: After an ordinary movement skill, leave a 1-second visual echo. An enemy hitting it grants 8 Energy, once per 5 seconds. Echoes have no objective weight and cannot receive healing or generate other echoes.

mutation.name: Fatal Exception
mutation.text: The unstable field never removes UI or simulates a genuine system error. Invalid destinations cancel movement and damage together; no one is placed inside walls or outside arena bounds.

sequence: Error Tile narrows safe movement, Missing Frame tests timing, and Rollback preserves an escape. Patient players can attack the actual anchors instead of chasing visual noise.

team.text: Technology scanners identify the real record node. Time can slow a tile's swap warning by 0.3 seconds but cannot reverse an already resolved swap.

name: Gold
tagline: Finite wealth conversion and heavy protection
identity: Gold turns successful trades into minted tokens. Tokens are match resources only, not real currency; the kit spends them on weight, shields, and conspicuous valuable structures.

moves.name: Gilt Dart
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Launch a gold sliver for 75 damage. Spend one Coin on hold to make it a 100-damage heavy dart that drops faster and deals 40 extra durability damage.
moves.p60: Lets a heavy dart pin a small construct for 1 second.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the slower heavy projectile.

moves.name: Bullion Guard
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 20 | H 7 | W 0.35 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend up to two Coins for a 60-point base shield plus 50 per Coin, lasting 4 seconds. Running speed falls 10% while shielded; remaining shield grants no Coin refund.
moves.p60: Removes the movement penalty below half shield strength.
moves.counterplay: Kite the heavy caster and wait out the shield.

moves.name: Golden Standard
moves.desc: Plant a 180-durability standard for 6 seconds. Allies within 4 metres gain 10% resistance to knockback. Recast spends a Coin to pulse 70 damage and 2-metre push once.
moves.p60: Makes the pulse remove one enemy ground hazard below 80 durability.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the standard before Coins are invested.

moves.name: Ransom Ring
moves.desc: Spend two Coins to draw a 4-metre ring for 4 seconds. Leaving through its edge deals 100 damage once; staying inside deals nothing. A 120-durability clasp opens the ring when broken.
moves.p60: Allows widening the ring by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Break the clasp or take the exit damage deliberately.

moves.name: Treasury of the Sun
moves.desc: Mint three giant 160-durability coins above a 7-metre zone. Drop them individually for 100 damage in 3-metre circles. Spend stored Coins to enlarge circles by 0.25 metres each, maximum 1.5.
moves.counterplay: Escape the locked circles and punish the weighted recovery.
moves.unstable: Drops them together for up to 300 damage but consumes all Coins and gives the caster a 20% slow for 4 seconds.

passive.name: Minted Value
passive.text: Dealing 100 actual health damage grants one Coin, maximum six, with excess progress retained. One Coin expires after 8 seconds without combat. Summons, shields, and friendly targets produce no Coins.

mutation.name: Gilded Burden
mutation.text: The unstable slow cannot be removed by Gold's own shield. Coins cannot be duplicated, copied, stolen outside explicit game effects, or converted into permanent progression.

sequence: Dart earns currency, Standard protects a position, and Ring discourages a simple retreat. Gold's tempo collapses when shields prevent it from minting new value.

team.text: Alchemist can turn a friendly gold prop into shielding once. Light through a standard illuminates its 4-metre zone, revealing both teams' concealed footprints.

name: Gravity
identity: Gravity alters movement through finite wells. It never creates a real-world singularity, inescapable permanent pull, or damage proportional to a player's hardware frame rate.

moves.name: Falling Pebble
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Launch a dense mote for 80 damage. It bends downward sharply after 12 metres, allowing overhead lobs but making long flat shots difficult. A direct hit adds one Weight.
moves.p60: Permits choosing the downward bend point.
moves.counterplay: Read the trajectory and move laterally.

moves.name: Local Down
moves.desc: Place a 3-metre well for 4 seconds, pulling enemies inward at 1 m/s while grounded. It deals no damage and never disables movement input. Its core has 110 durability.
moves.p60: Lets the caster move the core 2 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Walk outward, jump, or destroy the core.

moves.name: Vector Reversal
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 22 | H 9 | W 0.2 s | R 6 m
moves.desc: Reverse one nearby ordinary projectile's direction during a 0.6-second window, reducing its damage to 70%. Melee and beams ignore it. A reflected projectile cannot be reversed again.
moves.p60: Also cancels one incoming knockback event on the caster.
moves.counterplay: Use a beam or stagger projectiles.

moves.name: Weight of Arrival
moves.desc: Mark a target's current ground position for 0.8 seconds, then slam a 3-metre column for 130 damage. Each Weight adds 10, maximum 160; all Weight is consumed on hit.
moves.p60: Extends the column 3 metres upward.
moves.counterplay: Evade after the position locks.

moves.name: The Falling Kingdom
moves.desc: An 8-metre field alternates upward and downward force twice over 4 seconds. Each downward pulse deals 100 damage. Players retain air steering; breaking its 240-durability core ends later pulses.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the core or steer out between pulses.
moves.unstable: Adds a final 140-damage collapse but draws the caster into the same field.

passive.name: Mass Debt
passive.text: Each forced movement from Gravity adds one Weight for 4 seconds, maximum three. Each reduces jump height by 8%, but not running speed. Grounding alone causes no extra damage.

mutation.name: Singularity Debt
mutation.text: The unstable center has a finite 2 m/s pull and never overrides displacement immunity. Protected floors remain intact; floating debris is not extra unlisted damage.

sequence: Local Down limits approach angles, Pebble adds Weight, and Arrival punishes a delayed escape. Teleports and coordinated core destruction bypass the slow setup.

team.text: Space exits ignore the pull but still require clear destinations. Size doubles a giant's visual mass without multiplying Gravity damage; giants receive half forced-movement distance instead.

name: Ice
identity: Ice forms rigid cover and builds Chill. Snow controls soft accumulation; Ice creates sharp structures and brief freezes with explicit anti-chain protection.

moves.name: Rime Lance
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Fire an ice spear for 80 damage and one Chill. It sticks in terrain as an 80-durability shard for 5 seconds, usable as a barrier but not a second damaging hit.
moves.p60: Pierces one owned shard at unchanged damage.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the line or break lodged shards.

moves.name: Skate Cut
moves.desc: Slide 7 metres along the ground for 70 damage. Turning is limited, and a 3-second slick remains. The slick affects both teams' braking but never removes steering.
moves.p60: Allows one sharp 45-degree cut halfway through.
moves.counterplay: Pressure the endpoint or force a turn before the cut.

moves.name: Cryo Bastion
moves.desc: Raise a 220-durability ice wall for 7 seconds. Fire removes 50 extra durability per direct hit. Recast breaks it into a harmless slick, enabling a planned retreat.
moves.p60: Allows a small firing slit in the wall.
moves.counterplay: Attack through the slit or melt the cover.

moves.name: Brittle Verdict
moves.desc: A 3-metre crystal bloom erupts after 0.8 seconds for 120 damage. Frozen enemies take 30 extra damage but are immediately released, preventing a free extended combo.
moves.p60: Consumes nearby owned shards to widen the bloom by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Leave the bloom's visible frost outline.

moves.name: Winter Cathedral
moves.desc: Six 120-durability pillars rise around a 7-metre zone. Three alternating lanes flash and freeze for 0.5 seconds, dealing 80 each. Global control limits still apply; pillars can be broken for exits.
moves.counterplay: Break pillars or move through previously fired lanes.
moves.unstable: Shatters all surviving pillars for 140 damage, including against the caster, and removes every slick.

passive.name: Chill Threshold
passive.text: Direct hits add Chill for 5 seconds, maximum three. At three, the next Ice hit freezes for 0.6 seconds, consumes Chill, and grants 3 seconds of freeze immunity. Freeze does not amplify damage automatically.

mutation.name: Black Ice
mutation.text: Unstable black ice reflects its lane markers clearly. It does not secretly extend freeze duration; its extra danger is a final shared shatter followed by lost defensive terrain.

sequence: Lance builds Chill, Skate changes angle, and Verdict cashes out a freeze. Opponents can cleanse Chill or exploit the freeze immunity window to attack aggressively.

team.text: Water hit by Ice becomes one 100-durability frozen patch, consuming the pool. Fire thaws it into harmless water and removes one Chill from a directly heated target.

name: Illusion
identity: Illusion creates believable decoys and false routes. It cannot fabricate health loss, hide unavoidable attacks, alter menus, or make an opponent's control input unreliable.

moves.name: False Spear
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Launch two visually similar spears 0.3 seconds apart. One is real for 75 damage; the real tip has a consistent bright notch. The caster chooses their order before casting.
moves.p60: Lets the fake curve while the real remains straight.
moves.counterplay: Read the notch or evade both paths.

moves.name: Stage Double
moves.desc: Create a 1-hit decoy for 4 seconds that repeats the caster's last 1 second of movement. It has no attacks or collision. Damage reveals it immediately as transparent.
moves.p60: Permits one preset crouch or dodge motion.
moves.counterplay: Test the decoy with a cheap attack.

moves.name: False Door
moves.desc: Overlay a doorway on a real wall for 5 seconds while making one nearby open passage appear closed. Physical collisions never change, and outlines reveal the trick within 2 metres.
moves.p60: Briefly shows the false passage to targeting assistance, not manual aim.
moves.counterplay: Approach carefully or use a projectile to test collision.

moves.name: Curtain Call
moves.desc: Collapse owned illusions into a 4-metre flash for 100 damage. Each consumed Deception adds 10, maximum 130. The flash obscures distant scenery for 0.4 seconds but preserves attack outlines.
moves.p60: Leaves one fresh non-damaging decoy after the flash.
moves.counterplay: Leave the marked flash area or strike through it.

moves.name: The Audience Is Wrong
moves.desc: Create five decoys around an 8-metre stage for 6 seconds. The real caster may swap with one twice; each destination shows the real-tip notch 0.5 seconds before arrival. Decoy attacks are harmless.
moves.counterplay: Test decoys and track the destination tell.
moves.unstable: Permits a third swap but makes every destroyed decoy reveal the caster for 1 second.

passive.name: Credible Lie
passive.text: An enemy striking an untested illusion grants one Deception, maximum three, once per illusion. Spend Deception to extend an ordinary illusion by 1 second. Repeatedly shooting an already revealed fake grants nothing.

mutation.name: Broken Masquerade
mutation.text: The unstable reveal pierces Illusion's own concealment. There is always one real body; decoys cannot capture, heal, block projectiles, or trigger ally-count mechanics.

sequence: Double tests reactions, False Door steers a chase, and Spear rewards divided attention. Broad cheap attacks and close observation expose the trick with little investment.

team.text: Sound hits reveal fake collision surfaces. Light makes all illusion outlines visible at 4 metres, doubling the normal close-range identification distance.

name: Ink
identity: Ink gives written shapes physical consequences. It requires surfaces and readable strokes; Paper supplies foldable material, while Ink is a tool for marking, linking, and animating.

moves.name: Brush Lance
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Paint a narrow stroke for 70 damage and leave a mark on the impacted surface. A player hit receives a visible stain for 4 seconds, but no permanent tracking.
moves.p60: Lets the stroke turn once across an owned dry mark.
moves.counterplay: Break the connecting mark or dodge off the surface.

moves.name: Underline
moves.desc: Draw an 8-metre floor line lasting 5 seconds. Recast slides the caster along it at 12 m/s. Enemies crossing take 45 damage once; a broken middle segment stops travel.
moves.p60: Permits a single curve around visible cover.
moves.counterplay: Cut the line or attack its endpoint.

moves.name: Drawn Beast
moves.desc: Consume two dry marks to animate a 140-health ink wolf for 5 seconds. It performs one 120-damage pounce toward a commanded point, then dissolves. It cannot copy Animal behavior.
moves.p60: Allows recalling the wolf before its pounce for one mark refund.
moves.counterplay: Destroy it or evade the fixed landing point.

moves.name: Redaction
moves.desc: Cross out one ordinary hostile ground mark below 150 durability. It loses its next activation and dissolves after 1 second. On a player, deal 90 damage and remove one reveal mark instead.
moves.p60: Redraws one owned expired mark at half duration.
moves.counterplay: Protect the mark or attack during the visible cross stroke.

moves.name: Black Manuscript
moves.desc: Draw three giant symbols across a 7-metre field: Line pushes, Fang deals 130, and Circle roots 0.5 seconds. Activate in a chosen order with 0.7-second previews; each symbol has 120 durability.
moves.counterplay: Destroy one symbol and use the corresponding safe space.
moves.unstable: Activates all symbols twice at half second-pass damage but washes away every owned mark afterward.

passive.name: Wet Script
passive.text: Maintain four ink marks for 8 seconds. New marks remain wet for 2 seconds and can be washed away easily. Dry marks have 60 durability and can support one command each.

mutation.name: Living Ink
mutation.text: The unstable manuscript cannot write new game rules or erase abilities. Its second control application obeys the global diminishing-control limit even when two symbols overlap.

sequence: Lance builds dry marks, Underline supplies a route, and Beast attacks a redirected target. Water and mobile aerial enemies deny Ink's surface-dependent setup.

team.text: Paper carries one Ink mark as a movable talisman, sharing one activation budget. Water removes wet marks immediately and deals 40 durability damage to dry marks.

name: Insect
tagline: Chitin, brood commands, and controlled infestation
identity: Insect controls a small brood with specialized roles. Animal uses one substantial companion; Insect uses several fragile units and vulnerable hive infrastructure.

moves.name: Stinging Order
moves.desc: Command up to two Stingers to attack for 35 damage each and return. Both use visible approach arcs. They cannot pass through solid cover or keep tracking an unseen target.
moves.p60: Lets one surviving Stinger attack from a second angle.
moves.counterplay: Use a broad swipe or break their approach sightline.

moves.name: Beetle Buckler
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Assign the Beetle to block 100 frontal projectile damage for 3 seconds. Excess damage passes through. If it survives, it returns to its slot without healing.
moves.p60: Permits assigning the Beetle to one nearby ally.
moves.counterplay: Flank or exceed the small blocking budget.

moves.name: Scout Dust
moves.desc: The Scout releases dust in a 4-metre circle for 4 seconds, revealing moving enemy footprints and dealing 15 damage per second. Destroying the Scout immediately ends the dust.
moves.p60: Lets the Scout move the cloud 2 metres.
moves.counterplay: Shoot the visible Scout or stop moving briefly.

moves.name: Hive Stake
moves.desc: Build a 220-health hive for 10 seconds. It supplies regrowth and one extra temporary Stinger, which expires with the hive. Only one hive exists; replacing it dismisses the old extra insect.
moves.p60: Grants the hive 60 temporary shield on placement.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the hive to disrupt regrowth.

moves.name: Brood Eclipse
moves.desc: Release twelve 25-health insects for 6 seconds. They strike in three commanded waves, each capped at 90 total damage per victim. Area attacks can destroy the wave before contact.
moves.counterplay: Use sweeping damage and keep distance between waves.
moves.unstable: Adds a fourth wave but consumes the hive and all surviving ordinary insects afterward.

passive.name: Brood Slots
passive.text: Maintain four insects with 45 health each. Choose two Stingers, one Beetle, and one Scout. Defeated insects regrow at the hive after 6 seconds; without a hive, regrowth takes 10 seconds.

mutation.name: Locust Hunger
mutation.text: The unstable brood does not attack allies but leaves its caster without protection or scouts. No individual insect generates Proxima, healing triggers, or more brood slots.

sequence: Dust reveals a route, Stingers pressure it, and Beetle protects hive placement. Fire, Sound, and other broad attacks efficiently remove the fragile units.

team.text: Flower can shelter one insect, granting 20 health once. Poison coats one Stinger for 15 damage over 3 seconds, replacing rather than multiplying existing Poison stacks.

name: Laser
tagline: Line of sight and heat-limited precision
identity: Laser delivers narrow, readable beams with high aim commitment. Light includes revelation and support; Laser concentrates on firing geometry and vulnerable aiming windows.

moves.name: Redline Shot
moves.desc: A red aiming line appears for 0.4 seconds before a 100-damage hitscan shot. The line stops on cover. Aim moves at half speed during the final 0.15 seconds.
moves.p60: Lets the shot pierce one 60-durability object.
moves.counterplay: Move after the aim line begins to settle.

moves.name: Lens Slide
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.2 s | R 6 m
moves.desc: Slide 5 metres while preserving weapon aim. No damage or invulnerability is granted. The next Redline cast within 2 seconds starts 0.1 seconds faster, never below 0.3 seconds.
moves.p60: Removes 10 Heat if used without firing for 1 second.
moves.counterplay: Pressure the predictable lateral exit.

moves.name: Mirrorless Bend
moves.desc: Place a 90-durability lens for 5 seconds. The next Laser shot bends once at it along a displayed line and deals 85% damage. The lens breaks after use.
moves.p60: Allows two selectable exit angles, both previewed.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the lens or hide outside both angles.

moves.name: Searing Sweep
moves.desc: Sweep a beam through 60 degrees over 1.5 seconds, dealing five 30-damage ticks at most. Movement falls to 30% speed. The sweep cannot reverse direction after commitment.
moves.p60: Extends the sweep angle to 80 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Move behind the sweep or interrupt its stationary source.

moves.name: Horizon Incision
moves.desc: Charge a thick beam with a 1.2-second visible line, then fire three 100-damage pulses over 1 second. Ordinary cover loses 180 durability per pulse; surviving cover blocks damage behind it.
moves.counterplay: Leave the locked line and attack the exposed shooter.
moves.unstable: Adds a fourth 80-damage pulse but freezes aiming for the entire release and sets Heat to 100 afterward.

passive.name: Lens Temperature
passive.text: Landing a beam's central line grants one Focus, maximum three. Each Focus reduces the next beam's width by 10% and increases damage by 5%, capped at 15%. Missing consumes one Focus and adds 3 Heat.

mutation.name: Lens Failure
mutation.text: The unstable fourth pulse obeys the same cover rules. It never pierces protected structures or reaches beyond its range; lens glare cannot obscure the defender's movement cue.

sequence: Slide finds an angle, Bend threatens cover, and Redline punishes predictable movement. Fast close pressure and attacks from multiple angles exploit Laser's narrow aim commitment.

team.text: Mirror redirects one beam under the shared one-reflection limit. Crystal splits a beam into two half-damage branches, retaining the original maximum total damage against one target.

name: Lava
tagline: Slow terrain pressure and cooling crust
identity: Lava leaves dangerous molten ground that gradually becomes usable cover. Its threat persists longer than Fire, but travel speed and setup make it vulnerable to mobile opponents.

moves.name: Melt Glob
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 14 | H 7 | W 0.5 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Lob a heavy glob for 90 impact damage and a 2-metre pool dealing 20 per second. The pool's damage begins after 0.5 seconds and follows Cooling Cycle.
moves.p60: Makes the pool spread 1 metre downhill.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the slow arc and move uphill.

moves.name: Basalt Step
moves.desc: Raise a crust platform and step 5 metres onto it. The 180-durability platform lasts 6 seconds and damages no one on formation. It provides height but little horizontal escape.
moves.p60: Lets the caster tilt it as a ramp.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the support or pressure its upper surface.

moves.name: Lava Vein
moves.desc: Draw a glowing 10-metre fissure. After 0.9 seconds it erupts for 130 damage and becomes a narrow molten lane. Gaps and protected structural boundaries interrupt the fissure.
moves.p60: Allows one branch, sharing the same damage cap.
moves.counterplay: Cross before eruption or leap the narrow lane.

moves.name: Crustbreaker
moves.desc: Break up to two owned crusts into 100-damage bursts within 3 metres each. Targets can take both, but the crust is consumed and creates no replacement pool.
moves.p60: Pushes victims away from the nearest molten area.
moves.counterplay: Leave crusts when their surface glows again.

moves.name: Mantle Breach
moves.desc: Three vents open across an 8-metre zone, warning 1 second before each 110-damage eruption. Each leaves a pool. Destroying a vent's 140-durability rim reduces its eruption to 50 damage.
moves.counterplay: Break rims and move between vent timings.
moves.unstable: Joins the pools into a 4-second lava lake, dealing 25 per second to everyone including the caster.

passive.name: Cooling Cycle
passive.text: Owned pools remain molten for 4 seconds, then form 120-durability crust for 5 seconds. Crust deals no contact damage. Fire can remelt one crust once; repeated reheating cannot extend it indefinitely.

mutation.name: Core Exposure
mutation.text: The unstable lake is a shared ground hazard, not an unavoidable map flood. Its cooling crust remains neutral, preventing the caster from monopolizing every escape route afterward.

sequence: Glob narrows routes, Vein predicts movement, and Crustbreaker punishes enemies using cooled cover. Flight and fast lateral movement bypass its slow ground setup.

team.text: Water instantly crusts one pool, removing damage but creating cover. Earth channels guide downhill spread without increasing total molten area or damage ticks.

name: Life
identity: Life accelerates living systems and sustains them over time. Heal repairs immediate wounds; Life needs protected growth windows and cannot reverse a completed elimination.

moves.name: Vital Seed
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 14 | H 4 | W 0.4 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Throw a seed that heals an ally for 60 over 3 seconds or damages an enemy for 60. On terrain it grows a 70-health shoot that heals its first allied collector for 50.
moves.p60: Lets the shoot mature 0.5 seconds sooner.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the shoot or pressure the healing target.

moves.name: Living Armor
moves.desc: Grow a 120-point shield on an ally for 5 seconds. It repairs 10 shield per second while the ally avoids direct damage, capped at its original strength. It never becomes permanent armor.
moves.p60: Spends one Growth to cleanse a bleed.
moves.counterplay: Keep hitting to stop the repair window.

moves.name: Renewal Trail
moves.desc: Create a 10-metre trail for 6 seconds. Allies moving along it heal 15 per second, capped at 60 per ally per cast. Standing still gives nothing; enemies receive no healing.
moves.p60: Grants 10% speed along the trail.
moves.counterplay: Control its exit or force allies off the route.

moves.name: Second Growth
moves.desc: Restore 100 health to one living allied summon or 80 health to a player over 4 seconds. The first direct enemy hit pauses the next tick, once; dead summons cannot be restored.
moves.p60: Lets unused Growth add 10 healing each, consuming it.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the long cast or burst through the gradual recovery.

moves.name: Tree of Returning Days
moves.desc: A 350-health tree stands for 8 seconds. Allies within 7 metres gain 25 healing per second and one 80-point shield on entry. Roots provide climbable cover but do not trap enemies.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the tree or move the fight outside its reach.
moves.unstable: Doubles healing for 4 seconds, then withers and applies a 30% healing penalty to its caster for 6 seconds.

passive.name: Vital Growth
passive.text: Every 3 seconds without taking direct damage grants one Growth, maximum four. Each Growth increases one Life heal by 10 and is consumed. Damage removes one Growth, never all accumulated progress.

mutation.name: Borrowed Spring
mutation.text: Unstable growth cannot generate new Growth stacks from its own healing. The later healing penalty remains visible and cannot be removed by the caster's own Life abilities.

sequence: Armor protects growth time, Trail supports rotation, and Seeds reward planned movement. Sudden focused damage and repeated interrupts defeat Life's slow returns.

team.text: Plant structures receive half the tree's healing, within normal object caps. Vampire lifesteal counts as received healing but cannot produce Life's Growth resource.

name: Light
identity: Light exposes hidden routes and supports precision. Laser concentrates damage; Light combines sight, narrow barriers, and bright but accessibility-safe attack cues.

moves.name: Dawn Ray
moves.desc: Fire a luminous ray for 75 damage. It briefly illuminates a 2-metre corridor for both teams. Its visible windup remains 0.3 seconds even if other effects shorten casting.
moves.p60: Lets the ray remove one weak illusion it crosses.
moves.counterplay: Use solid cover; illumination is not wall penetration.

moves.name: Luminous Step
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R 7 m
moves.desc: Dash 6 metres and leave an afterimage for 1 second. The afterimage is non-solid and harmless. Arrival emits a 3-metre reveal pulse without damage.
moves.p60: Grants a 50-point shield if it reveals an enemy.
moves.counterplay: Trap the arrival circle rather than the image.

moves.name: Prism Veil
moves.desc: Place a thin 160-durability light plane for 4 seconds. It blocks one side's energy projectiles but lets physical projectiles through. Its protected side is marked by a visible striped edge.
moves.p60: Lets an ally crossing gain 1 second of reveal resistance.
moves.counterplay: Use physical attacks or flank the plane.

moves.name: Noon Brand
moves.desc: Mark a visible enemy for 3 seconds. A descending column strikes their locked position after 0.9 seconds for 130 damage. The brand's remaining duration provides reveal only, not further strikes.
moves.p60: Removes one concealment effect on a confirmed hit.
moves.counterplay: Move after the position locks.

moves.name: Day Without Shadow
moves.desc: An 8-metre sun disc reveals all units and false constructs for 6 seconds. Three rotating beams deal 80 damage each, capped at 250. A 220-durability center ends the effect if destroyed.
moves.counterplay: Break the center or follow a beam's trailing safe space.
moves.unstable: Adds a 120-damage final flash, but reveals the caster through solid cover for 4 seconds afterward.

passive.name: Revealing Contact
passive.text: Direct Light hits reveal a target's outline for 2 seconds through concealment, not solid walls. Hitting an already revealed target refunds 4 Energy, once per cast. Illusions reveal only their own false outline.

mutation.name: Unshielded Radiance
mutation.text: The unstable flash never whites out the screen. Its damage zone has a persistent outline, reduced-flash presentation, and an audio cue with equal warning time.

sequence: Ray identifies a hidden route, Step changes angle, and Brand forces movement. Light lacks sustained physical protection and can be overwhelmed by ordinary melee pressure.

team.text: Dark can carve a temporary unlit pocket in the sun disc but does not hide attack markers. Mirror redirects one ray while preserving reveal duration and damage caps.

name: Love
tagline: Chosen bonds and shared defensive costs
identity: Love is voluntary team support, not forced romance or mind control. Its bonds share finite benefits and distribute damage; they never multiply one heal into unlimited healing.

moves.name: Heartline
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Send a heart-shaped projectile that heals the bonded ally for 70 or damages an enemy for 60. An unbonded ally receives 50 healing. It stops on the first unit.
moves.p60: Lets it curve modestly toward the visible bonded ally.
moves.counterplay: Block the line or separate the partners.

moves.name: Come Back Safe
moves.desc: Give the partner a 100-point shield and mark the caster's position for 3 seconds. The partner may interact to dash toward that point up to 6 metres; movement is optional and can be blocked by terrain.
moves.p60: Allows the caster to take the return instead.
moves.counterplay: Control the marked meeting point.

moves.name: Shared Burden
moves.desc: For 4 seconds, redirect 25% of the partner's incoming health damage to the caster, maximum 120. Redirected damage ignores shields and cannot be redirected again. Both see the remaining budget.
moves.p60: Reduces the transferred portion by 20% before applying it.
moves.counterplay: Pressure both partners or force the budget to empty.

moves.name: Sever the Threat
moves.desc: A ribbon sweeps around the partner, dealing 110 damage to nearby enemies and pushing them 2 metres away. It has a 3-metre radius and requires current line of sight.
moves.p60: Cleanses one slow from the partner.
moves.counterplay: Attack from outside the ribbon's radius.

moves.name: No One Falls Alone
moves.desc: Create up to three voluntary links for 6 seconds. Distribute a total pool of 450 shield among linked allies according to missing health. Recast reallocates unused shield once; it does not refill the pool.
moves.counterplay: Split pressure and force the caster's shared burden.
moves.unstable: Adds 200 shield but the caster absorbs the first 150 health damage that penetrates any linked ally's shield.

passive.name: Mutual Bond
passive.text: Bond to one consenting ally within 18 metres. A quarter of healing received may transfer to the partner instead, not duplicate. The link breaks beyond 24 metres for 2 seconds or on either elimination.

mutation.name: Unconditional Cost
mutation.text: The unstable link has no resurrection or automatic survival clause. Redirected damage can defeat the caster, and eliminated partners consume no further shield or damage budget.

sequence: Heartline stabilizes the partner, Burden protects a critical action, and Ribbon removes close pressure. Isolation and sightline breaks interrupt Love more reliably than raw shield damage alone.

team.text: Heal's output may be transferred but never copied across bonds. Duplication bodies are ineligible partners; only their real player body may accept a link.

name: Lunar
identity: Lunar alternates crescent, full, and new moon behavior on a public cycle. Solar stores exposure around a sun; Lunar plans around predictable changes in range, defense, and concealment.

moves.name: Silver Crescent
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Throw a curved blade for 75 damage. It returns along the same route for 35, but one target can take at most 100 total. Terrain stops both travel phases.
moves.p60: Lets the returning blade pass through one owned lunar seal.
moves.counterplay: Evade the return as well as the outbound arc.

moves.name: Moonpool
moves.desc: Place a 4-metre silver pool for 5 seconds. Allies gain 10% movement speed inside; enemies receive a 15% slow. It deals no damage and has a 100-durability center.
moves.p60: Grants one 40-point shield to an ally entering during Full.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the center or fight outside the pool.

moves.name: Tidal Veil
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Create a 130-point shield for 3 seconds. Recast releases remaining shield as a harmless 3-metre push, scaled from 0 to 2 metres. The shield cannot reflect damage.
moves.p60: Releases one removable reveal mark with the push.
moves.counterplay: Wait out the shield or pressure from multiple directions.

moves.name: Phase Arrest
moves.desc: Lock the current phase for 4 seconds and strike a 3-metre circle for 120 damage after 0.8 seconds. The clock resumes from its saved position afterward.
moves.p60: Lets the caster advance one phase before locking.
moves.counterplay: Use the public phase icon to anticipate the chosen advantage.

moves.name: Thirteenfold Moonfall
moves.desc: Thirteen small moons fall in three previewed clusters over 4 seconds, each hit dealing 45 damage, capped at 270 per enemy. At least one continuous exit corridor remains clear.
moves.counterplay: Follow the open corridor and avoid the final large marker.
