moves.unstable: Adds a final 120-damage full moon, but resets the caster to New with no phase benefits for 6 seconds.

passive.name: Three Phases
passive.text: Cycle Crescent, Full, and New every 4 seconds. Crescent adds 2 metres to projectile range; Full adds 30 shield to one defensive cast; New hides the caster's footsteps for 2 seconds after a dodge. The phase icon is public.

mutation.name: Blood Moon
mutation.text: The unstable color change does not grant Blood mechanics. Lunar's three-phase cycle is a gameplay abstraction, with no dependence on real lunar dates or local time.

sequence: Pool controls position while Crescent threatens a return path; Arrest preserves a useful phase for the final. Opponents can wait out predictable Full defenses and attack during New.

team.text: Water extends Moonpool by 1 metre without increasing slow. Shadow can anchor to its cast silhouette but loses that anchor when the pool expires.

name: Magic
identity: Magic selects from a small prepared spellbook. Arcane builds geometry, Alchemist mixes reagents, and Magic exchanges perfect specialization for access to several modest answers.

moves.name: Spellbolt
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Use Bolt to fire a 75-damage orb. Tap again before release to widen it into three 25-damage sparks, retaining total damage. Both forms stop at the first solid obstacle.
moves.p60: Lets sparks spread after passing an ally.
moves.counterplay: Evade the chosen narrow or broad pattern.

moves.name: Portable Ward
moves.desc: Use Ward to place a 150-durability shield plate for 4 seconds. It faces one direction and can be carried at walking speed by its caster; carrying prevents Spellbolt.
moves.p60: Permits dropping the plate without ending its duration.
moves.counterplay: Flank the plate or pressure while Bolt is unavailable.

moves.name: Rabbit Turn
moves.statline: CD 16 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Use Trick to create a harmless rabbit decoy and dash 4 metres sideways. The real caster remains outlined for 0.3 seconds, preventing a completely unreadable escape.
moves.p60: Lets the decoy hop once toward the original aim point.
moves.counterplay: Track the outlined body rather than the rabbit.

moves.name: Spellbook Revision
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 24 | H 10 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Turn one page face up and change its next spell: Bolt becomes a 90-damage lob, Ward becomes 80 healing over 4 seconds, or Trick becomes a 2-metre push. The revision expires after one cast.
moves.p60: Shortens the selected page's ordinary cooldown by 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the visible book-reading channel.

moves.name: Five Page Finale
moves.desc: Cast five preselected effects over 5 seconds: two 80-damage bolts, a 120-point ward, a 90-damage pulse, and a 4-metre reposition. Each retains its own tell; interruption ends unused pages.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt between pages or force the reposition early.
moves.unstable: Permits choosing their order mid-sequence but seals the spellbook for 4 seconds afterward.

passive.name: Prepared Pages
passive.text: Prepare Bolt, Ward, and Trick. Casting a page turns it face down for 4 seconds, but other pages remain available. Using all three different pages in sequence restores 10 Energy once per cycle.

mutation.name: Unwritten Chapter
mutation.text: The unstable finale cannot add spells from other kits. Its flexibility is ordering, not unlimited invention; copied pages use Copy's fixed budget and never reproduce the spellbook passive.

sequence: Rotate pages to sustain Energy and revise the answer actually needed. Magic is inefficient if forced to repeat one page, and its strongest flexibility requires an exposed channel.

team.text: Paper may carry one revised Spellbolt in a visible seal on an Accordion Wall panel. It releases once when that panel breaks, retaining the bolt's damage and a 0.5-second warning. Arcane lines may bend Spellbolt once, consuming any stored counter charge.

name: Mirror
identity: Mirror redirects existing attacks and positions. It does not copy abilities into a reusable library; every reflection requires an intact surface, a valid angle, and a single-use budget.

moves.name: Silver Shard
moves.desc: Throw a shard for 70 damage. Hitting terrain plants a small mirror for 5 seconds, oriented by the aim direction. Hitting a player plants no mirror on their body.
moves.p60: Grants the planted mirror 40 extra durability.
moves.counterplay: Attack the rear or change angle.

moves.name: Reflecting Guard
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.15 s | R self
moves.desc: Hold a hand mirror for 0.6 seconds to reflect one ordinary projectile at 75% damage, capped at 120. Beams require an explicit beam-compatible mirror; melee and ultimates pass through.
moves.p60: Permits aiming the reflection within a 30-degree cone.
moves.counterplay: Use an excluded attack type or bait the window.

moves.name: Looking Glass Step
moves.desc: Connect two owned mirrors for 3 seconds. The caster may traverse once after a 0.4-second flash, provided both surfaces and the connecting route are unblocked. Traversal consumes both mirrors.
moves.p60: Leaves one 50-durability mirror at the exit.
moves.counterplay: Break an endpoint or block the connecting line.

moves.name: Reverse Image
moves.desc: A 3-metre mirror field warns for 0.8 seconds, then swaps the caster and one consenting ally inside it, or deals 110 damage to enemies. It never forces enemy swaps.
moves.p60: Grants both swapped allies 40 shield.
moves.counterplay: Leave the damage field or pressure the exchange destination.

moves.name: Hall of Reflections
moves.desc: Six 130-durability mirrors surround a 7-metre court for 6 seconds. Fire three 90-damage rays through selected mirrors. Each ray reflects once at most; destroying its destination cancels that branch.
moves.counterplay: Break mirrors and use their rear faces as safe angles.
moves.unstable: Fires a fourth ray but all reflected rays become neutral and can hit the caster.

passive.name: True Surface
passive.text: Maintain three mirrors with 100 durability each. Their front reflects eligible projectiles; their rear takes normal damage. Reflected attacks gain a visible ownership ring and can never reflect again.

mutation.name: Silver Reversal
mutation.text: Unstable reflection never chains between hostile mirror halls. Every projectile carries a reflected flag, preserving a strict one-reflection ceiling regardless of ownership changes.

sequence: Shard prepares an angle, Guard punishes a shot, and Step changes side. Mirror is weak against area damage and attacks that strike both faces at once.

team.text: A planted mirror can redirect one Laser beam at 80% damage and then breaks. Light reflects without increasing reveal duration or passing through opaque cover.

name: Mist
identity: Mist obscures long sightlines while preserving nearby silhouettes. Cloud supplies platforms and Dark suppresses illumination; Mist creates low, dispersible concealment and tracks condensation.

moves.name: Dew Needle
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Shoot a condensed droplet for 65 damage. Impact creates a 1.5-metre mist patch for 3 seconds. The droplet is visible against dark backgrounds and stops on cover.
moves.p60: Makes a hit reveal condensation on the target for 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Block the droplet or walk out of its small patch.

moves.name: Veil Drift
moves.desc: Move 6 metres while emitting a 3-metre mist trail for 4 seconds. The caster is not invulnerable or fully invisible; close opponents retain the body silhouette.
moves.p60: Allows cancelling movement halfway through while leaving the full trail.
moves.counterplay: Use area attacks or track close silhouettes.

moves.name: Low Fog
moves.desc: Spread a 6-metre-radius, 2-metre-high fog for 6 seconds. It breaks target lock through more than 4 metres of fog but does not affect manual aim or objective markers.
moves.p60: Lets the caster move the fog center 2 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Gain elevation or disperse a corridor with Wind.

moves.name: Condense and Fall
moves.desc: Collapse one mist patch into a 3-metre rain burst for 120 damage and 20% slow for 2 seconds. The patch visibly contracts for 0.7 seconds before striking.
moves.p60: Cleanses one friendly burn inside the burst.
moves.counterplay: Leave the shrinking outline before condensation completes.

moves.name: The Vanishing Shore
moves.desc: Fill a 9-metre field with layered fog for 7 seconds. Three moving condensation fronts deal 80 damage each. Their bright edges remain visible from inside, and gaps provide continuous escape routes.
moves.counterplay: Follow front edges or attack the revealed trail.
moves.unstable: Allows fronts to reverse once but makes the caster's own footprints visible to everyone for 6 seconds.

passive.name: Condensation Trace
passive.text: Enemies sprinting through owned mist leave footprints for 2 seconds. Walking leaves none. The caster can see those footprints only within 12 metres; the effect is not global wall tracking.

mutation.name: Ghost Mist
mutation.text: Unstable fog never hides essential hitboxes. Thermal or reveal effects expose units normally; reduced-visibility settings preserve equal gameplay information rather than making fog harmless.

sequence: Needle tags a route, Low Fog divides sight, and Condense punishes hesitation. Elevation, walking instead of sprinting, and sustained area attacks counter the soft concealment.

team.text: Wind clears a 3-metre corridor through fog for 2 seconds. Electric can jump through one condensed patch at normal range, consuming the patch without additional damage.

name: Mud
identity: Mud slows committed ground movement and buries small constructs. Sand abrades and shifts, while Mud creates sticky routes that can be dried, washed, or escaped vertically.

moves.name: Silt Bomb
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Lob a clump for 75 damage and a 2-metre puddle lasting 4 seconds. The puddle slows 20% but deals no ongoing damage. Multiple puddles do not stack slows.
moves.p60: Lets the puddle spread 1 metre on landing.
moves.counterplay: Jump across or move to dry ground.

moves.name: Quagmire Grip
moves.desc: A visible muddy hand rises after 0.7 seconds for 100 damage and a 0.5-second root. It reaches only 2 metres above ground and cannot grab high-flying targets.
moves.p60: Applies Caked directly on a confirmed hit.
moves.counterplay: Leave the bubbling marker before the hand forms.

moves.name: Mudslide
moves.desc: Surf 8 metres on a mud wave for 80 damage and 2-metre push. Steering is limited on level ground but improves downhill. The wave stops against solid walls.
moves.p60: Carries one small neutral prop as 40 extra shield.
moves.counterplay: Attack from the side or block the lane.

moves.name: Buried Engine
moves.desc: Encase one ordinary ground construct in 160-durability mud for 4 seconds, pausing its automated action. The owner can break the casing to restore it; the underlying construct takes no damage.
moves.p60: Also removes one reinforcement layer from the construct.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the mud shell or use a manual attack.

moves.name: World Without Footing
moves.desc: An 8-metre basin forms for 7 seconds, slowing grounded enemies 25%. Three marked sinkholes pulse for 90 damage each. Sinkholes do not trap indefinitely and leave firm paths between them.
moves.counterplay: Use elevation or exit before the final flood.
moves.unstable: Floods the firm paths for 2 seconds at the end, applying the same slow to the caster and dealing 100 damage.

passive.name: Caked Soles
passive.text: Two Mud hits within 5 seconds apply Caked for 3 seconds, reducing dash distance by 20%. Running speed is unaffected outside Mud pools. A jump on clean ground removes Caked after landing.

mutation.name: Deep Mire
mutation.text: Unstable sinking is a surface effect with a clear floor. No player is buried out of view or held beyond the control cap; the caster can become stranded in its own mud.

sequence: Silt limits dashes, Grip catches a delayed escape, and Slide pushes enemies toward another puddle. Aerial mobility and dry high ground bypass its core advantage.

team.text: Water dilutes Mud, halving slow and extending the slick's area without damage. Fire dries a puddle into 100-durability cracked ground, removing its movement penalty.

name: Music
identity: Music combines timed notes into phrases. Sound manipulates acoustic force directly; Music rewards readable timing and chosen harmony rather than arbitrary audio-dependent reactions.

moves.name: Staccato
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.2 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Fire three note bolts for 25 damage each, spaced 0.2 seconds apart. Casting on beat makes their spacing uniform; off-beat casts retain full damage but a wider spread.
moves.p60: Lets the last note pass through one allied instrument.
moves.counterplay: Move between the short note intervals.

moves.name: Legato Path
moves.desc: Draw an 8-metre staff for 5 seconds. Allies following it gain 12% speed; enemies receive no effect. The staff has two 80-durability end notes that can be destroyed.
moves.p60: Grants one ally 40 shield on completing the path.
moves.counterplay: Break an end note or control the destination.

moves.name: Dissonant Chord
moves.desc: Spend up to three Notes for a cone dealing 60 plus 20 per Note. Three Notes also interrupt channels for 0.25 seconds. It does not mute player communications or alter controls.
moves.p60: Widens the cone by 15 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Backstep the conductor's raised hand.

moves.name: Rest Measure
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 22 | H 7 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Remain still for one full measure to restore 20 Energy and remove 15 Heat. Each direct hit interrupts the rest. Spend one Note to heal 50 at completion, once.
moves.p60: Permits walking at half speed during the rest.
moves.counterplay: Maintain pressure through the recovery measure.

moves.name: Symphony of Four Movements
moves.desc: A 7-metre stage performs four beats: 80 damage outward, 80 shield inward, 90 damage across a lane, then 100 damage in a ring. Every movement previews on the score and floor.
moves.counterplay: Read the score and move between the changing shapes.
moves.unstable: Accelerates the final two movements to 0.6-second intervals but seals Note generation for 6 seconds afterward.

passive.name: Four Beat Measure
passive.text: A visible metronome marks four beats at 0.6-second intervals. Casting within 0.12 seconds of a beat grants one Note, maximum four. Audio is optional; visual and haptic cues carry identical information.

mutation.name: Broken Tempo
mutation.text: The unstable tempo retains at least 0.6 seconds of warning and never requires sound to evade. Multiple musicians cannot stack speed buffs or overlap shield pools beyond global caps.

sequence: Path supports spacing, Staccato earns Notes, and Chord punishes a channel. Enemies who vary their engagement timing can disrupt Music's predictable rhythm windows.

team.text: Sound extends a musical area's radius by 1 metre once. Circus may synchronize paired fireworks to a beat, preserving total damage and every launcher's visible cue.

name: Mystery
identity: Mystery turns observable evidence into a tactical advantage. The opponent can see that a scheme exists, but must infer its purpose. Nothing in this kit depends on secret random rolls, misleading interface elements, or knowledge of the opponent's real identity.

moves.name: Question Mark
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Throw a curved punctuation blade for 70 damage. Against the Subject, it illuminates their footprints for 3 seconds, including the direction of a dash but not their location through solid walls.
moves.p60: Makes the blade return along its original path for 25 damage, once per target.
moves.counterplay: Change direction after the outward throw; its return cannot chase.

moves.name: Sealed Envelope
moves.desc: Choose a snare or shield before placing an 80-durability envelope. A snare opens after a 0.6-second warning for 70 damage and 0.6-second root; a shield opens on allied interaction for 100 shield. Both last 8 seconds.
moves.p60: Permits moving the unopened envelope 3 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the visible envelope or bait its opening from the edge.

moves.name: Cross Examination
moves.desc: Spend one Clue and announce its action type. For 3 seconds, the Subject's next matching action triggers an 80-damage spectral gavel after a 0.5-second tell. The action still completes; avoiding it defeats the wager.
moves.p60: Refunds 8 Energy if the prediction proves correct.
moves.counterplay: Use a different action or dodge the gavel after triggering it.

moves.name: Missing Piece
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 20 | H 7 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Leave a conspicuous silhouette for 4 seconds and sidestep up to 5 metres. You gain no invisibility. Recasting returns you to the silhouette if a clear route remains; taking direct damage destroys the return option.
moves.p60: Extends the return window by 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Watch the real movement trail and deny the marked return point.

moves.name: The Final Deduction
moves.desc: Spend all Clues. Three evidence circles appear around the Subject's current position, detonating in their announced order for 80 damage each. Each spent Clue widens one circle by 0.5 metres. Their centres lock before the first strike.
moves.counterplay: Leave the fixed circles; the evidence does not follow its suspect.
moves.unstable: Adds a fourth 90-damage conclusion circle, but reveals your location to the Subject for 8 seconds.

passive.name: Case File
passive.text: The first enemy to damage you becomes your Subject for 10 seconds. Witnessing their dash, guard, or projectile produces the corresponding Clue, once each. Clues are visible as three symbols above your hand; maximum three. Changing Subject clears them.

mutation.name: Unsolved Case
mutation.text: The fourth circle has its own 0.8-second warning. A defeated Subject does not transfer Clues to another enemy. Information effects never fabricate damage numbers or system notifications.

sequence: Gather Clues while spacing with Question Mark. Announce a dash prediction, then threaten an envelope to force a choice. Patient opponents can refuse the expected response and make your preparation expire.

team.text: Illusion can distract from an envelope but cannot hide its warning. Psychic can move an unopened envelope within its placement range; doing so exposes its selected type.

name: Nature
identity: Nature maintains a small ecosystem whose components support one another. Plant builds structures, Flower deploys specialized blooms, and Life stimulates living bodies; Nature's strength is the relationship between terrain, shelter, and creatures.

moves.name: Canopy Seed
moves.desc: Plant a 160-durability tree that unfolds a 4-metre canopy after 1 second and lasts 10 seconds. The canopy blocks overhead projectiles but not lateral shots; its trunk provides narrow physical cover.
moves.p60: Gives allies beneath it 40 shield once on entry.
moves.counterplay: Attack laterally or cut down the trunk.

moves.name: Spring Run
moves.desc: Release a shallow, 8-metre stream lasting 7 seconds. Allies moving downstream gain 12% speed. Enemies crossing upstream are slowed 15%; the stream cannot carry unwilling bodies or flood enclosed rooms.
moves.p60: Cleanses one Burn application on first allied entry.
moves.counterplay: Cross sideways rather than pushing against the current.

moves.name: Guardian Wildlife
moves.desc: Summon two 70-health spectral deer for 6 seconds. They intercept one hostile projectile each, then vanish. They do not attack, scout through walls, or occupy objectives; their paths remain inside the grove.
moves.p60: Lets the surviving deer heal one ally for 40 at expiry.
moves.counterplay: Use low-cost shots to expend the guardians before committing.

moves.name: Season Turn
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 26 | H 11 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Choose spring or autumn for 5 seconds. Spring makes the grove heal allies for 15 per second; autumn sheds a leaf screen that reduces enemy sight across its boundary. The season affects an 8-metre area around you.
moves.p60: Allows one season change without extending the duration.
moves.counterplay: Displace the keeper or destroy components to dismantle the safe area.

moves.name: Ancient Sanctuary
moves.desc: An ancient 400-durability tree establishes a 9-metre sanctuary for 8 seconds. Three roots provide 100-durability cover, while allies gain 20 healing per second. At expiry, remaining roots release 70-damage outward waves individually.
moves.counterplay: Destroy roots before their announced release or attack the central tree.
moves.unstable: Makes the roots release their waves early and regrow once, but halves sanctuary healing.

passive.name: Living Balance
passive.text: Your grove can contain one canopy, one stream, and one wildlife marker. Each different living component grants allies inside the grove 3% damage resistance, maximum 9%. Destroyed components remove their contribution immediately.

mutation.name: Wild Season
mutation.text: Regrown roots inherit the original expiry time and cannot create a second sanctuary. Sanctuary healing and seasonal healing share the global healing limit rather than multiplying without bound.

sequence: Canopy blocks one approach, Spring Run supplies an exit, and wildlife spends the enemy's first shots. Nature loses efficiency when forced to abandon its established ground or defend from several sides.

team.text: Water can refresh Spring Run by 2 seconds once. A Flower bloom inside the grove counts as wildlife only if Guardian Wildlife is absent, preserving the three-component resistance cap.

name: Nightmare
tagline: Dread buildup and threatening false shapes
identity: Nightmare pressures decisions with escalating dread. Its frightening imagery never removes the player's controls, injects fake crashes, or creates untelegraphed damage. The central question is whether an apparent threat has become physically real.

moves.name: Under the Bed
moves.statline: CD 8 s | E 16 | H 6 | W 0.4 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: A claw slides along the floor, visibly rippling before emerging for 75 damage. It cannot climb a wall or strike airborne targets more than 2 metres above its route.
moves.p60: Leaves a second harmless ripple that ends with an unmistakable hollow outline.
moves.counterplay: Jump the actual ripple or step sideways before its emergence.

moves.name: Watching Eyes
moves.desc: Place three 50-durability eyes along a 6-metre line for 7 seconds. An eye watches a 60-degree cone; an enemy staying inside for 1 second gains one Dread stack, once per eye.
moves.p60: Lets one surviving eye turn 45 degrees on recast.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the eyes or move across their sightlines quickly.

moves.name: False Awakening
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 24 | H 9 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Create a motionless dream-double and dash 5 metres. After 0.8 seconds, the double lunges 4 metres for 95 damage. Its solid outline appears before the lunge; hitting it first cancels the attack.
moves.p60: Gives the double 100 health instead of 60.
moves.counterplay: Strike the double during its formation or avoid its straight lunge.

moves.name: Weight of Dread
moves.desc: Consume a target's Dread stacks. Each causes 35 damage and 0.25 seconds of root, up to 105 damage and 0.75 seconds. A visible tether must maintain line of sight throughout windup.
moves.p60: Refunds one stack if the target had three.
moves.counterplay: Break sight before the tether tightens or cleanse Dread beforehand.

moves.name: The Room That Follows
moves.desc: Four freestanding doorframes surround a fixed 7-metre area for 7 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds one frame becomes solid and sends a 90-damage creature across the room. A lit lintel announces the active frame 0.7 seconds early.
moves.counterplay: Move through the open spaces between frames and track the lit lintels.
moves.unstable: Activates two opposite frames on the final beat, but leaves you rooted during that beat.

passive.name: Dread Gauge
passive.text: Your direct abilities apply one Dread stack for 6 seconds, maximum three per enemy. At three, your real constructs gain a distinct solid outline to that enemy and your next hit deals 30 bonus damage, consuming all stacks.

mutation.name: Waking Terror
mutation.text: The room has no ceiling, invisible walls, compulsory camera changes, or full-screen obstruction. Its creatures hit once and cannot apply fresh Dread; the ultimate cannot perpetuate itself.

sequence: Eyes shape approach routes; claws punish predictable crossings; Weight cashes out preparation. Enemies who remove surveillance and interrupt sightlines deny your strongest conversions.

team.text: Dream can wake a sleeping ally to remove one Dread stack. Dark strengthens the visual silhouette of Nightmare attacks but never hides their solid-phase warning.

name: Normal
identity: Normal uses no exotic material, hidden damage immunity, or automatic superiority over supernatural powers. It wins by preserving Energy, varying timing, and punishing obvious commitments with reliable, modest techniques.

moves.name: Straight Strike
moves.statline: CD 5 s | E 10 | H 3 | W 0.2 s | R 3 m
moves.desc: Deliver a direct 80-damage punch with a 0.25-second recovery. It has no armor penetration, lunge correction, or concealed status effect. Its short commitment makes it a dependable punish.
moves.p60: Adds 25 guard damage if the strike is blocked.
moves.counterplay: Stay outside arm's reach or parry the single contact.

moves.name: Practical Step
moves.statline: CD 9 s | E 12 | H 4 | W 0.1 s | R self
moves.desc: Step 4 metres in a chosen direction without invulnerability. The first 0.2 seconds ignores slows but not roots or walls. Your facing remains unchanged so you can retreat while watching the opponent.
moves.p60: Shortens its recovery from 0.3 to 0.15 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Aim along the visible step rather than at its starting position.

moves.name: Firm Guard
moves.statline: CD 14 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.15 s | R self
moves.desc: Brace for 0.8 seconds. The first frontal direct hit deals 60% less damage and restores 15 guard. You cannot attack during the brace; subsequent hits receive ordinary guarding rules.
moves.p60: Also prevents that first hit's knockback.
moves.counterplay: Feint, attack from the side, or use a low-value opener.

moves.name: Opportunist
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.4 s | R 5 m
moves.desc: Lunge 3 metres and strike for 90 damage. If the target is currently in the recovery of an ability, add 45 damage. The bonus checks the target's actual recovery state, not a hidden prediction.
moves.p60: Marks a successful punish target for 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Cancel only actions that permit cancellation, or avoid whiffing long recoveries.

moves.name: Perfect Execution
moves.statline: CD 80 s | E 35 | H 30 | W 0.7 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 8 seconds, your four normal abilities cost 6 less Energy and each first successful hit or block reduces the cooldown of a different normal ability by 2 seconds. Each ability can trigger this once; damage does not increase.
moves.counterplay: Deny clean hits and force wasted actions instead of trading into the sequence.
moves.unstable: Resets Practical Step once, but prevents Energy regeneration until the window ends.

passive.name: Good Fundamentals
passive.text: Using a different ability from your previous cast refunds 4 Energy after that action finishes. Repeating a move is allowed but earns nothing. Ultimates, copied casts, and interrupted actions do not produce the refund.

mutation.name: Overextension
mutation.text: The extra step retains its collision and recovery rules. Normal never disables an opponent's element or turns their ultimate into a basic attack; its advantage remains disciplined resource use.

sequence: Step to make a heavy attack miss, use Opportunist during recovery, and protect the exit with Firm Guard. Long-range zoning and patient guard play limit Normal's access to profitable exchanges.

team.text: Defensive can create the safe approach Normal lacks. Fight can force a predictable recovery, but a shared punish still obeys control limits and does not grant duplicate Proxima rewards.

name: Nuclear
tagline: Fictional reactor management and delayed zones
identity: Nuclear is a fantasy reactor kit built around visible containment, scheduled bursts, and hazardous ground. Its terms describe game effects, not real nuclear processes, materials, or construction methods.

moves.name: Fission Spark
moves.statline: CD 8 s | E 18 | H 8 | W 0.5 s | R 24 m
moves.desc: Launch a slow green-white orb for 90 damage. On striking terrain, it splits into two weaker arcs for 25 each. A target can take the central hit or the arcs, never both.
moves.p60: Lets you choose the split direction at release.
moves.counterplay: Move away from the central trajectory and read the fork before impact.

moves.name: Containment Vessel
moves.desc: Place a 180-durability vessel for 8 seconds. Its 3-metre field absorbs up to 120 projectile damage, then cracks and stops functioning. Destroying it creates only a harmless warning flash.
moves.p60: Allows reclaiming an undamaged vessel for 10 Energy.
moves.counterplay: Break it with sustained fire or approach around its limited coverage.

moves.name: Fallout Mark
moves.desc: A painted 4-metre circle activates after 1 second and lasts 5 seconds, dealing 20 damage per second. Leaving stops damage immediately; it applies no persistent illness or invisible long-term penalty.
moves.p60: Lets the circle drift 2 metres toward a visible pointer once.
moves.counterplay: Leave the marked ground before activation and avoid re-entry.

moves.name: Controlled Vent
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 20 | H 0 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Channel for 1.2 seconds, removing 30 Heat while releasing three narrow steam jets for 25 damage each. The jets rotate at a fixed rate. Being interrupted stops remaining cooling and jets.
moves.p60: Broadens the safe gaps between jets for allied passage without changing damage.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the vent or attack through the visible safe gaps.

moves.name: Sun in a Cage
moves.desc: A 300-durability reactor forms inside a 7-metre warning circle. After 2 seconds it releases a 180-damage ring, then a second 120-damage ring 1.2 seconds later. Breaking the reactor before either pulse cancels remaining pulses.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the reactor or cross the outgoing ring and leave before the collapse.
moves.unstable: Trades the second ring for a 200-damage inward collapse with its own 1-second warning.

passive.name: Containment Rings
passive.text: Three luminous rings surround your reactor. Each damaging ability opens one ring for 6 seconds. At three open rings, your next ability gains 20 damage but adds 8 Heat, then closes all rings. The state is visible to both teams.

mutation.name: Containment Failure
mutation.text: The unstable collapse can damage the caster and does not pull targets. All radioactive-looking residue expires with its listed zone; no contamination survives a round or affects real players.

sequence: A vessel buys the time needed to mark territory and vent safely. Fast divers exploit the long windups, while ranged teams can destroy your reactor before it delivers its full sequence.

team.text: Defensive can shelter the reactor without increasing its health. Void may cancel one ordinary reactor projectile, but cannot erase the entire ultimate or turn its damage into stored Energy.

name: Paper
identity: Paper converts thin sheets into tools with very different shapes. Its structures are quick to deploy and tactically flexible, but they remain visibly fragile; a beautiful fold is not an excuse for steel-level durability.

moves.name: Razor Letter
moves.desc: Flick a folded dart for 65 damage. It can pass through a gap as narrow as its actual projectile model, but cannot ignore a closed wall. Its flat trajectory makes lateral movement effective.
moves.p60: Lets the dart unfold after a terrain hit into a 40-durability visual marker.
moves.counterplay: Dodge sideways or intercept it with any solid cover.

moves.name: Accordion Wall
moves.desc: Unfold a zigzag wall with three 70-durability panels, lasting 7 seconds. Each panel blocks projectiles independently; destroying one leaves an actual gap. It cannot pin or push a character.
moves.p60: Allows one surviving panel to rotate 45 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Break one panel to open a firing lane.

moves.name: Origami Crane
moves.desc: Create a 90-health crane carrying one willing ally up to 8 metres horizontally and 3 metres vertically. The rider can dismount at any moment. Breaking the crane releases the rider into ordinary falling.
moves.p60: Grants a 1-second slow fall after dismount.
moves.counterplay: Shoot the visible crane or control its landing point.

moves.name: Paper Seal
moves.desc: Attach a seal with a projectile that deals 40 damage. After 1 second it unfolds into ribbons, slowing the target 25% for 2 seconds. Guarding the initial seal prevents attachment.
moves.p60: Makes the seal reveal the target during its unfolding.
moves.counterplay: Block the seal or cleanse it before the ribbons open.

moves.name: Thousand Fold Citadel
moves.desc: Six 120-durability folds rise around a 6-metre area as ramps, shutters, and bridges for 8 seconds. Select two folds to launch as 85-damage birds; launched folds cease being cover. No fold encloses an enemy completely.
moves.counterplay: Break key folds or exploit the openings created when cover becomes ammunition.
moves.unstable: Launches all surviving folds, but destroys every remaining piece of your paper terrain.

passive.name: Crease Memory
passive.text: Completing a different fold from your previous ability grants one Crease, maximum three. Spend a Crease by holding a normal cast for 0.25 seconds to reduce its Energy cost by 5. Creases expire after 8 seconds without folding.

mutation.name: Unfolding Collapse
mutation.text: Launched birds maintain a 0.6-second warning and each target can take at most three hits. Water or Fire destroys paper according to the explicit interaction rule, not an unbounded elemental multiplier.

sequence: Build a partial wall, seal a predictable approach, then use the crane to change elevation. Sustained area attacks dismantle your low-durability geometry before its flexibility pays off.

team.text: Ink can write one ordinary Ink mark on a Paper panel. Water touching a panel reduces its remaining durability by 40 once per Water cast; it does not instantly erase the entire citadel.

name: Phoenix
tagline: Recovery windows and one vulnerable rebirth
identity: Phoenix survives by preparing an escape from defeat, not by ignoring it. Its rebirth is a visible, destructible commitment that consumes an ultimate; an eliminated player cannot repeatedly return through passive effects.

moves.name: Cinder Wing
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R 12 m
moves.desc: Sweep a wing through a 70-degree cone for 75 damage and create a 3-metre backward hop. The hop has collision and no invulnerability; striking an obstacle ends it early.
moves.p60: Leaves a 30-damage feather where the hop began, igniting after 0.7 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Stay outside the cone or follow after the feather detonates.

moves.name: Ashen Ascent
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 20 | H 8 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Rise 4 metres, then glide for up to 2 seconds at walking speed. You can steer but cannot cast the ultimate while airborne. Landing creates a harmless ash ring that indicates your recovery.
moves.p60: Permits one aerial Cinder Wing without adding altitude.
moves.counterplay: Track the glide's limited speed and punish the landing.

moves.name: Warmth of Return
moves.desc: Spend up to 30 Embers to place a 120-durability feather for 6 seconds. A willing ally can claim it for 60 healing plus 2 healing per Ember spent. It does not revive an eliminated ally.
moves.p60: Lets the feather remove one Burn on claim.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the visible feather before it is collected.

moves.name: Searing Descent
moves.desc: Dive toward a marked landing point, dealing 100 damage in a 3-metre circle. Starting at least 3 metres above ground adds 30 damage. The landing locks 0.5 seconds before impact.
moves.p60: Restores 10 Embers if the elevated version hits.
moves.counterplay: Move after the circle locks or interrupt the takeoff.

moves.name: Second Dawn
moves.statline: CD 95 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.2 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: Create a 250-health cocoon at your feet for 6 seconds. If you would be defeated within 10 metres of it, become the cocoon for 2 seconds; surviving restores you at 250 health and destroys it. No trigger means it expires unused.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the cocoon before the lethal hit or during the emergence channel.
moves.unstable: Restores 400 health instead, but reduces cocoon health to 150 and forbids movement for 1 second after emergence.

passive.name: Ember Reserve
passive.text: Dealing direct damage stores 10 Embers, at most once per cast, maximum 50. After 3 seconds without taking damage, consume 10 Embers per second to heal 15. Embers grant no damage or life-steal bonus.

mutation.name: Ashbound Rebirth
mutation.text: Only one rescue can occur per ultimate. Cocoon destruction defeats the Phoenix; allies cannot heal it, and the rescue restores no Energy, Proxima, Embers, cooldowns, or objective possession. Burnout follows emergence or cocoon expiry.

sequence: Earn Embers safely, place the cocoon behind accessible cover, then contest within its radius. Displacement beyond 10 metres and coordinated cocoon damage defeat the rescue without requiring anti-healing.

team.text: Fire can reveal the cocoon with its lighting but cannot recharge it. Heal may heal the emerged Phoenix normally; it cannot target the cocoon or rewind its consumed rescue.

name: Plant
identity: Plant constructs connected vines, roots, and flexible supports. Its defining mechanic is growth along existing connections; isolated structures work, but a visible root network improves deployment without granting control of every plant on the map.

moves.name: Vine Lash
moves.desc: Whip a visible vine for 80 damage. A terrain hit can anchor the vine for 3 seconds; recasting pulls you up to 5 metres toward it. It never pulls an enemy through cover.
moves.p60: Increases anchor duration to 5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the lash or watch the anchored route.

moves.name: Root Lattice
moves.desc: Grow three 90-durability roots across a 5-metre area for 7 seconds. Crossing a root deals 25 damage and slows 20% for 1 second, once per root per target. The roots are low and jumpable.
moves.p60: Makes one root 30 durability tougher.
moves.counterplay: Jump the lattice or break a root to open a path.

moves.name: Living Trellis
moves.desc: Raise a 220-durability, 4-metre climbing frame for 8 seconds. Anyone may climb it; allies climb 20% faster. Its openings allow narrow shots through, so it is support rather than a solid wall.
moves.p60: Lets its upper branch bend once to form a short bridge.
moves.counterplay: Use its openings or destroy the base before a climb finishes.

moves.name: Grafting Hand
moves.desc: Transfer up to 120 durability from one own Plant structure to another, preserving total durability. The donor remains at least 1 durability. A 0.8-second glowing connection must stay unobstructed.
moves.p60: Transfers instantly after the initial windup.
moves.counterplay: Break sight between the structures or attack the weakened donor.

moves.name: City of Roots
moves.desc: Five 160-durability root arches grow sequentially across an 8-metre zone. Each emergence deals 60 damage after a 0.7-second ground warning. They last 8 seconds and form traversable ramps with at least two open exits.
moves.counterplay: Evade each emergence, then break or climb the remaining architecture.
moves.unstable: Lets you uproot two arches into 90-damage rolling tangles, sacrificing those paths.

passive.name: Root Network
passive.text: Your structures connect when within 6 metres and unobstructed along the ground. A normal ability placed beside a connected structure grows 0.2 seconds faster. Maximum four structures; replacing one visibly withers the oldest.

mutation.name: Untamed Growth
mutation.text: Ultimate arches temporarily replace the four-structure cap but do not multiply ordinary growth sites. Tangled roots stop at solid terrain and cannot squeeze through doors narrower than their hitbox.

sequence: Lattice controls the floor while Trellis supplies elevation. Graft durability into the structure under pressure, but watch the donor. Area damage and vertical attackers bypass the value of interconnected ground positions.

team.text: Nature's stream can bridge one broken network gap of up to 2 metres. Thorn can coat one root with its own damage budget; crossing it does not duplicate both kits' maximum damage on every frame.

name: Plasma
identity: Plasma shapes a brilliant, energized medium inside magnetic-looking fantasy constraints. It excels at sustained pressure and short-lived bridges between charged targets, but cannot automatically electrocute everything in the environment.

moves.name: Ion Needle
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 14 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R 24 m
moves.desc: Fire a bright needle for 70 damage. Holding for an additional 0.5 seconds narrows its width and increases damage to 90, while creating a visible aiming line. It pierces no terrain.
moves.p60: Lets the charged needle pierce one enemy for 45 damage to a second.
moves.counterplay: Use cover or move after the charge line appears.

moves.name: Magnetic Bottle
moves.desc: Deploy a 140-durability bottle for 7 seconds. Your next Plasma projectile entering it is stored for up to 3 seconds, then released in a direction chosen on recast with the original damage budget.
moves.p60: Lets the stored shot wait 2 seconds longer.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the bottle; the stored shot dissipates harmlessly.

moves.name: Filament Bridge
moves.desc: Connect two visible ground points no more than 8 metres apart. The filament lasts 4 seconds and deals 35 damage per second to enemies crossing its 0.8-metre width. It does not home or form through walls.
moves.p60: Permits moving one endpoint 2 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Cross quickly, jump over it, or avoid the thin line entirely.

moves.name: Corona Skin
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 25 | H 10 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Gain 100 shield for 4 seconds. When an enemy lands a melee hit, discharge 30 damage to that attacker, at most three times total. The shield provides no reflected projectile damage.
moves.p60: Preserves one unspent discharge for 1 second after the shield breaks.
moves.counterplay: Use ranged pressure or spend a light attack to remove a discharge.

moves.name: Contained Starfire
moves.desc: A 5-metre sphere forms for 5 seconds, dealing 35 damage per second to enemies inside. Three 100-durability anchors hold it in place; destroying two collapses it. The centre remains fixed and the boundary visibly pulses.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the remaining anchors or leave the sphere before sustained damage accumulates.
moves.unstable: Removes one anchor and raises tick damage to 45, making the sphere easier to collapse.

passive.name: Containment Charge
passive.text: Normal ability hits grant one Charge, maximum three, once per cast. Three Charges turn your next Plasma ability into a contained cast that adds 20 damage and 5 Heat, then clears the Charges. Misses preserve them.

mutation.name: Loss of Containment
mutation.text: Collapse releases no surprise explosion. A stored projectile cannot be stored again, and Filament Bridge never treats allies, summons, or scenery as extra damage multipliers.

sequence: Bottle changes a needle's firing angle while Filament restricts a crossing. Shield protects a brief close exchange. Plasma's setup objects and fixed lines are vulnerable to deliberate dismantling.

team.text: Electric can illuminate Plasma anchors through allied visual clutter but cannot charge them indefinitely. Crystal can redirect one needle, retaining its original hit cap and total damage.

name: Poison
identity: Poison attacks a target's condition over time. Acid attacks equipment and surfaces; Poison needs sustained exposure and can be interrupted by leaving a zone, cleansing, or denying the next application.

moves.name: Venom Fang
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 10 m
moves.desc: Strike with a narrow fang projectile for 55 direct damage and one Load. Against a target already at four Loads, it deals 20 additional direct damage but adds no extra tick frequency.
moves.p60: Increases projectile range by 4 metres.
moves.counterplay: Block the application or use distance to outlast existing Load.

moves.name: Spore Ampoule
moves.desc: Throw a visible ampoule that creates a 3-metre cloud for 5 seconds. Remaining inside for 1 full second adds one Load, up to two applications per target from that cloud. Brief crossings do not apply it.
moves.p60: Expands the radius by 0.5 metres.
moves.counterplay: Leave before the exposure timer completes or destroy the airborne ampoule.

moves.name: Antidote Exchange
moves.statline: CD 18 s | E 23 | H 6 | W 0.6 s | R 8 m
moves.desc: Remove poison from yourself or one willing ally, then grant 60 shield for 3 seconds. If a poison effect was removed, create an 80-durability antidote vial that another ally can claim for one cleanse.
moves.p60: Raises the shield to 90.
moves.counterplay: Pressure the recovery window or destroy the dropped vial.

moves.name: Catalyst Pin
moves.desc: A pin deals 70 direct damage and consumes all Load on the target for 25 damage per stack. The effect cashes out existing exposure; it does not also retain the consumed damage-over-time stacks.
moves.p60: Returns one Load after a four-stack cashout.
moves.counterplay: Cleanse before the pin lands, block it, or make its narrow shot miss.

moves.name: Garden of Venom
moves.desc: Four 100-durability pods open around a 7-metre zone for 7 seconds. Each releases a 40-damage puff every 2 seconds, applying one Load. A target can receive only one puff hit per beat regardless of overlapping pods.
moves.counterplay: Break pods to create an exit, then leave before the next synchronized release.
moves.unstable: Lets pods advance inward by 2 metres, but removes their first puff and exposes the caster to their direct damage.

passive.name: Toxic Load
passive.text: Your listed poison effects add one Load, maximum four. Each Load deals 5 damage per second for 5 seconds; new applications refresh duration but not the tick clock. A cleanse removes all Load. No effect spreads between players automatically.

mutation.name: Toxic Bloom
mutation.text: The unstable garden does not apply real illness, permanent debuffs, or unavoidable post-round damage. Defeat, round end, or an appropriate cleanse removes every remaining Load.

sequence: Use a cloud to make a route expensive, apply fangs when an enemy chooses it, then cash out before a cleanse. Burst-focused teams can end exchanges before your gradual damage reaches meaningful value.

team.text: Wind can shift one cloud 3 metres, consuming that cloud's remaining duration normally. Heal's designated cleanse removes Load; ordinary healing restores health without silently deleting poison.

name: Power
identity: Power specializes in moving weight and delivering deliberate, physical impact. Fight rewards technique and counters; Power rewards positioning before a heavy commitment. Strength does not grant immunity to displacement, limitless lifting, or control of protected map structures.

moves.name: Heavy Hand
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 16 | H 6 | W 0.5 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Deliver a visibly wound-up punch for 110 damage, pushing the target 2 metres. A miss leaves 0.6 seconds of recovery. The fist does not curve toward a target who sidesteps after release.
moves.p60: Adds a 30-damage floor shock behind the impact, excluding the initial target.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the shoulder windup or punish the long recovery.

moves.name: Lift and Carry
moves.statline: CD 14 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.6 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Lift one designated movable prop or your own debris weighing up to the game's heavy-prop class. Carry it for 4 seconds as 150-durability frontal cover, then throw it up to 10 metres for 100 damage.
moves.p60: Permits one jump while carrying, capped at ordinary jump height.
moves.counterplay: Attack from the rear or destroy the carried cover.

moves.name: Ground Breaker
moves.statline: CD 18 s | E 27 | H 11 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Strike the ground, releasing a 6-metre cone for 100 damage and a 0.5-second lift. The wave travels along the floor and stops at a major ledge; it does not hit high airborne targets.
moves.p60: Widens the cone by 15 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Jump above the wave or move around its announced cone.

moves.name: Iron Grip
moves.desc: Attempt a short, guardable grab. On success, hold the target for 0.5 seconds, then throw them 4 metres for 110 damage. Both characters remain vulnerable; interruption releases the target without the throw.
moves.p60: Lets you choose a sideward rather than forward throw.
moves.counterplay: Backstep the reaching hand, block it, or interrupt from outside the grab.

moves.name: Atlas Moment
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.2 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: Tear up a temporary 6-metre platform of conjured stone, lifting nearby enemies only 1 metre. After a further 0.8-second warning, slam it for 220 damage in a 5-metre circle. The platform never removes real map flooring.
moves.counterplay: Leave the raised platform before the slam or punish the exposed lift.
moves.unstable: Permits throwing the platform 6 metres instead, but adds 0.5 seconds of visible aiming time.

passive.name: Set Your Feet
passive.text: Remaining grounded without dashing for 1 second grants Braced. Your next Power hit deals 20 additional guard damage and resists light knockback during its active frames. Moving normally preserves Braced; jumping, dashing, or using it clears the state.

mutation.name: Beyond the Limit
mutation.text: The platform has a fixed mass and footprint; it cannot carry objectives, detach buildings, or create permanent pits. After an unstable throw, Burnout begins on impact or on interrupted release.

sequence: Carry cover to gain ground, brace before committing, and throw enemies toward a known follow-up lane. Fast lateral movement, aerial attackers, and failed-grab punishment exploit Power's readable commitments.

team.text: Rock may supply an eligible loose boulder for Lift and Carry, preserving that boulder's existing damage budget. Agility can exploit a throw's landing window without extending its control duration.

name: Pulse
identity: Pulse sends discrete expansions through space. Unlike Sound, it does not manipulate resonance or hearing; unlike Music, it does not require musical timing. Its gameplay is reading ring positions and deciding which distance to occupy next.

moves.name: Expanding Ring
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Release a ring that expands from 1 to 8 metres over 0.8 seconds, dealing 75 damage once per enemy. The centre is safe after the ring passes; solid cover blocks the segment behind it.
moves.p60: Increases maximum radius to 10 metres without changing travel speed.
moves.counterplay: Dash through after the ring passes or shelter behind a solid obstacle.

moves.name: Compression Point
moves.desc: Place a 2-metre point that contracts after 0.8 seconds for 85 damage and a 1.5-metre inward pull. The pull ends at collision and cannot drag a target through another player.
moves.p60: Adds a second harmless aiming circle showing the final safe boundary.
moves.counterplay: Leave the marked point before contraction or break line of sight during placement.

moves.name: Counterpulse
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 24 | H 9 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: A 3-metre shell lasts 0.35 seconds. It destroys the first ordinary incoming projectile and sends a 60-damage pulse back along that projectile's direction. Beams and ultimate projectiles are not destroyed.
moves.p60: Extends the shell to 0.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Bait it with a weak projectile or use a beam or melee approach.

moves.name: Double Interval
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 26 | H 10 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend up to two Echoes. Release an outward wave for 65 damage, then an inward wave for 65 damage after 0.9 seconds. Each Echo adds 1 metre to their shared maximum radius, starting at 6 metres.
moves.p60: Lets you delay the inward wave by up to 0.4 seconds, visibly pausing its rim.
moves.counterplay: Move outside the maximum radius or time crossings between the waves.

moves.name: Heart of the Battlefield
moves.desc: A stationary 8-metre field emits four alternating rings at 1-second intervals: outward, inward, outward, inward. Each deals 75 damage once. The next direction is displayed by arrows on the centre and rim.
moves.counterplay: Read each direction and avoid standing where the rings reverse.
moves.unstable: Allows moving the centre 3 metres between the second and third rings, with a 0.8-second relocation preview.

passive.name: Wave Memory
passive.text: A normal ability that hits an enemy with its outermost 1-metre band grants one Echo, maximum three. Echoes last 7 seconds. Only the first hit of each cast qualifies; damage-over-time cannot generate them repeatedly.

mutation.name: Arrhythmic Core
mutation.text: Moving the centre does not teleport a damaging ring onto a target. The relocation suspends damage until the preview finishes, and no target can take repeated hits from the same ring.

sequence: Use Compression Point to encourage an outward dodge, then catch its endpoint with the edge of Expanding Ring. Uneven terrain and hard cover fragment your circles and create exploitable safe pockets.

team.text: Gravity may slow a ring's travel by 15% inside its zone without changing damage. Sound can make the next ring direction audible, but equivalent visual cues remain mandatory.

name: Psychic
identity: Psychic manipulates a limited set of visible objects and short mental links. It cannot read private thoughts, seize a player's controls, or move a target through a solid obstacle. Its best effects require attention that an opponent can disrupt.

moves.name: Mind Lance
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 16 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R 22 m
moves.desc: Fire a straight telekinetic dart for 75 damage. Consume one orbiting stone to add a second 30-damage shard 0.2 seconds later along the same line. No stone means only the dart fires.
moves.p60: Lets the shard use a slightly adjusted aim within 10 degrees.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep both aligned shots or use cover to break their lane.

moves.name: Levitate Object
moves.desc: Lift one eligible loose prop for 4 seconds. It has 120 effective durability and can be positioned within 6 metres of you as cover. Recast throws it 10 metres for 90 damage; protected scenery is ineligible.
moves.p60: Allows rotating the prop once without releasing it.
moves.counterplay: Break the floating prop or attack from outside its coverage.

moves.name: Mental Thread
moves.desc: Maintain a visible link to an enemy for up to 2 seconds. While linked, they are slowed 20%; completing the full link deals 90 damage. Taking a direct hit or losing sight ends the link.
moves.p60: Refunds 8 Energy if the link completes.
moves.counterplay: Break sight or hit the caster to interrupt concentration.

moves.name: Repulsion Palm
moves.desc: Release a 90-degree cone for 80 damage and 3-metre knockback. Spend all remaining orbiting stones for 10 additional damage each. The push cannot become a stun by repeatedly pressing someone into a wall.
moves.p60: Restores one stone if the cone hits at least two real enemies.
moves.counterplay: Approach from another angle or bait the palm before committing.

moves.name: Crown of Thought
moves.desc: Six 60-health stones form around a fixed 6-metre zone. Over 5 seconds, select three to launch for 90 damage each; unused stones provide interceptable cover. Each launch displays its trajectory for 0.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Destroy stones, exploit announced lines, or interrupt the rooted caster.
moves.unstable: Launches all six in opposite pairs, but roots the caster during the 2-second sequence.

passive.name: Focus Orbit
passive.text: Hold up to three small, conjured stones in orbit. One forms after 2 seconds without taking direct damage. Stones visibly indicate your reserve; firing an ability that consumes them empties the corresponding orbit slots.

mutation.name: Mental Overreach
mutation.text: A target can take at most three stone hits from the unstable sequence. Psychic control of an object never grants that object's owner's abilities, stored charges, or objective interaction permissions.

sequence: Float cover to protect a thread, then use Palm when the enemy closes. Rapid chip damage denies orbit replenishment, while flankers can break concentration without entering your strongest frontal tools.

team.text: Rock supplies clearly eligible loose stones, not entire formations. Moving Mystery's envelope exposes its selected effect, trading concealment for a better position.

name: Rainbow
tagline: Seven chosen hues and a restrained spectrum
identity: Rainbow cycles through a fixed spectrum with small, legible properties. It does not gain seven complete elemental kits. The player chooses when to advance, while opponents can always read the active colour and anticipate its modest effect.

moves.name: Spectrum Bolt
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 13 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 20 m
moves.desc: Fire a vivid bolt for 65 damage carrying the current hue's property. Defensive properties trigger only if the bolt hits a real enemy; missing still advances the wheel, allowing deliberate colour planning at an Energy cost.
moves.p60: Lets the bolt retain a 0.5-metre-wide trail for 0.3 seconds, with no extra hits.
moves.counterplay: Watch the colour and sidestep the narrow projectile.

moves.name: Prism Skip
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 19 | H 6 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: Dash 5 metres, leaving a harmless ribbon. Hold the input for 0.4 seconds before dashing to skip one extra hue. Green and blue activate on a completed dash; offensive hue properties have no target and do nothing.
moves.p60: Grants 0.5 seconds of slow resistance after landing.
moves.counterplay: Track the ribbon and punish the delayed held version.

moves.name: Colour Panel
moves.desc: Create a 130-durability panel for 6 seconds. One own Spectrum Bolt passing through splits into two 40-damage rays; a target can take only one. The panel keeps the hue present when it was placed.
moves.p60: Lets one allied Laser use the panel while preserving that laser's total damage budget.
moves.counterplay: Break the panel or move outside its two announced exit lines.

moves.name: White Balance
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 25 | H 9 | W 0.7 s | R self
moves.desc: Reset the wheel to any chosen hue and gain 80 shield for 3 seconds. This ability neither applies a hue property nor advances the wheel. Its long recovery exposes careless mid-combat colour selection.
moves.p60: Also removes one minor slow.
moves.counterplay: Attack during selection or wait out the shield before re-engaging.

moves.name: Sevenfold Horizon
moves.desc: Seven coloured lanes appear across a 7-metre field, firing in spectrum order at 0.5-second intervals for 45 damage each. Each lane applies its hue property to its first valid target; a target can take at most four lane hits.
moves.counterplay: Read the numbered lane order and move into lanes that already fired.
moves.unstable: Reverses the last three lanes' order after a clear 0.8-second pause, then locks the wheel on white for 5 seconds with no hue bonuses.

passive.name: Seven Hue Wheel
passive.text: Start red; each completed normal cast advances one hue. Red adds 15 direct damage; orange adds 10 guard damage; yellow adds 2 metres to projectiles; green heals you 15; blue grants 20 shield; indigo reveals hit enemies 1 second; violet slows them 10% for 1 second. Apply once per cast.

mutation.name: Colourless Afterimage
mutation.text: Unstable white is a penalty state, not access to all seven effects. The spectrum always includes symbols and ordering cues so colour vision is never required to identify mechanics.

sequence: Plan blue before entry, indigo before a stealth target escapes, or yellow for a distant bolt. Low damage per individual action and an externally visible sequence let opponents predict your next useful property.

team.text: Light makes panels easier for allies to identify without hiding them from enemies. Crystal can redirect a split ray but cannot split it again or multiply hue triggers.

name: Reptile
identity: Reptile uses a resilient body, low movement, and a planned molt. It differs from Beast's pursuit and Animal's broad adaptations by committing to scales, climbing grip, and short temperature-dependent windows.

moves.name: Tail Sweep
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Sweep a 180-degree rear-and-side arc for 80 damage and 1.5-metre knockback. The space directly in front of your chest is a safe gap. Turning becomes locked once the sweep starts.
moves.p60: Extends the tail's reach by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Stay in the frontal gap or move beyond the sweep radius.

moves.name: Wall Grip
moves.statline: CD 13 s | E 19 | H 6 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Climb a designated traversable wall up to 5 metres for 3 seconds. You cannot cling to ceilings or attack while climbing. A direct hit releases your grip into ordinary falling.
moves.p60: Allows one Tail Sweep after voluntarily dropping.
moves.counterplay: Shoot the climbing silhouette or control the top edge.

moves.name: Shed Skin
moves.statline: CD 19 s | E 25 | H 8 | W 0.7 s | R self
moves.desc: Consume all remaining Plates, remove one slow or poison effect, and leave an 80-durability skin for 4 seconds. The skin blocks one projectile; you gain 15 shield per Plate consumed for 3 seconds.
moves.p60: Restores one Plate after the skin is destroyed.
moves.counterplay: Pressure immediately while the reptile's natural protection is depleted.

moves.name: Basking Rush
moves.desc: Hold still to bask for 0.8 seconds, then rush 7 metres for 110 damage. Having three or four Plates adds 20 damage. Taking damage during basking cancels the bonus, not the rush itself.
moves.p60: Lets you turn up to 20 degrees during the first half of the rush.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the preparation or sidestep the committed charge.

moves.name: Ancient Scale Form
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.1 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 8 seconds, gain six temporary Plates, a 15% larger body, and an additional 20 damage on Tail Sweep. Lost Plates do not regenerate during the form. Its larger hitbox is fully functional and visibly outlined.
moves.counterplay: Expend the finite Plates with controlled hits or evade the brief shedding warning.
moves.unstable: Sheds all six Plates at once into a 150-damage ring, immediately ending the form.

passive.name: Scale Plates
passive.text: Begin with four Plates. The first direct hit every 1.5 seconds consumes one Plate to reduce that hit by 15 damage. Recover one Plate after 3 seconds without damage, maximum four; damage-over-time does not consume Plates.

mutation.name: Brittle Renewal
mutation.text: The unstable shed cannot generate more shield through Shed Skin and does not restore ordinary Plates. Fire or Ice may change the visual basking effect, but neither grants an unlisted immunity or automatic stun.

sequence: Use Plates to survive entry, reserve Shed Skin for a meaningful debuff, and climb to reset pressure. Repeated small direct hits strip defense more efficiently than one enormous attack.

team.text: Standing in an allied Solar light patch shortens Basking Rush preparation by 0.2 seconds once per cast. Ice slows the climb normally, but cannot freeze the reptile beyond global control caps.

name: Rock
identity: Rock manipulates a small number of discrete, physical masses. Earth reshapes terrain; Rock creates objects with positions, durability, and momentum. Its strength is making yesterday's cover become today's projectile.

moves.name: Pebble Volley
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 14 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Fire three pebbles in a shallow fan for 25 damage each. At close range all can hit; at long range the spread naturally limits overlap. They stop on the first solid collision.
moves.p60: Tightens the fan if you have remained still for 0.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Create distance to reduce overlap or block the spread.

moves.name: Boulder Birth
moves.desc: Raise one boulder after a 0.6-second ground warning. Its emergence deals 60 damage and pushes an overlapping body to the nearest legal side. It lasts 12 seconds and cannot appear inside occupied structures.
moves.p60: Grants the new boulder 40 extra durability.
moves.counterplay: Leave the emergence marker or destroy the boulder from a safe angle.

moves.name: Rolling Verdict
moves.desc: Kick one own boulder into an 18-metre roll for 110 damage. It slows on slopes, stops at major obstacles, and hits each enemy once. If at least half its durability remains, it settles as cover at the endpoint.
moves.p60: Allows one 15-degree steering correction early in the roll.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep its broad but committed route or break it before arrival.

moves.name: Stone Splitter
moves.desc: Shatter an own boulder into five fragments in a 70-degree cone, each dealing 35 damage. A target can take at most three fragments. The boulder is consumed regardless of whether the shot hits.
moves.p60: Leaves one 60-durability remnant where it stood.
moves.counterplay: Move out of the forward cone or force the caster to spend useful cover.

moves.name: Monolith Procession
moves.desc: Four 180-durability monoliths rise in a line with 2-metre gaps. Select each once over 6 seconds to topple for 100 damage along its marked 5-metre footprint. Untoppled monoliths crumble harmlessly at expiry.
moves.counterplay: Move through the gaps and avoid the next marked falling footprint.
moves.unstable: Topples all remaining monoliths in sequence, with 0.7-second warnings, but prevents voluntary cancellation.

passive.name: Three Stones
passive.text: Maintain up to three 140-durability boulders. Newly created boulders replace the oldest. A stationary boulder provides cover; a moving one cannot simultaneously block shots as an indestructible object.

mutation.name: Avalanche Commitment
mutation.text: No target takes more than three monolith hits. Falling stone never breaks protected flooring or turns a knockdown into an indefinite crush; surviving characters are placed beside the settled rubble.

sequence: Birth a boulder to claim cover, roll it to displace that cover, or split it to punish a close approach. Mobility around your finite objects forces expensive decisions about which rock to sacrifice.

team.text: Either partner can move an eligible loose boulder. Ownership stays with Rock for the three-stone cap, and a transferred boulder cannot deal both its own roll damage and a second full throw budget.

name: Sand
identity: Sand creates unstable footing, abrasive streams, and temporary dunes. It never suffocates a target through an unavoidable status or buries them beneath unbreakable scenery. Its terrain changes routes without permanently changing the map.

moves.name: Abrasive Stream
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 12 m
moves.desc: Channel a narrow stream for 0.8 seconds, dealing four 20-damage ticks. You move at half speed and can turn slowly. The stream has limited width and cannot bend around cover.
moves.p60: Extends range by 2 metres for the final two ticks.
moves.counterplay: Move laterally or interrupt the exposed channel.

moves.name: Dune Rise
moves.desc: Raise a 200-durability, 3-metre-high dune over 1 second. It lasts 8 seconds and is walkable from both sides; steep faces slow climbers 20%. It cannot seal an exit or overlap protected objects.
moves.p60: Lets one face remain shallow for easier allied ascent.
moves.counterplay: Climb the shallow side or break the dune's low durability.

moves.name: Sifting Step
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 24 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Move as a low sand ribbon up to 7 metres along clear ground. You remain damageable, cannot pass under sealed doors, and emerge immediately if rooted. The ribbon leaves a visible trail.
moves.p60: Removes one slow at the start.
moves.counterplay: Aim along the ground trail or force the route onto broken terrain.

moves.name: Burial Circle
moves.desc: A 4-metre circle churns for 3 seconds. Enemies inside take 25 damage per second; those at three Drift are rooted for 0.6 seconds once, then lose all Drift. The effect only reaches ankle height.
moves.p60: Preserves one Drift after the root.
moves.counterplay: Exit before three Drift or jump across the circle instead of standing in it.

moves.name: March of the Dunes
moves.desc: Three 5-metre-wide dunes advance 10 metres over 5 seconds, each dealing 80 damage and pushing 1.5 metres on first contact. Their crests obscure distant sight but leave clear silhouettes within 4 metres.
moves.counterplay: Move into the spaces between dunes and watch the final crest's direction.
moves.unstable: Reverses the final dune after a 0.8-second warning, sacrificing the other two.

passive.name: Loose Footing
passive.text: Your sand zones build one Drift on an enemy after each full second of continuous contact, maximum three. Each Drift adds 5% slow, up to 15%, and all fade 1 second after leaving sand.

mutation.name: Shifting Desert
mutation.text: An enemy can take at most three dune hits total, including the reversal. Sand never disables the interface, covers the entire screen, or erases close-range attack cues.

sequence: Use Dune Rise to shape a lane, build Drift with Stream pressure, and threaten Burial Circle where an enemy wants to stop. Airborne approaches and rapid disengagement prevent Drift from accumulating.

team.text: Water turns one sand patch into ordinary Mud terrain with no stacked slows. Glass can harden one dune into 160-durability cover, replacing its sand slow and using the same expiry time.

name: Shot
identity: Shot rewards aimed releases, ricochets, and selective reload windows. Its weapons are stylized energy launchers, not real-world firearm instructions. Weapon offers multiple combat tools; Shot concentrates on making a small projectile kit reliable.

moves.name: Pinpoint Round
moves.desc: Fire a visible, fast projectile for 80 damage. It has travel time and no automatic headshot multiplier. Holding for 0.5 seconds reduces movement speed 20% and adds 15 damage with a bright aiming glint.
moves.p60: Lets a fully held shot deal 20 additional guard damage.
moves.counterplay: Break sight or move after the glint appears.

moves.name: Bank Shot
moves.desc: Fire a 75-damage round that ricochets once from eligible hard terrain. A preview shows the first reflection; a ricochet adds no damage. If the angle would trap it in geometry, the round dissipates.
moves.p60: Allows a second ricochet, with damage reduced to 60 after that bounce.
moves.counterplay: Move away from the visible reflected lane.

moves.name: Covering Burst
moves.desc: Send five 25-damage projectiles across a chosen 30-degree fan over 0.7 seconds. You may stop firing early, but unused shots are lost and costs remain. The burst has no stun or suppression debuff.
moves.p60: Lets you narrow the fan to 15 degrees before the first shot.
moves.counterplay: Use cover between projectiles or flank the locked firing direction.

moves.name: Tactical Reload
moves.statline: CD 20 s | E 16 | H 5 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend 1 second refreshing your launcher. On completion, reduce Pinpoint Round and Bank Shot cooldowns by 3 seconds each. Taking a direct hit interrupts the reload; no resources are refunded.
moves.p60: Allows walking at half speed during the reload.
moves.counterplay: Maintain light pressure to deny the reset.

moves.name: One Clear Lane
moves.desc: Designate a 4-metre-wide lane and load three charged rounds for 6 seconds. Each manual release has a 0.5-second glint and deals 110 damage. Each round can pierce one enemy for 55 damage to a second, but stops at cover.
moves.counterplay: Break the lane with solid cover or dash after the final aim locks.
moves.unstable: Merges remaining rounds into one shot for 110 damage per round, capped at 330, with a 1.2-second warning.

passive.name: Steady Sight
passive.text: Remaining grounded and not dashing for 0.7 seconds narrows projectile spread by 25%. A direct ability hit on the same enemy twice within 4 seconds marks them for 2 seconds, revealing only while unobstructed.

mutation.name: Last Round
mutation.text: The merged shot cannot pierce an additional target or acquire a separate headshot bonus. Moving aim remains visibly constrained by the announced lane; it cannot whip behind the caster at release.

sequence: Bank shots test entrenched positions; a glint pressures movement; Covering Burst punishes a predictable dodge. Close lateral rushes and sustained chip deny the stationary aim and reload windows you prefer.

team.text: Mirror can redirect one round while preserving damage and bounce limits. Defensive creates a firing position, but Shot cannot fire through its opaque shields unless that specific shield permits allied passage.

name: Shadow
tagline: Connections between visible patches of shade
identity: Shadow uses actual, readable shadow anchors for movement and delayed strikes. Dark creates hostile dark energy; Shadow depends on positions. Every usable anchor remains outlined for opponents, even when the environment itself is dim.

moves.name: Shade Cut
moves.desc: Send a flat crescent along the floor for 75 damage. On terrain impact it leaves an anchor at the last legal ground point. It cannot hit enemies floating more than 2 metres above its path.
moves.p60: Adds 2 metres of travel.
moves.counterplay: Jump over the low crescent or sidestep its narrow route.

moves.name: Umbra Passage
moves.desc: Travel to one own anchor in range after a visible connecting trail appears for 0.5 seconds. The path must be clear and traversable; you are untargetable only during the 0.15-second transit, not windup or arrival.
moves.p60: Preserves the destination anchor instead of consuming it.
moves.counterplay: Break the anchor or punish the clearly marked arrival point.

moves.name: Borrowed Silhouette
moves.desc: Attach a visible shadow to an enemy with a 40-damage projectile. After 1 second, it swings from their previous facing for 60 damage. The swing location locks 0.4 seconds before contact.
moves.p60: Leaves an anchor where the delayed swing occurred.
moves.counterplay: Change position after the lock or cleanse the attached silhouette.

moves.name: Long Evening
moves.desc: Connect two own anchors with a 0.8-metre-wide dark seam for 4 seconds. Crossing it deals 80 damage and slows 20% for 1 second, once per enemy. Destroying either anchor ends the seam.
moves.p60: Lets the seam curve around one designated open corner, with its entire route visible.
moves.counterplay: Break an endpoint or jump across the seam.

moves.name: Court of Moving Shadows
moves.desc: Place four temporary anchors around a 7-metre area. Over 6 seconds, choose three anchor-to-anchor slashes for 90 damage each; every connecting line warns for 0.7 seconds. Each slash consumes its origin anchor.
moves.counterplay: Destroy anchors to remove possible lines or step into space between them.
moves.unstable: Executes all remaining legal lines in a fixed announced sequence, then destroys every own anchor.

passive.name: Three Anchors
passive.text: Your abilities can create up to three 60-durability shadow anchors lasting 8 seconds. Anchors require traversable surfaces, cannot occupy protected areas, and are suppressed while inside an explicitly cleansing Light field.

mutation.name: Midnight Debt
mutation.text: No target takes more than three ultimate slashes. Shadows never serve as permission to teleport through arbitrary walls, possess a target, or strike them without a connected, displayed route.

sequence: Use Shade Cut to place a safe route, threaten a seam, then travel when the enemy commits elsewhere. Bright cleansing zones, anchor destruction, and vertical movement remove your positional foundation.

team.text: Light's designated cleansing fields suppress anchors while active. Dark can create suitable visual shade, but Shadow must still spend its own ability to place a usable anchor there.

name: Size
tagline: Changing body dimensions with real tradeoffs
identity: Size changes reach, targetability, and traversal within strict bounds. Enlarging increases your actual hitbox; shrinking shortens your reach. Neither state permits clipping through scenery, escaping target locks automatically, or altering another player's interface.

moves.name: Scale Shift
moves.statline: CD 8 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Choose the next size. The transformation takes 0.4 seconds and fails without cost if there is insufficient space. Existing projectiles, shields, and attached effects do not resize with you.
moves.p60: Grants 35 shield for 2 seconds after a legal transformation.
moves.counterplay: Pressure during the visible transformation or use the resulting hitbox tradeoff.

moves.name: Measured Blow
moves.statline: CD 10 s | E 18 | H 6 | W 0.4 s | R 4 m
moves.desc: Strike for 80 damage at Standard. Small deals 65 with 0.15-second faster recovery; Large deals 105 with 0.2-second slower recovery. All versions have a clearly distinct animation and no hidden reach beyond the model.
moves.p60: Adds 15 damage only if your size changed within the previous 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Read the size and punish the appropriate recovery.

moves.name: Pocket Passage
moves.statline: CD 16 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Shrink to Small and dash 5 metres through a visibly valid opening. The game previews whether the full route fits. You remain damageable and return to your previous size only when legal space exists.
moves.p60: Extends the dash by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Attack the previewed exit or deny the route with an area attack.

moves.name: Giants Reach
moves.desc: Temporarily extend one arm to deliver a 100-damage downward strike in a 2-metre circle. The hand's landing point locks after windup; hitting the extended arm damages you normally.
moves.p60: Widens the impact circle by 0.5 metres.
moves.counterplay: Leave the marked landing point or attack the exposed arm.

moves.name: Colossal Interval
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.2 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 7 seconds, enter Colossal at 180% size, gain 180 shield, and replace basic attacks with 90-damage, 5-metre sweeps every 0.9 seconds. Movement slows 20%; ordinary abilities remain available with their listed reach caps.
moves.counterplay: Kite the slower giant, attack the larger hitbox, and leave the stomp radius.
moves.unstable: Ends the form with a 150-damage, 6-metre stomp after a 1-second warning, sacrificing any remaining shield.
