passive.name: Mass Budget
passive.text: Maintain Small at 70%, Standard at 100%, or Large at 140% visual and collision scale. Small grants 10% movement speed but reduces basic reach 20%; Large adds 20% basic reach but reduces movement speed 10%. Health never changes with scale.

mutation.name: Return to Scale
mutation.text: Reversion uses the nearest legal standing space without crossing walls. If clearance is unavailable, the model compresses harmlessly while collision stays valid; it never crushes trapped enemies or preserves Colossal attack reach.

sequence: Small helps approach, Standard preserves mobility, and Large punishes a committed opponent. Scale changes cannot simultaneously deliver Small's target profile and Large's reach; accuracy and area attacks punish poor mode choices.

team.text: Space checks the traveller's current collision size at both portal ends. Elasticity can cushion a giant's landing, but does not expand the legal size cap or allow the giant through an invalid gap.

name: Slasher
identity: Slasher creates cutting edges and rewards connecting different attack angles. Weapon changes tools and Fight exploits technique; Slasher commits to offensive geometry, narrow openings, and the risk of being punished after a missed swing.

moves.name: Horizon Edge
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 14 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 5 m
moves.desc: Sweep a horizontal crescent for 75 damage across a 100-degree arc. Its outer edge travels slightly farther than its centre; turning locks during the active swing. It counts as a horizontal hit.
moves.p60: Extends the outermost edge by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Backstep the edge or pass behind the locked swing.

moves.name: Falling Line
moves.desc: Bring down a vertical blade of force for 100 damage along a narrow 7-metre line. The line is marked briefly before contact and counts as a vertical hit. It cannot pass through solid cover.
moves.p60: Adds 20 guard damage to a blocked strike.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the thin line rather than retreating along it.

moves.name: Draw and Pass
moves.statline: CD 16 s | E 23 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Dash 6 metres and deliver a 70-damage horizontal cut to one enemy beside your path. The attack does not track behind you, and the dash stops at a solid collision.
moves.p60: Lets you choose which side receives the cut at release.
moves.counterplay: Move to the unselected side or punish the dash endpoint.

moves.name: Guard Splitter
moves.desc: Raise a blade overhead and strike vertically for 120 damage. Against guard, it deals 60 guard damage rather than bypassing the guard. Missing creates 0.8 seconds of recovery.
moves.p60: Refunds 8 Energy if the strike breaks a guard.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the long preparation or sidestep and punish the miss.

moves.name: Thirteen Visible Cuts
moves.desc: Mark a 6-metre zone with thirteen cosmetic strokes, then execute four real cuts in a numbered order: horizontal, vertical, diagonal, cross. Each deals 75 damage after a 0.6-second preview; the remaining strokes are non-damaging decoration.
moves.counterplay: Follow the numbered real cuts and move into already-cleared sections.
moves.unstable: Lets you rotate the last cross by 45 degrees during an extra 0.5-second warning, but removes your exit dash option until it resolves.

passive.name: Crosscut
passive.text: Landing horizontal and vertical Slasher hits on the same enemy within 4 seconds primes a Crosscut. Your next direct Slasher hit deals 35 bonus damage, then clears the sequence. Repeating the same angle does not advance it.

mutation.name: Edge Without Retreat
mutation.text: Decorative strokes are thinner and never use active-hit warning colours. Crosscut can trigger once during the ultimate; the ultimate cannot repeatedly rebuild and consume its own passive bonus.

sequence: Horizon encourages a retreat, Falling Line punishes that straight retreat, and Draw and Pass changes sides. Strong spacing and interrupts against Guard Splitter deny your angle sequence.

team.text: Thread can constrain a route but never extends Slasher's hitbox beyond its visual edge. Steel can reinforce one blade to add 15 guard damage, once, without increasing health damage.

name: Slime
tagline: Viscosity changes and a conserved body
identity: Slime changes between fluid mobility and dense impact. It can separate a small portion of itself, but cannot create unlimited independent bodies, absorb every incoming attack, or become completely untargetable by spreading thinly.

moves.name: Gel Jab
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 13 | H 4 | W 0.25 s | R 5 m
moves.desc: Extend a gelatinous fist for 70 damage. Fluid reaches 7 metres with unchanged damage; Dense reaches 4 metres and deals 90. The stretched limb remains part of your vulnerable hitbox until it retracts.
moves.p60: Shortens retraction by 0.15 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Attack the extended limb or move beyond the current mode's reach.

moves.name: Sticky Patch
moves.desc: Leave a 3-metre puddle for 6 seconds. Enemies are slowed 20% while touching it; Fluid Slime moves across it 15% faster. The puddle has 100 durability and is not an independent body.
moves.p60: Lets you reclaim it while touching it to recover 8 Energy.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the puddle or jump across its narrow footprint.

moves.name: Separate Self
moves.desc: Send a 100-health, non-attacking blob to a visible point for 5 seconds. Recast swaps your position with it along a clear path. The swap consumes the blob; its destruction deals no damage to your main body.
moves.p60: Lets the blob move an additional 3 metres before swapping.
moves.counterplay: Break the blob or obstruct the visible swap route.

moves.name: Impact Reservoir
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 26 | H 10 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Dense mode only: for 1 second, reduce the next frontal hit by 50% and store up to 80 prevented damage. Recast within 2 seconds releases a 4-metre cone for 40 plus the stored amount; otherwise it dissipates.
moves.p60: Preserves the stored charge for 1 extra second.
moves.counterplay: Use a weak hit to fill it poorly, then avoid the short cone.

moves.name: Great Gel Tide
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.2 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: Become a broad, 3-metre-wide moving gel wave for 5 seconds. You remain damageable, gain 150 shield, and move at normal speed. First contact deals 110 damage and pushes 2 metres; repeat contact deals nothing.
moves.counterplay: Attack the enlarged body, destroy side waves, or move behind the forward tide.
moves.unstable: Splits off two 80-health side waves for 70 damage each, but removes your shield immediately.

passive.name: Viscosity
passive.text: Choose Fluid or Dense by holding guard for 0.6 seconds without taking damage. Fluid grants 10% movement speed but takes 10% more direct damage; Dense reduces incoming direct damage 10% but slows movement 10%. The body texture clearly changes.

mutation.name: Divided Mass
mutation.text: One enemy can take at most two wave hits total. All separated mass expires with the form; blobs cannot capture, revive, copy your abilities, or create further blobs.

sequence: Fluid closes distance through a patch; Dense contests one committed hit; a preplaced blob gives an exit. Burst damage against Fluid and patient attacks against Reservoir punish automatic mode swapping.

team.text: Water broadens one Sticky Patch by 1 metre but reduces its slow to 10%. Ice can freeze a patch into 100-durability terrain, removing its movement effects for both teams.

name: Snow
identity: Snow controls visibility, footing, and gradual accumulation. Ice creates rigid frozen structures; Snow creates loose cover that can be dispersed. Its whiteout preserves close-range readability and never replaces the whole screen with an opaque overlay.

moves.name: Packed Snowball
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 13 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Throw a visible snowball for 65 damage and one Powder. It falls along a shallow arc and bursts harmlessly on a wall. It does not freeze or stun its target.
moves.p60: Leaves a 1-metre patch of snow for 3 seconds on terrain impact.
moves.counterplay: Move sideways or use overhead cover against the arc.

moves.name: Powder Bank
moves.desc: Raise a 150-durability, 2-metre-high snowbank for 7 seconds. It blocks sight and ordinary projectiles while intact but is easily climbed. Crossing the crest applies one Powder to enemies.
moves.p60: Grants allies 30 shield once when they cross its crest.
moves.counterplay: Break the bank or approach around its short sides.

moves.name: Silent Ski
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 23 | H 8 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Glide 8 metres along the ground, extending to 10 on existing snow. You remain visible and damageable but create no footstep sound. A clear trail communicates the route to players relying on visuals.
moves.p60: Allows a single 20-degree turn during the glide.
moves.counterplay: Watch the trail and aim at the glide's predictable endpoint.

moves.name: Snow Veil
moves.desc: A 5-metre field of falling snow lasts 5 seconds. Distant silhouettes fade beyond 8 metres across it; nearby enemies within 4 metres remain fully readable. Every full second inside applies one Powder.
moves.p60: Lets you shift the veil 2 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Close the distance, leave the field, or attack through its visible boundary.

moves.name: Avalanche Curtain
moves.desc: A 10-metre-wide wall of loose snow travels 12 metres over 3 seconds. First contact deals 170 damage and pushes 3 metres; behind it remains a 5-second snowfield. The wall stops at major solid terrain.
moves.counterplay: Use the central gap, move around the wall's edge, or shelter behind substantial cover.
moves.unstable: Leaves two parallel curtains with a 2-metre safe gap, each dealing 130 damage; one enemy can be hit by only one.

passive.name: Powder Layer
passive.text: Enemies standing in your snow gain one Powder every second, maximum three. At three, their next dash travels 15% less distance, then all Powder clears. Leaving snow for 2 seconds removes the buildup.

mutation.name: Blind Winter
mutation.text: Curtains never overlap into an unavoidable double hit. Snowfall cannot hide the next active attack marker, alter target indicators, or obscure accessibility cues that other powers are required to show.

sequence: Build Powder before threatening a chase, use a bank to change sightlines, then ski to another angle. Fire and sustained area damage remove your fragile cover, while flyers ignore much of your footing control.

team.text: Wind disperses a Snow Veil after 1 second of sustained contact. Ice hardens a snowbank to 220 durability but removes its climb shield and Powder application, replacing loose snow with ordinary Ice cover.

name: Solar
tagline: Exposure and a moving point of daylight
identity: Solar projects concentrated daylight and stores its own exposure. Light specializes in illumination and clean sightlines; Solar builds and spends warmth around a designated sun. Natural daylight is cosmetic and never decides whether the kit functions.

moves.name: Sunlance
moves.desc: Fire a golden lance for 80 damage. Spend one Exposure to add 20 damage and a brighter release flash. It is a projectile with travel time, not an instantaneous line through cover.
moves.p60: Lets the empowered lance pierce a weakened construct with less than 50 durability.
moves.counterplay: Use hard cover or sidestep after the bright charge.

moves.name: Sunspot
moves.desc: Place a 120-durability miniature sun 3 metres above a chosen point for 8 seconds. It illuminates its 5-metre zone and supplies Exposure. Only one Sunspot exists; its light does not deal passive damage.
moves.p60: Permits moving the sun 3 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the visible sun or force Solar outside its lit area.

moves.name: Helios Guard
moves.statline: CD 18 s | E 25 | H 9 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Gain 90 shield for 4 seconds. Spend up to two Exposure to add 30 shield each. When the shield expires, it emits a harmless flare that briefly marks your location; it never becomes an unavoidable blind.
moves.p60: Returns one Exposure if the shield survives its full duration.
moves.counterplay: Apply controlled damage or wait out the finite protection.

moves.name: Noon Arc
moves.desc: Sweep a narrow beam through a 60-degree arc over 0.8 seconds for 100 damage once per target. Spend two Exposure to add a 30-damage afterglow at the arc's endpoint after 0.6 seconds.
moves.p60: Lets you choose the sweep's direction before release.
moves.counterplay: Pass behind the sweep or avoid its clearly marked endpoint.

moves.name: High Sun Ascendant
moves.desc: Raise a 300-durability sun over an 8-metre zone for 7 seconds. Three rotating rays sweep outward, dealing 65 damage once per revolution, maximum three hits per target. Dark wedges between rays remain safe.
moves.counterplay: Move between rays or destroy the sun before its final sweep.
moves.unstable: Concentrates the final revolution into a single 180-damage ray with a 1-second aiming warning, then destroys the sun.

passive.name: Solar Exposure
passive.text: Your Sunspot creates a 5-metre lit zone. Remaining inside grants one Exposure each second, maximum four. Exposure lasts 6 seconds after leaving. Spending it improves designated abilities, not every damage source.

mutation.name: After Noon
mutation.text: The final ray replaces, rather than adds to, the last revolution. Solar cannot stack multiple suns, and reflected or split rays share the original per-target hit cap.

sequence: Place Sunspot where you can fight without standing still, earn Exposure, then choose offense or shield. An enemy who removes the sun or continually changes engagement location denies your resource engine.

team.text: Sunspot shortens Reptile's basking preparation as specified in that kit. Plant structures under it gain 20 maximum durability once, but no accelerated attack rate or unlimited growth.

name: Sound
identity: Sound manipulates audible and visible vibrations. Music depends on phrases and beats; Sound depends on surfaces, frequency modes, and pressure. Deafened status affects in-world sound cues only, never voice chat, system audio, or required visual warnings.

moves.name: Sonic Snap
moves.desc: Release a narrow pressure wave for 70 damage. It visibly compresses the air along its path and stops at a solid surface, marking it for Resonance. It cannot travel through arbitrary walls.
moves.p60: Widens the wave by 0.3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the narrow wave or make it strike unhelpful terrain.

moves.name: Tuning Fork
moves.desc: Plant a 120-durability fork for 7 seconds. Your next Sound wave hitting it splits into left and right 50-damage pulses. Each enemy can take only one pulse and the original wave is consumed.
moves.p60: Allows rotating the fork 30 degrees before it is struck.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the fork or leave its visible output lanes.

moves.name: Pressure Break
moves.desc: A 90-degree cone deals 90 damage and 35 additional guard damage. If it breaks guard, it pushes the target 2 metres instead of adding another stun beyond the normal guard break.
moves.p60: Extends the cone by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Release guard and dodge the cone or punish its windup.

moves.name: Quiet Pocket
moves.desc: Create a 4-metre area for 5 seconds that muffles footsteps and ability audio for anyone inside. All visual telegraphs remain unchanged. The boundary is clearly marked and opponents know when they enter it.
moves.p60: Reveals projectiles crossing the boundary with a bright ripple.
moves.counterplay: Trust visual information and fight outside the pocket when possible.

moves.name: Resonance Cathedral
moves.desc: Four 120-durability pillars surround a 7-metre zone. Three waves bounce between surviving pillars at 1-second intervals for 90 damage each, with their paths previewed 0.6 seconds early. Destroyed pillars remove their outgoing paths.
moves.counterplay: Break a pillar to open a safe sector or follow the changing previews.
moves.unstable: Creates one final 100-damage chord between surviving pillars, but destroys all of them afterward.

passive.name: Resonant Surface
passive.text: A direct Sound hit on terrain marks one surface for 6 seconds, maximum two. A later Sound wave striking a marked surface emits a 35-damage reflected pulse once, then clears the mark. A target cannot take both direct and reflected damage from the same cast.

mutation.name: Shattered Resonance
mutation.text: Every wave retains a one-hit-per-target cap regardless of reflections. The ultimate does not use real painful frequencies or require high audio volume; visual intensity cues fully represent its mechanics.

sequence: Use terrain to create a reflected threat, then aim the next wave where either route pressures movement. Open spaces with few useful surfaces and quick pillar destruction reduce your geometry options.

team.text: Sound can extend a musical area's radius once as specified by Music. Glass can reflect one ordinary Sound wave, but that reflection consumes the same reflection allowance rather than starting a loop.

name: Space
identity: Space connects legal places rather than rewriting time. Its portals require valid entrances and exits, have a finite throughput, and display where they lead. No portal reaches an unseen room, protected spawn, or coordinate outside the playable map.

moves.name: Fold Dart
moves.desc: Fire a 75-damage dart. If it crosses your own portal, it retains its remaining travel distance and emerges along the exit's indicated direction. It can use only one portal pair per cast.
moves.p60: Adds 3 metres of remaining range after a valid traversal.
moves.counterplay: Watch the linked exit rather than the initial firing angle.

moves.name: Paired Door
moves.desc: Place two linked, 130-durability apertures no more than 12 metres apart for 6 seconds. Both positions need line of sight at placement. Each admits two willing allied characters total; enemies cannot be forced through.
moves.p60: Allows one additional allied traversal.
moves.counterplay: Destroy either aperture or control the visible exit.

moves.name: Short Fold
moves.statline: CD 19 s | E 24 | H 8 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Teleport 6 metres to a visible, legal point after a 0.4-second destination flash. The route cannot cross a sealed solid obstruction. The arrival has 0.25 seconds of recovery and no lingering invulnerability.
moves.p60: Grants 30 shield for 1 second on arrival.
moves.counterplay: Attack the flashing destination or interrupt before transit.

moves.name: Distance Lens
moves.desc: Place a 4-metre field for 4 seconds. Ordinary hostile projectiles move 25% slower while inside but recover normal speed on exit. It affects neither hitscan beams nor melee reach, and does not alter their damage.
moves.p60: Lets allies see projected exit trajectories.
moves.counterplay: Move around the lens or use attacks it does not slow.

moves.name: Atlas of Open Doors
moves.desc: Create three paired routes around a fixed 9-metre area for 7 seconds, each with distinct symbols and 150-durability ends. Each pair admits two allied traversals and up to three projectiles, preserving their damage and remaining range.
moves.counterplay: Destroy key endpoints, watch the symbols, and deny the announced destination.
moves.unstable: Moves one exit up to 4 metres after a 1-second preview, but closes the other two pairs.

passive.name: Spatial Survey
passive.text: Aim at traversable ground for 0.5 seconds to preview a legal anchor within 20 metres. The preview displays exit clearance and line of sight; it confers no damage, reveal through walls, or hidden-target information.

mutation.name: Collapsed Distance
mutation.text: A body cannot be split by a closing portal; a committed traveller exits legally, then the pair closes. Portals cannot duplicate projectiles, refresh their lifetime, or chain into an endless loop.

sequence: A paired door creates a flank only if the exit is safe. Use Lens to buy reaction time while you relocate. Endpoint destruction and coordinated attacks on arrivals punish careless route planning.

team.text: Size must fit both apertures at its current collision scale. Shot may fire through one pair, retaining its projectile count, ricochet allowance, and ultimate hit restrictions.

name: Star
tagline: Small celestial bodies and finite stellar fuel
identity: Star summons individual miniature stars with finite fuel and readable orbits. Solar maintains exposure around one sun; Cosmic coordinates larger orbital patterns. Star treats each luminous body as an object that can shine, launch, or collapse once.

moves.name: Spark Birth
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.4 s | R 14 m
moves.desc: Spend one Fuel to create an 80-health star at a visible point for 7 seconds. On arrival it deals 55 damage in a 1.5-metre circle after a brief flare. It then remains stationary as a usable star.
moves.p60: Extends its lifetime by 2 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Leave the arrival flare or destroy the fragile star.

moves.name: Comet Throw
moves.desc: Launch one own star along a chosen 14-metre line for 100 damage, consuming it at first collision. Its tail clearly shows travel direction. With no star in range, the cast is unavailable and costs nothing.
moves.p60: Lets the comet leave one 30-damage cinder at its impact point.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the comet or place cover along its straight route.

moves.name: Binary Link
moves.desc: Connect two own stars within 8 metres for 4 seconds. Enemies crossing the line take 75 damage once and are revealed 2 seconds. Destroying either star ends the link without an explosion.
moves.p60: Refunds one Fuel if both stars survive the full link.
moves.counterplay: Destroy a star or jump across the line.

moves.name: Dying Light
moves.desc: Collapse one own star after a 0.8-second warning for 120 damage in a 3-metre circle. The star can still be destroyed during the warning, cancelling the collapse. It cannot collapse twice.
moves.p60: Gives allies within the circle 50 shield when the collapse resolves.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the warned star or move outside its radius.

moves.name: Constellations End
moves.desc: Create five temporary 100-health stars across a 7-metre pattern for 6 seconds. Choose three in sequence to collapse for 95 damage each after 0.7-second warnings. Unused stars expire harmlessly and cannot fuel normal abilities.
moves.counterplay: Destroy critical stars and move away from each announced collapse.
moves.unstable: Collapses all remaining stars in a fixed outer-to-inner order, but prevents normal Fuel recovery for 6 seconds.

passive.name: Stellar Fuel
passive.text: Maintain three Fuel points. Recover one every 4 seconds without casting a Star ability. Creating a star consumes one Fuel; abilities that require an existing star cannot conjure a replacement for free. Stars remain visibly countable.

mutation.name: Spent Constellation
mutation.text: A target can take at most three collapse hits during the entire ultimate. Temporary ultimate stars cannot be copied, converted into normal Fuel, or preserved beyond the constellation's expiry.

sequence: Place stars where either a comet or a link will matter, then collapse the one an enemy approaches. Destroying stars early turns your preparation into lost Fuel and creates a genuine recovery window.

team.text: A comet may traverse one Space portal without regaining range. Cosmic can move one ordinary star along a displayed orbit, but cannot extend its lifetime or remove Star's ownership limit.

name: Steel
identity: Steel forges a limited set of durable edges and plates. It is not control over every metal object in the world. Steel's distinctive resource is temper: investing preparation in a tool and deciding when to spend its improved form.

moves.name: Forged Spear
moves.desc: Throw a steel spear for 85 damage. At three Temper, it deals 30 additional guard damage and remains as a 100-durability planted spear for 5 seconds. The spear cannot pierce solid walls.
moves.p60: Lets you retrieve a planted spear within 3 metres for 8 Energy.
moves.counterplay: Block cautiously or sidestep the visible throw.

moves.name: Plate Mantle
moves.statline: CD 14 s | E 23 | H 8 | W 0.6 s | R self
moves.desc: Forge 130 shield for 5 seconds while slowing yourself 10%. At three Temper, the shield rises to 180 and ignores the first light knockback. It remains vulnerable to ordinary damage and cannot be healed.
moves.p60: Removes the self-slow for the first 1.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Wait out the limited shield or attack from a range the slower user cannot answer.

moves.name: Rivet Line
moves.desc: Drive four rivets along an 8-metre ground line for 25 damage each; a target can take at most three. At three Temper, the final rivet creates a 100-durability low brace for 4 seconds.
moves.p60: Lets the brace last 2 seconds longer.
moves.counterplay: Move perpendicular to the line or jump above the low rivets.

moves.name: Reforge
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 24 | H 7 | W 0.9 s | R self
moves.desc: Remain still for 1 second to restore 70 durability to one own planted spear or brace within 5 metres. Alternatively, restore 60 of your existing Plate Mantle shield, without extending its duration. This is not a forging ability for Temper consumption.
moves.p60: Permits walking at half speed during the work.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the visible forging animation or destroy the selected tool first.

moves.name: Foundry Champion
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.3 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 8 seconds, wield a broad steel blade and gain 160 shield. Three manual heavy swings deal 110 damage each in a 5-metre arc, each with 0.6-second windup. Ordinary attacks remain available between them.
moves.counterplay: Kite the heavy swings, then dodge the drop's fixed landing circle.
moves.unstable: Expends remaining swings in one 160-damage anvil drop with a 1-second ground warning, sacrificing all remaining shield.

passive.name: Tempered Edge
passive.text: Blocking a direct hit or hitting with a normal Steel ability grants one Temper, maximum three, once per cast or guard event. At three, your next forging ability consumes them for its listed tempered property. Temper expires after 8 seconds out of combat.

mutation.name: Quenched Too Fast
mutation.text: The anvil drop deals 160 regardless of how many swings remained; its advantage is area, not multiplying stored damage. Reforge cannot renew the ultimate shield or reset its duration.

sequence: Earn Temper through honest exchanges, choose a defensive mantle or an offensive spear, and reforge only when protected. Fast disengagement wastes your temporary investments, while sustained pressure prevents repairs.

team.text: An allied Fire hit can grant one Temper per 6 seconds without damaging Steel, but cannot bypass the three-point cap. Steel may reinforce a Slasher blade once as specified in that kit.

name: Storm
tagline: Moving weather fronts and charged transitions
identity: Storm combines a local wind front with scheduled lightning, rather than freely inheriting all Wind, Water, and Electric abilities. Its effects are strongest when an enemy remains inside the moving front long enough to be forecast and struck.

moves.name: Squall Gust
moves.desc: Release a narrow gust for 70 damage and 1.5-metre push. If it crosses your storm zone, widen it by 0.5 metres without increasing damage. It cannot pull a target backward through the caster.
moves.p60: Adds 1 metre of push against Forecast targets.
moves.counterplay: Move sideways or use a stable obstacle to limit displacement.

moves.name: Rolling Front
moves.desc: Create a 5-metre storm zone lasting 6 seconds. It visibly moves along a straight, previewed route, applies Forecast, and reduces enemy movement 10%. Only one normal front can exist at a time.
moves.p60: Allows one 30-degree direction change with a visible arrow.
moves.counterplay: Move across the front rather than following its travel direction.

moves.name: Forecast Bolt
moves.desc: Place a lightning marker under a visible enemy; it locks after 0.3 seconds and strikes 0.6 seconds later for 100 damage. Forecast adds 30 damage, then is consumed. The bolt does not follow after the lock.
moves.p60: Lets a missed bolt energize the ground for one 25-damage tick.
moves.counterplay: Move after the marker locks or break sight during initial targeting.

moves.name: Eye of Calm
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 24 | H 8 | W 0.6 s | R self
moves.desc: For 4 seconds, create a 3-metre calm circle that moves with you. Allies inside ignore Storm's own wind penalties and gain 60 shield on first entry. Hostile lightning and other elements remain fully functional.
moves.p60: Lets the circle remove one minor slow on first entry.
moves.counterplay: Attack from outside the small circle or pressure its finite shields.

moves.name: Supercell Procession
moves.desc: A 9-metre supercell moves 8 metres over 7 seconds. Four lightning lanes strike across it at 1.2-second intervals for 80 damage each, with 0.8-second forecasts. A 2-metre central eye remains safe from its own lanes.
moves.counterplay: Follow the clearly marked eye or leave the supercell entirely.
moves.unstable: Moves the safe eye 3 metres sideways before the last two lanes, with a 1-second preview.

passive.name: Weather Front
passive.text: Your storm zone travels at 2 metres per second in its initial direction. Enemies inside for 1 second become Forecast for 3 seconds, allowing designated lightning follow-ups. The mark appears above the target and never reveals through solid walls.

mutation.name: Broken Forecast
mutation.text: The moving eye never vanishes; it follows a shown path during relocation. Lanes retain a maximum of three hits per target, and no additional random lightning strikes outside the announced sequence.

sequence: Use the front to mark a route, push an enemy toward its next position, then punish a predictable dodge with Forecast Bolt. Enemies who cross the front quickly avoid most of its preparation.

team.text: Cloud may extend a front's lifetime by 1 second once. Electric can consume a Forecast mark for 20 additional damage on one hit, replacing Storm's own potential bonus rather than duplicating it.

name: Technology
tagline: A small network of readable devices
identity: Technology deploys fictional combat devices with batteries, sightlines, and destructible bodies. It cannot access real accounts, disable another player's software, or silently take ownership of every machine. Network strength depends on protected, visible nodes.

moves.name: Arc Projector
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Fire a small energy bolt for 70 damage. If aimed through an own scanner's visible line, it gains 10 damage. The scanner does not auto-aim the projectile or locate targets behind walls.
moves.p60: Lets a hit briefly display the target's current shield amount to you.
moves.counterplay: Leave the scanner's lane or dodge the manually aimed bolt.

moves.name: Scout Node
moves.desc: Place a 90-health scanner for 10 seconds. It sweeps a visible 90-degree cone out to 12 metres once per second, marking exposed enemies for 1 second. It cannot detect through solid cover or inside stealth without line of sight.
moves.p60: Extends the sweep range by 3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the scanner or move outside its shown cone.

moves.name: Sentry Pod
moves.desc: Deploy a 140-health sentry for 7 seconds. It fires a 20-damage visible bolt every 0.8 seconds at an exposed target within 10 metres, requiring 0.5 seconds to acquire a new target. Maximum six shots total.
moves.p60: Adds one shot without changing fire rate.
moves.counterplay: Break sight, destroy the pod, or bait its finite battery.

moves.name: Field Service
moves.desc: Channel for 1 second to repair 80 health to one own device or relocate it to a visible point within 4 metres. Repair never restores spent ammunition or extends the device's lifetime.
moves.p60: Allows a relocation to preserve the device's current target lock if sight remains clear.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the engineer or destroy the targeted device before service completes.

moves.name: Command Network
moves.desc: Deploy a 300-health command hub for 8 seconds. Up to three linked own devices gain 40 shield and 20% faster acquisition. The hub also permits two manual 100-damage orbital-style pulses, each with a 1-second ground warning and 4-metre radius.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the hub, break device links, or leave the clearly marked pulse area.
moves.unstable: Merges the two unused pulses into one 170-damage pulse with 6-metre radius, then shuts down all own devices for 4 seconds.

passive.name: Local Network
passive.text: Maintain up to three devices. Devices within 8 metres of another own device share target information only while a real enemy is in at least one's line of sight. A visible cable-light indicates a connection; disconnected devices still function locally.

mutation.name: Emergency Shutdown
mutation.text: The merged pulse is unavailable after either ordinary pulse is spent. Device shutdown is an in-world state with clear lights; it never resembles a crash, disconnect, input failure, or security alert.

sequence: A scanner supplies information, a sentry punishes a known lane, and service keeps one critical node alive. Flanking, area damage, and baiting limited ammunition dismantle the network without a special hacking ability.

team.text: Engine can reposition one eligible device using its own movement tool. Electric can drain two sentry shots on a direct device hit, once per cast; it does not take ownership or damage real software.

name: Thread
identity: Thread creates a limited network of physical filaments. Its control comes from anchoring, pulling, and cutting those lines; it cannot puppet a player's inputs, sever bodies with invisible wires, or attach an unlimited number of targets.

moves.name: Needle Cast
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 15 | H 5 | W 0.3 s | R 16 m
moves.desc: Throw a needle for 65 damage. A terrain hit anchors a thread between that point and your hand for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy deals damage but does not automatically attach a controlling line.
moves.p60: Lets the needle penetrate one fragile construct below 40 durability.
moves.counterplay: Block the needle or avoid the narrow throw.

moves.name: Anchor Weave
moves.desc: Connect two visible terrain points with a thread for 7 seconds. Crossing a Taut line deals 55 damage and slows 20% for 1 second, once per enemy. Slack lines deal no damage.
moves.p60: Gives the line 30 extra durability.
moves.counterplay: Cut the visible thread, step around an endpoint, or jump above it.

moves.name: Reel Step
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 23 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Pull yourself up to 7 metres toward a hand-held thread's anchor. The route must be clear and the line is consumed on arrival. You remain damageable throughout and cannot reel through another character.
moves.p60: Lets you stop early without consuming the anchor for 1 second.
moves.counterplay: Break the line or attack the predictable approach path.

moves.name: Scissor Release
moves.desc: Cut up to two own Taut lines. Each snaps along its displayed route for 90 damage, consuming it. A target can take damage from both only if it physically intersects both separate routes.
moves.p60: Returns 6 Energy for each line that hits a real enemy.
moves.counterplay: Move off the taut routes during the visible scissor windup.

moves.name: Loom of the Arena
moves.desc: Six 90-durability threads form a marked lattice across an 8-metre area for 6 seconds. Select three lines to snap for 90 damage each after 0.6-second warnings. Unselected lines remain traversable and deal no contact damage.
moves.counterplay: Destroy key lines or follow the order into already-cleared spaces.
moves.unstable: Snaps all surviving lines in a fixed numbered order, then removes every own thread.

passive.name: Tension Limit
passive.text: Maintain three threads, each with two visible endpoints and 70 durability. A thread becomes Taut when endpoints are more than 5 metres apart, visibly straightening. Moving an endpoint beyond 12 metres breaks the line harmlessly.

mutation.name: Unraveling
mutation.text: A target can take at most three ultimate snaps. Thread never creates invisible collision, compulsory movement animations, or lines anchored inside an enemy's body; all endpoints remain inspectable and attackable.

sequence: Build crossing routes, use Reel Step to change the angle of a hand-held line, then release when an enemy commits. Broad attacks clear fragile filaments, and open vertical space gives opponents routes above your network.

team.text: Slasher can cut an allied thread to trigger its existing snap budget with the normal warning. Weapon can anchor a thread to one planted tool, but retrieving that tool breaks the thread harmlessly.

name: Thorn
identity: Thorn creates sharp, limited hazards that punish movement through a defended route. Plant builds living architecture; Thorn specializes in the cost of crossing it. Its effects never deal damage merely because an enemy presses a movement key.

moves.name: Briar Needle
moves.desc: Fire two staggered thorns for 35 damage each. If both hit the same enemy, apply one Barb. The thorns travel along nearly parallel lines and stop at the first solid surface.
moves.p60: Brings their release interval from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the paired lane or block one thorn to deny the Barb.

moves.name: Barbed Hedge
moves.desc: Grow a 180-durability hedge 5 metres long and 1.5 metres high for 7 seconds. Crossing it deals 60 damage and applies one Barb, once per target. It blocks movement only until climbed or broken.
moves.p60: Lets you leave a 1-metre non-damaging opening during placement.
moves.counterplay: Use the opening, jump over the hedge, or destroy a section.

moves.name: Roseguard
moves.statline: CD 18 s | E 24 | H 9 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Gain 90 shield for 4 seconds. The first two melee attackers each receive 30 damage and one Barb when they make contact. Multiple hits from the same attack count once; ranged attacks trigger no retaliation.
moves.p60: Adds 30 shield without increasing retaliation count.
moves.counterplay: Use ranged pressure or wait for the short guard to expire.

moves.name: Catchthorn
moves.desc: Place a clearly visible thorn loop that arms after 0.8 seconds and lasts 5 seconds. The first enemy crossing it takes 80 damage and a 0.7-second root. The 80-durability loop breaks after triggering.
moves.p60: Leaves one Barb on the trapped target.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the loop or route around its visible boundary.

moves.name: Crown of Briars
moves.desc: A 7-metre ring of six 120-durability thorn sections grows with two open gates. Every 1.5 seconds, alternating sections extend inward for 80 damage and one Barb. Three extension beats occur; each is previewed by bright buds.
moves.counterplay: Use an open gate, destroy a section, or stand behind a section that already extended.
moves.unstable: Rotates the two open gates 60 degrees before the last beat, with a 1-second preview.

passive.name: Barbed Contact
passive.text: Your designated thorn hazards apply one Barb for 5 seconds, maximum three. The target's next dash consumes all Barbs for 15 damage each at dash start. Ordinary walking does not trigger this damage; a cleanse removes Barbs.

mutation.name: Cruel Bloom
mutation.text: Gates never close simultaneously during rotation. The ultimate's contact damage is capped at three hits per target, and Barb damage remains capped at 45 per dash rather than multiplying per thorn.

sequence: A hedge makes the direct route costly; needles apply pressure on the alternative; Catchthorn punishes an impatient escape. Methodical clearing and walking instead of panic-dashing reduce your payoff.

team.text: One Plant root can receive a Thorn coating using the same single-crossing damage budget as a hedge. Heal's appropriate cleanse removes Barbs, while raw healing simply offsets damage already taken.

name: Time
tagline: Local timing changes and limited snapshots
identity: Time alters the pace of a small area and preserves one recent position. It cannot rewrite a completed elimination, duplicate items, reset an entire match, or reverse another player's decisions. All timing changes are visible and bounded.

moves.name: Clock Shard
moves.desc: Fire a shard for 75 damage. Spend one Tick to slow the target's movement 15% for 1.5 seconds. The effect does not slow their camera, input sampling, or network connection.
moves.p60: Extends the slow by 0.5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Dodge the narrow shard or use cover to deny its application.

moves.name: Moment Anchor
moves.statline: CD 16 s | E 24 | H 8 | W 0.6 s | R self
moves.desc: Record your position for 4 seconds with a 100-durability clock. Recast returns you to it along a valid clear route. Health, Energy, Proxima, Heat, statuses, cooldowns, and carried objectives are not rewound.
moves.p60: Extends the window to 5 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the clock or deny the clearly marked return position.

moves.name: Slow Hour
moves.desc: Create a 4-metre field for 4 seconds. Enemy movement and ordinary projectile travel inside slow 20%; attack animations, cooldowns, and damage-over-time tick clocks remain unchanged. Leaving immediately restores normal pace.
moves.p60: Lets one willing ally ignore the field's projectile slowing for one cast.
moves.counterplay: Exit the field, use cover, or attack with a beam unaffected by travel speed.

moves.name: Borrowed Second
moves.statline: CD 23 s | E 26 | H 10 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Spend all Ticks to reduce the remaining cooldown of one other normal Time ability by 1 second per Tick. It cannot affect itself, an ultimate, a copied ability, or a cooldown already at zero.
moves.p60: Refunds 5 Energy when three Ticks are spent.
moves.counterplay: Recognize the clock-wheel flash and anticipate one earlier follow-up.

moves.name: The Suspended Hour
moves.desc: A 7-metre field lasts 6 seconds. Three times, a visible clock reaches noon and suspends ordinary projectiles inside for 0.6 seconds, then releases them at original speed. Enemies receive a 25% movement slow but are never fully frozen.
moves.counterplay: Move out before a clock strike, use melee or beams, and avoid the displayed suspended trajectories.
moves.unstable: Adds a fourth suspension, extending the field by 1 second, but locks your normal cooldown recovery during that extra second.

passive.name: Second Hand
passive.text: Completing a normal Time ability grants one Tick, maximum three. Ticks last 8 seconds. Spend them only through designated effects; they do not accelerate all cooldowns or grant a passive action-speed advantage.

mutation.name: Time Owed
mutation.text: Suspended projectiles keep their original ownership, damage, and remaining lifetime; expired shots dissipate. No suspension refreshes a projectile, stores an ultimate indefinitely, or creates an extra copy when time resumes.

sequence: Place a legal anchor before entry, slow a route, then spend Ticks to restore one useful tool earlier. Anchor destruction and attacks unaffected by travel speed keep Time from controlling every exchange.

team.text: Space checks a Time return's destination independently; a removed portal does not make a blocked return legal. Shot projectiles resume exactly once after suspension, with no duplicated impact or restored range.

name: Vampire
tagline: Recoverable aggression and a costly retreat
identity: Vampire sustains through direct contact with real enemies. Blood manages a personal reserve and droplets; Vampire steals a bounded portion of damage actually dealt. It cannot farm healing from allies, invulnerable targets, constructs, or its own summons.

moves.name: Crimson Bite
moves.statline: CD 7 s | E 16 | H 5 | W 0.35 s | R 3 m
moves.desc: Lunge 2 metres and strike for 85 damage. This is a guardable melee hit, not a compulsory grapple. If it hits an enemy below half health, add 15 healing after the normal passive calculation.
moves.p60: Extends the lunge by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Backstep or guard the short, direct approach.

moves.name: Bat Passage
moves.statline: CD 14 s | E 22 | H 8 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Become a visible bat-shaped swarm and travel 7 metres over 0.7 seconds. Your hitbox remains a clearly outlined 1-metre core; you gain 20% damage resistance but no invulnerability and cannot pass through walls.
moves.p60: Removes one minor slow on activation.
moves.counterplay: Aim at the core or punish the fixed travel endpoint.

moves.name: Sanguine Tether
moves.desc: Attach a visible link with a projectile for 40 damage. Maintain sight and remain within 12 metres for 2 seconds to deal three further 25-damage ticks and heal 15 per tick. Direct damage to you interrupts the link.
moves.p60: Allows one 0.2-second sight interruption without breaking it.
moves.counterplay: Break range, use cover, or hit the vampire during the drain.

moves.name: Night Feast
moves.desc: Sweep a 100-degree claw arc for 100 damage. Hitting two real enemies grants 50 shield for 3 seconds. The passive healing cap is shared across all victims, preventing crowd-size scaling.
moves.p60: Extends the shield to 4 seconds.
moves.counterplay: Spread out and punish the visible sweep recovery.

moves.name: Crimson Court
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.2 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 7 seconds, gain 15% movement speed and replace basic attacks with three available 90-damage lunges, each 5 metres and separated by at least 1 second. Successful lunges heal 35 each instead of using passive healing.
moves.counterplay: Break the lunge lanes, guard the entries, and punish a missed recovery.
moves.unstable: Adds a fourth lunge but removes all remaining self-healing from the form after the third.

passive.name: Living Hunger
passive.text: Direct Vampire ability damage heals you for 12% of health damage actually dealt, capped at 40 healing per cast. Shield damage grants nothing. Damage-over-time, reflected damage, and attacks during Burnout do not trigger it.

mutation.name: Hunger Without Rest
mutation.text: The extra lunge does not restore health or extend the form. Healing cannot exceed missing health, feed further drains, or return an eliminated Vampire to play; there is no passive resurrection.

sequence: Use a tether only when you can protect the channel, then chase with Bite or retreat with Bat Passage. Shields, anti-healing effects that explicitly exist, and patient spacing deny the health damage your sustain requires.

team.text: Blood can mark a route with droplets but cannot be consumed as free Vampire healing. Designated Light reveal effects expose the bat core; ordinary illumination does not invent a universal Vampire damage multiplier.

name: Void
identity: Void removes selected, bounded interactions. Destruction damages structures; Void can cancel a small projectile, suppress a temporary field, or create an empty gap. It cannot erase a player, delete their inventory, or override every other ultimate by definition.

moves.name: Null Shard
moves.desc: Fire a black-edged shard for 75 damage. It deals an additional 25 damage to temporary constructs but does not ignore shields, armor, or solid cover. Its silhouette remains visible against dark scenery.
moves.p60: Lets it pass through one construct it destroys, with 40 damage remaining.
moves.counterplay: Use durable cover or dodge the single narrow projectile.

moves.name: Empty Palm
moves.statline: CD 15 s | E 23 | H 8 | W 0.2 s | R 5 m
moves.desc: Spend one Absence to cancel one ordinary hostile projectile entering a frontal 90-degree cone during 0.35 seconds. It does not cancel beams, melee, ultimate projectiles, or already-applied damage-over-time.
moves.p60: Extends the cone's reach by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Bait the finite charge with a weak projectile or attack outside the cone.

moves.name: Hollow Patch
moves.desc: Place a 3-metre patch for 3 seconds. Spend one Absence to suppress one ordinary enemy ground field where they overlap; its duration continues running and it resumes if still active when suppression ends.
moves.p60: Lets you reposition the patch 2 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Move the fight outside the overlap or use a non-ground attack.

moves.name: Vanishing Step
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 25 | H 9 | W 0.4 s | R self
moves.desc: Blink 5 metres to a visible legal point, leaving a 1-second empty afterimage. The blink cannot cross a sealed wall, and you are vulnerable during its 0.4-second preparation and 0.3-second arrival recovery.
moves.p60: Makes the afterimage intercept one ordinary projectile, consuming an Absence only if it does.
moves.counterplay: Attack before transit or at the displayed arrival point.

moves.name: Boundary of Nothing
moves.desc: A 7-metre ring forms for 6 seconds with four 100-durability boundary nodes. It cancels up to six ordinary hostile projectiles crossing inward, one per 0.3 seconds. Every cancelled shot visibly extinguishes one of six notches; no damage is returned.
moves.counterplay: Use beams, melee, ultimate attacks, or destroy two boundary nodes to collapse the ring.
moves.unstable: Also suppresses one ordinary ground field inside for 3 seconds, but halves the remaining projectile allowance.

passive.name: Absence Charges
passive.text: Hold two Absence charges. Recover one after 5 seconds without cancelling an effect. Every successful cancellation consumes one; an attempted cancellation without a legal target spends nothing and provides no defensive window.

mutation.name: Cost of Absence
mutation.text: Cancellation never converts hostile damage into health, Energy, Proxima, or copied attacks. The ring does not stop a character crossing it, remove objectives, or delete the map beneath anyone.

sequence: Save finite charges for meaningful shots, use Hollow Patch to open a short approach, and blink after the opponent commits. Multi-hit volleys, beams, and melee pressure exhaust or bypass your narrow answers.

team.text: Destruction can break Void's physical boundary nodes. Mirror cannot reflect a cancellation into another cancellation; an already-nullified projectile ceases to exist and cannot be recovered as ammunition.

name: Water
identity: Water controls shallow currents, compact jets, and a finite moving body of water. It can redirect movement and extinguish designated fire effects, but cannot manipulate the water inside a living opponent or flood the entire arena without a bounded ability.

moves.name: Pressure Lance
moves.desc: Fire a narrow jet for 80 damage. Spend one Flow to push the target 1 metre. The jet stops at solid cover and cannot pierce an opponent's body to attack an arbitrary target behind it.
moves.p60: Increases range by 3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep the thin jet or brace behind cover.

moves.name: Running Channel
moves.desc: Create an 8-metre-long, 2-metre-wide shallow current for 6 seconds. Allies moving downstream gain 15% speed; enemies moving upstream are slowed 15%. Crossing sideways causes neither effect.
moves.p60: Lets the channel bend once around a visible open corner.
moves.counterplay: Cross the narrow channel sideways or control its endpoint.

moves.name: Undertow Step
moves.statline: CD 17 s | E 23 | H 8 | W 0.3 s | R self
moves.desc: Ride a 6-metre wave along clear ground. Crossing your own channel extends travel by 2 metres. The wave deals 45 damage once to enemies beside its route but does not drag them along.
moves.p60: Removes one Burn at activation.
moves.counterplay: Move perpendicular to the route or attack the exposed rider.

moves.name: Crest Break
moves.desc: Raise a 4-metre-wide crest that breaks forward for 100 damage and 2-metre push. Spend up to two Flow to add 15 damage each. Targets are pushed only as far as legal collision allows.
moves.p60: Leaves a 3-second channel at the crest's landing.
moves.counterplay: Move around the sides or interrupt the rising-water warning.

moves.name: Tide of the Returning Sea
moves.desc: A broad tide advances 12 metres for 140 damage, then returns after a 1-second pause for 100 damage. The return travels along the original path and pulls hit enemies 2 metres toward the starting edge, not toward a hidden centre.
moves.counterplay: Cross behind the outward wave and use the announced safe route on its return.
moves.unstable: Splits the return into two 80-damage side currents, leaving a 3-metre central safe lane.

passive.name: Flow Sequence
passive.text: Alternating a jet ability with a current ability grants one Flow, maximum three. Jet abilities are Pressure Lance and Crest Break; current abilities are Running Channel and Undertow Step. Flow lasts 7 seconds and is spent by designated effects.

mutation.name: Flood Recedes
mutation.text: No target takes more than one return-current hit. Water levels remain shallow and temporary; no drowning meter, unavoidable suffocation, permanent terrain removal, or bodily-fluid control is implied.

sequence: Alternate a precise jet with a movement current to earn Flow, then spend it on a meaningful crest. Wide open terrain and opponents who cross your channels sideways reduce your directional control.

team.text: A direct Water hit removes one ordinary Burn application or extinguishes one small Fire patch. Electric gains one extra legal ground-chain target through a Water channel, but never chains through all occupants automatically.

name: Weapon
identity: Weapon changes combat tools rather than gaining every weapon ever imagined. Three clear stances cover reach, defense, and range. Switching creates an opportunity but also a visible commitment; no stance secretly carries another element's entire moveset.

moves.name: Arsenal Shift
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 10 | H 3 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Switch to either other stance. The new tool unfolds visibly over 0.25 seconds. Guard capacity changes preserve the fraction already missing, preventing free guard restoration by repeated switching.
moves.p60: Grants 20 shield for 1 second after switching to a different stance.
moves.counterplay: Pressure during the visible change or exploit the newly selected tool's weakness.

moves.name: Signature Action
moves.desc: Blade sweeps 4 metres for 95 damage; Shield bashes 3 metres for 65 damage and 2-metre push; Bow fires one 90-damage projectile to 22 metres. Each version has the same cooldown but a distinct windup pose.
moves.p60: Adds 15 guard damage to Blade, 1 metre of push to Shield, or 3 metres of range to Bow.
moves.counterplay: Read the tool: evade the sweep, avoid the bash, or break the bow's sightline.

moves.name: Planted Standard
moves.desc: Plant a spare tool as a 150-durability standard for 7 seconds. Allies within 3 metres gain 8% faster guard recovery. Recast retrieves it if within 5 metres, ending the field and refunding 6 Energy.
moves.p60: Extends the recovery aura to 4 metres.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the standard or force allies outside its small radius.

moves.name: Countertool
moves.statline: CD 21 s | E 26 | H 10 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: Blade parries one frontal melee strike during 0.25 seconds; Shield blocks one ordinary projectile during 0.5 seconds; Bow performs a 4-metre backward hop without invulnerability. Successful parry or block deals no automatic retaliation.
moves.p60: Gives a successful defensive version 30 shield, or extends the hop by 1 metre.
moves.counterplay: Use an attack the active tool does not answer, or bait the short timing window.

moves.name: Armory in Motion
moves.statline: CD 90 s | E 40 | H 30 | W 1.1 s | R self | P 100
moves.desc: For 8 seconds, Arsenal Shift costs no Energy and each stance gains one enhanced Signature Action: Blade 125 damage, Shield 90 damage, Bow 120 damage. Each stance's enhancement is consumed once; Signature Action cooldown becomes 2 seconds during the window.
moves.counterplay: Read the tool order and avoid the shared lane or deny clean individual actions.
moves.unstable: Releases the remaining enhancements as three sequential spectral tools along one marked lane, but ends the stance-switching window immediately.

passive.name: Three Tool Rack
passive.text: Select Blade, Shield, or Bow using Arsenal Shift. Blade grants 0.5 metres of basic reach; Shield adds 15 guard capacity; Bow replaces basic attacks with 45-damage visible bolts every 0.8 seconds, range 18 metres. Only one stance is active.

mutation.name: Empty Rack
mutation.text: Only unspent stance enhancements can appear in the unstable sequence. Each spectral tool warns for 0.6 seconds; no tool is replenished by changing stance, copying the caster, or rewinding position.

sequence: Use Bow to provoke an approach, Shield to survive it, and Blade when the opponent commits. Switching on reaction is not instantaneous, and a wrong Countertool choice leaves its full cooldown exposed.

team.text: Steel can reinforce the standard by 40 durability once without extending its lifetime. Thread may anchor to it; retrieving or destroying the standard breaks that connection harmlessly.

name: Wind
identity: Wind shapes moving air into vectors. Fly owns sustained aerial movement; Storm owns a travelling weather system. Wind wins through directional repositioning, temporary lift, and redirecting a small number of eligible projectiles.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.statline: CD 6 s | E 14 | H 4 | W 0.3 s | R 18 m
moves.desc: Launch a thin pressure crescent for 70 damage. Its visible wake shows travel direction. It stops at solid terrain and does not cut through an unlimited number of enemies or structures.
moves.p60: Increases projectile width by 0.3 metres.
moves.counterplay: Move perpendicular to its path or block the single impact.

moves.name: Gale Step
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 19 | H 6 | W 0.2 s | R self
moves.desc: Dash 6 metres along a chosen horizontal direction. You can use it in the air once before landing; it adds no upward velocity and grants no invulnerability. Collision stops the movement.
moves.p60: Lets the dash clear one minor slow.
moves.counterplay: Aim at the landing route or force the dash toward an obstructed lane.

moves.name: Updraft Pillar
moves.desc: Create a 3-metre pillar for 4 seconds. Willing allies can ride it up 4 metres once; enemies receive a single 0.5-second lift and 50 damage on first entry. Its top does not trap anyone.
moves.p60: Grants allies a 1-second slow fall when leaving.
moves.counterplay: Avoid the visible pillar or attack riders from outside it.

moves.name: Crosswind
moves.desc: A 6-metre lateral gust deals 85 damage and pushes 2 metres. It redirects up to two ordinary projectiles by 30 degrees, preserving owner, damage, and remaining range. It cannot reflect them directly back.
moves.p60: Increases the projectile allowance to three.
moves.counterplay: Use beams, wait out the gust, or attack along its side rather than into it.

moves.name: Eye of the Gale
moves.desc: A fixed 8-metre wind ring rotates for 6 seconds. Three gust sectors pass around it, each dealing 80 damage and pushing 1.5 metres once per revolution, maximum three hits per target. A 3-metre centre stays calm.
moves.counterplay: Enter the calm centre or move with the shown rotation while avoiding the sectors.
moves.unstable: Reverses rotation after a 1-second preview, sacrificing the final revolution's damage for stronger 3-metre pushes.

passive.name: Tailwind
passive.text: Moving at least 3 metres in the same direction over 1 second grants Tailwind, increasing the next Wind movement ability's distance by 1 metre. A sharp reversal, root, or use clears it. Tailwind does not stack.

mutation.name: Air Runs Out
mutation.text: The reversed finale deals no damage, cannot push through walls, and cannot keep a target airborne beyond control limits. Wind never removes breathable air from a target's body or creates unavoidable asphyxiation.

sequence: Build Tailwind while approaching, use a pillar for a new angle, and crosswind an opponent away from cover. Indoor geometry and enemies who hold stable positions reduce the value of long movement vectors.

team.text: Wind can move one Cloud or Poison zone 3 metres with a deliberate gust. The zone retains its owner, damage budget, remaining lifetime, and target limits; moving it does not reapply entry damage instantly.

name: Witch
tagline: Prepared curses and a vulnerable familiar
identity: Witch binds explicit curses through ritual objects. Magic offers flexible spell construction; Witch invests in a target, a familiar, and chosen conditions. Its curses are fictional combat statuses, not claims about real supernatural harm.

moves.name: Needle Hex
moves.desc: Fire a crooked violet needle for 65 damage and one Hex. It curves at most 15 degrees toward your aim point during its first half of travel; it does not lock onto hidden or vanished targets.
moves.p60: Lets a missed needle leave a harmless 3-second ritual marker.
moves.counterplay: Sidestep late in its path or use solid cover.

moves.name: Familiar Watch
moves.desc: Summon a 100-health familiar for 7 seconds. It patrols a chosen 5-metre circle, marking visible enemies for 1 second when they enter. It deals no damage and cannot scout through walls, pick up objects, or cast curses independently.
moves.p60: Lets you relocate its patrol centre 3 metres once.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the familiar or enter from beyond its line of sight.

moves.name: Conditional Curse
moves.desc: Consume two Hexes and choose Haste or Shelter. For 3 seconds, the target's next dash triggers a delayed 80-damage sigil, or their next guard triggers 35 guard damage. The chosen condition is displayed above them; the action itself remains legal.
moves.p60: Returns one Hex if the condition triggers.
moves.counterplay: Avoid the named action temporarily or evade the delayed sigil after dashing.

moves.name: Broom Crossing
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 25 | H 9 | W 0.5 s | R self
moves.desc: Ride a visible broom 8 metres at 2 metres above ground over 1 second. It cannot cross sealed walls or gain altitude repeatedly. Taking a heavy interrupt ends the ride and produces a normal fall.
moves.p60: Grants 40 shield only during the ride.
moves.counterplay: Track the fixed-height route or deny its landing point.

moves.name: The Third Bell
moves.desc: Place a 250-health ritual bell inside a 7-metre circle. It tolls three times at 1.2-second intervals: first applies one Hex, second deals 90 damage, third consumes up to three Hexes per enemy for 35 damage each. Destroying the bell cancels remaining tolls.
moves.counterplay: Destroy the bell, leave its circle, or cleanse Hexes before the third toll.
moves.unstable: Allows the familiar to carry the bell 3 metres before the final toll, but the bell shares the familiar's remaining health if lower.

passive.name: Three Hex Marks
passive.text: Your direct Witch hits apply one Hex for 6 seconds, maximum three. Each mark is a visible symbol with a matching status icon. A cleanse removes all Hexes; merely healing health does not remove them.

mutation.name: Broken Coven
mutation.text: Moving the bell gives a full 1-second destination warning. The familiar cannot carry it through walls, survive its own destruction by transferring into the bell, or create a second ritual.

sequence: Use familiar information to land needles, then name the response you want to discourage. Curse conditions are strongest when the opponent has a real reason to choose that action; patient refusal and cleanses waste preparation.

team.text: Mystery can pressure a different action to create a meaningful choice, but their punishment triggers remain separate and visible. Ghost can transport no ritual object while fully phased unless its own move explicitly permits it.

name: Yin Yang
identity: Yin Yang alternates a protective Yin stance and an assertive Yang stance. Neither is automatically good or evil, and balance is a combat resource rather than a claim about real spiritual practice. The player must choose which side a situation needs.

moves.name: Twin Current
moves.desc: In Yin, release a 55-damage crescent that grants you 35 shield if it hits. In Yang, release an 85-damage crescent with no shield. Each version moves the dial toward its stance only on completion.
moves.p60: Makes Yin grant 50 shield or Yang deal 15 additional guard damage.
moves.counterplay: Read the current stance and decide whether to trade, block, or disengage.

moves.name: Turning Circle
moves.statline: CD 12 s | E 19 | H 6 | W 0.25 s | R self
moves.desc: Change stance while stepping 4 metres. It does not move the dial by itself, so repeated switching cannot farm the balance shield. The step follows normal collision and offers no invulnerability.
moves.p60: Permits choosing a curved step around one visible obstacle edge.
moves.counterplay: Track the step and punish the stance you know will follow.

moves.name: Stillness and Motion
moves.desc: Yin creates a 100-durability, 3-metre barrier for 3 seconds. Yang sends a 90-damage wave with 2-metre push. A barrier occupies the same slot as the wave; the ability cannot create both in one cast.
moves.p60: Raises barrier durability by 40 or extends the wave's reach by 2 metres.
moves.counterplay: Flank the short barrier or sidestep the forward wave.

moves.name: Restore the Centre
moves.statline: CD 22 s | E 26 | H 10 | W 0.8 s | R self
moves.desc: Return the dial to zero. From a negative value, gain 25 healing per step erased; from a positive value, send a 3-metre ring for 25 damage per step erased. Casting at zero is unavailable. This reset does not trigger Balance Dial's shield.
moves.p60: Removes one minor slow when at least two steps are erased.
moves.counterplay: Interrupt the deliberate recentering or stay outside the short offensive ring.

moves.name: Whole of the Turning World
moves.desc: Create an 8-metre circle divided into Yin and Yang halves for 7 seconds. Yin grants allies 20 healing per second; Yang deals enemies 25 damage per second. Rotate the dividing line up to 90 degrees once with a 0.8-second preview.
moves.counterplay: Follow the previewed boundary, leave the harmful half, and cross behind the final ring.
moves.unstable: Exchanges the halves after a 1-second warning, then collapses the circle into a 120-damage outward ring and ends all healing.

passive.name: Balance Dial
passive.text: Start at zero on a dial from minus three to plus three. Yin abilities move it one step negative; Yang abilities move it one positive. Crossing through zero after using both stances grants 40 shield, at most once every 5 seconds. Remaining at an extreme grants no bonus.

mutation.name: Balance Spent
mutation.text: The collapse replaces the final 2 seconds of the field rather than adding a full-duration extra attack. The circle does not invert health into damage, swap enemy and ally allegiance, or copy another element's ultimate.

sequence: Use Yin to survive entry, turn to Yang when an opponent commits, then recenter before the dial becomes predictable. Forced stance changes and long-range pressure can make the appropriate half of your kit unavailable at the wrong moment.

team.text: Light can clarify the boundary and Dark can obscure distant scenery, but neither removes the circle's visible symbols. Yin Yang's two halves keep separate ownership and cannot absorb those partners into a permanent combined form.
